lessons.title: SHAPING THE MINDSET + CLASSROOM VOCABULARY
lessons.grammar_topic: Shaping the mindset (grammatika yo'q)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: 'Shaping the mindset' bo'limi; Teacher's book: Lesson 1.
objectives: Nega ingliz tilini o'rganish kerakligini dalillar bilan tushuntirib bera oladi (~1,5 mlrd so'zlashuvchi, saytlarning ~yarmi, 500–600 soat dars + mustaqil ish, ~4000 so'z, 6 marta uchratish).
CEFR darajalari (A1–C2) va IELTS band (0–9) mosligini bilib oladi; o'zining hozirgi o'rnini (A1 — IELTS band 4.0 dan past) va kurs yo'lini (1.0 → 4.0) ko'rsata oladi.
Coin va XP tizimi, kombinatsiya va normativ nima ekanini tushunadi.
Sinfda ustoz bilan ishlatiladigan 20 ta asosiy iborani (CORE) tanib, aytib bera oladi.
Telegram guruhga qo'shiladi va birinchi ovozli normativni qanday topshirishni biladi.
materials: Doska, marker; 'CEFR–IELTS' va 'Qancha soat' jadvallari (grammar.notes dagi 'CEFR–IELTS' va 'Qancha soat' qatorlaridan doskaga yoziladi yoki chop etiladi).
Markazning Coin sovg'alari ro'yxati va XP ligalar jadvali (chop etilgan).
CORE 20 ibora varag'i — rejadagi CORE ro'yxatdan chop etiladi (har o'quvchiga bittadan).
Telegram guruh havolasi / QR-kod.
timeline: Salomlashish, tanishuv
Ustoz o'zini tanishtiradi. Har o'quvchi ismi va nima uchun kelganini 1 gapda aytadi. Har javobdan keyin qisqa maqtov: Well done! / Great! / Excellent! / Good answer!
SAVOL: Nega ingliz tili?
Doskaga 'SHAPING THE MINDSET — tushunchani shakllantirish' yoziladi. Hamma navbat bilan javob beradi. Fikrlar doskaga qisqa yoziladi.
Raqamlar bilan isbot
~1,5 mlrd so'zlashuvchi (har 5–6 kishidan 1); saytlarning taxminan yarmi ingliz tilida; TOP universitetlar; 'hozir bilish — imtiyoz, 10 yildan keyin bilmaslik — minus'. Raqamlar daftarga yoziladi.
Darajalar va vaqt
CEFR–IELTS jadvali (grammar.notes); noldan B2 gacha ~500–600 soat ustoz bilan dars + mustaqil ish; kuniga 1 soat ≈ 18 oy, 3 soat ≈ 6 oy (hisob — notes). 'Bu soatlarni kim qiladi?' — o'quvchi.
Qanday o'rganamiz
Kinestet/audial/vizual; 6 marta uchratish qoidasi; 'xato = yaxshi'; 1 kun praktika > 1 hafta nazariya. Velosiped misoli.
Coin, XP, Kahoot, normativ va kombinatsiya

Coin sovg'alari, XP ligalar ko'rsatiladi. Kombinatsiya/normativ ta'rifi — notes; bugun 1 aylana: ibora + tarjima + harakat. Keyingi dars boshida — O'tgan dars Kahooti (10 savol) + og'zaki normativ (CORE 20, 3 kishilik).
LUG'AT — Classroom vocabulary (CORE 20) + Simon says
Varaq tarqatiladi. Ustoz aytadi va harakat bilan ko'rsatadi → hamma 2 marta takrorlaydi → ustoz faqat harakatni ko'rsatadi, o'quvchi aytadi (12 daq). Keyin 4-mashq 'Simon says' (8 daq).
SINF MASHQLARI 1–3 (ZAXIRA: 5)
Majburiy: 1–3; ZAXIRA: 5. 1-mashq juftlikda (5 daq), 2-mashq yakka (4), 3-mashq mini-dialog (6). Sekin o'quvchi kuchli sherik bilan ishlaydi; tez tugatganga STRONG ro'yxat.
Sinf qoidalari, Telegram, uyga vazifa

Telegram guruh ochiladi, hamma qo'shiladi. MAJBURIY uyga vazifa (~35 daq): ovozli normativ CORE 20 (1:30, L02 gacha), ko'chirib yozish + tarjima, ibora–vaziyat. Kech qolish/telefon qoidasi 4-darsda kelishiladi.
Yakun
Bugungi 3 ta asosiy fikrni o'quvchilar o'zi aytadi: 'soatni men qilaman', 'xato — yaxshi', 'ishlatsam esda qoladi'.

intro: Bu darsda grammatika o'tilmaydi. Maqsad — o'quvchida to'g'ri tushuncha (mindset) hosil qilish. Suhbat pastdagi savol-javob ketma-ketligi bo'yicha boradi: ustoz savol beradi, o'quvchilar taxmin qiladi, keyin ustoz javobni aytadi va doskaga yozadi.
presentation: Nega ingliz tilini o'rganishimiz kerak? (hammadan so'raladi)
har xil javoblar — hammasi maqtaladi
Hozir dunyoda nechta odam ingliz tilida gaplashadi?
taxminan 1,5 milliard (ona tili va ikkinchi til sifatida birga) — dunyodagi har 5–6 kishidan 1 tasi
Internetdagi ma'lumotning nechi foizi ingliz tilida?
saytlarning taxminan yarmi (~50%) — bu boshqa har qanday tildan bir necha barobar ko'p
10 yildan keyin ingliz tilini bilmaslik nima bo'ladi?
minus (hozir bilish — imtiyoz)
IELTS 6.0 (B2) ga yetish uchun taxminan necha soat kerak?
Cambridge taxmini: noldan B2 gacha ~500–600 soat ustoz bilan dars; bunga mustaqil ish (uy vazifasi, o'qish, tinglash) qo'shiladi — umumiy soat bundan ancha ko'p
Shu soatlarni kim qilishi kerak — ustozmi, o'quvchimi?
o'quvchi
Kino ko'rish va musiqa tinglash ham shu soatlarga kiradimi?
kino — ha, inglizcha va subtitr bilan diqqat bilan ko'rilsa; musiqa — so'zlarini o'qib, faol tinglansa foydali, fon sifatida — foydasi kam
6.0 uchun nechta so'z bilish kerak? Bitta so'z esda qolishi uchun necha marta uchratish kerak?
taxminan 4000 ta (taxminiy raqam); kamida 6 marta — turli gaplarda
Eng zo'r usul qaysi — nazariya yoki praktika?
praktika — ishlatish
Xato qilsangiz bu yomonmi?
yo'q, yaxshi — demak o'rganyapman
notes: Suhbat monolog bo'lmasin: har 2–3 daqiqada savol bering va javobni kuting. O'quvchi raqamni o'zi aytsa, esida qoladi.
Raqamlarni doskaga KATTA yozing: ~1 500 000 000 / ~50% / 500–600 soat + mustaqil ish / ~4000 / 6. 'Taxminan' so'zini albatta ayting.
Kuchli o'quvchilarni ham, sekinlarini ham birinchi darsdayoq maqtang — bu darsning maqsadi qo'rquvni olib tashlash.

CEFR–IELTS (rasmiy moslik): A1–A2 — IELTS band 4.0 dan past (rasmiy moslik B1 dan boshlanadi); B1 ≈ 4.0–5.0, B2 ≈ 5.5–6.5, C1 ≈ 7.0–8.0, C2 ≈ 8.5–9.0. Diqqat: 'IELTS 1.0 / 2.0 / 3.0 / 4.0' — Jony Academy kurs nomlari (A1 → A2 → B1 → B1+), IELTS band balli emas.
Qancha soat (faqat ustoz bilan dars, ~550 soat): kuniga 1 soat ≈ 18 oy; kuniga 3 soat ≈ 6 oy. Mustaqil ish bunga qo'shiladi — shuning uchun 'soatni o'quvchi qiladi'.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Bugun (formulasiz dars) 1 aylana = ibora + tarjima + harakat: A: 'Stand up, please.' -> B: 'O'rningizdan turing, iltimos' deydi va turadi. Bugun coin yo'q; keyingi darslarda normativ: 1 daqiqada 3 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 4 aylana = 2 coin.

Normativ — vaqt va xato chegarasi oldindan aytilgan qisqa o'lchov topshirig'i; bajarilsa coin yoki XP beriladi. Bugungi normativ — ovozli (CORE 20, 1:30, L02 gacha); L02 boshida — og'zaki normativ (3 kishilik) va Kahoot.
Sekin o'quvchi: 1-mashqda avval 1–4-bandlarni bajaradi, 3-mashqda qatorlarni qutidan tayyor ko'chiradi, kuchli sherik bilan juftlanadi. Tez tugatgan — STRONG ro'yxatdan 3 ta ibora bilan gap aytadi.

how: Bu ro'yxat sinfda har kuni eshitiladigan iboralar. CORE 20 — har bir o'quvchi majburiy biladi (ustoz shu iboralarni faqat inglizcha aytadi). STRONG va SUPER — ixtiyoriy, kuchli o'quvchilar uchun (jamlanma: CORE+STRONG = 40, CORE+STRONG+SUPER = 60).
Usul: ustoz iborani aytadi va harakat bilan ko'rsatadi → hamma takrorlaydi → ustoz faqat harakatni ko'rsatadi, o'quvchi iborani aytadi.

lessons.title: TO BE + ADJECTIVE
lessons.grammar_topic: To be + adjective (am / is / are + sifat)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Level 1 (Unit 1, Exercise 1–3); Teacher's book: Lesson 2.
objectives: am / is / are ni egaga qarab to'g'ri tanlaydi (I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are).
'Subject + am/is/are + adjective' formulasida tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzadi.
Ismlar va so'z birikmalarini olmoshga moslashtiradi (my sister = she, Ali and Vali = they).
20 ta CORE sifatni tarjimasi bilan biladi va ular bilan o'zi, oilasi, do'sti haqida gap tuzadi.
'How are you?' savoliga kamida 5 xil javob beradi.
materials: Doska; formula jadvali (katta qilib doskaga yoki plakat).
Kahoot: L01 Classroom vocabulary (tizimda, 'O'tgan dars Kahooti').
CORE 20 sifat varag'i (vocab CORE ro'yxatidan chop etiladi: so'z, transkripsiya, tarjima, misol).
Mashq 5 uchun 'Find someone who…' jadvali (5-mashqdagi jadval) — chop eting yoki doskaga chizing, o'quvchi daftarga ko'chiradi.
timeline: Salomlashish — How are you?
Har o'quvchidan 'How are you?' so'raladi; aytilgan javob takrorlanmaydi. Doskada: I'm fine, thanks. / Not bad. / Great! / I'm OK. / I'm tired. / I'm hungry. / I'm happy.
KAHOOT — L01: Classroom vocabulary
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' — L01 banki, birinchi 10 savol; 1–3-o'rin 3/2/1 coin
OG'ZAKI NORMATIV — L01: Classroom vocabulary (CORE 20)
3 kishilik guruh, 3 daqiqa tayyorgarlik, 20 ibora + tarjima 2:00 da — 1 coin
YANGI MAVZU — to be + adjective
Kontekst: ustoz o'zi haqida aytadi (I am tired. I am not hungry. Are you tired?). Formula jadvali — savol-javob (presentation), CCQ bilan. Egani moslash: my sister → she, Ali and Vali → they.
LUG'AT — Common adjectives 1 (CORE 20)
Ustoz o'qiydi → jo'r takror (2 marta). Har so'zga o'quvchi o'zi haqida bitta gap tuzadi: 'I am busy'. Talaffuzga e'tibor: busy /ˈbɪzi/, hungry /ˈhʌŋɡri/.
KOMBINATSIYA — to be + adjective

Juftlikda: A ega + sifat aytadi, B tasdiq, inkor, savol + tarjima = 1 aylana. I — happy -> I am happy — Men xursandman -> I am not happy -> Am I happy? Warm-up 1 aylana; normativ 1 daqiqada 3 aylana — 1 coin, 4 — 2 coin.
SINF MASHQLARI 1–4
Majburiy: 1–4 (~21 daqiqa + tekshiruv). Ustoz aylanib xatoni darrov tuzatadi. Kuchsiz o'quvchi: 3-mashqda 1–6-gaplar, doskadagi formulaga qarab. Tez tugatgan: STRONG so'zlar bilan 3 gap.
Mashq 5 — Find someone who…
O'quvchilar turib bir-biridan 'Are you hungry?' deb so'raydi, ism yozadi. Oxirida 3–4 o'quvchi natijani aytadi: 'Dilnoza is tired'.
Uyga vazifa va coin
MAJBURIY (~40 daqiqa): ovozli normativ Common adjectives 1 (L03 gacha), 2–3-mashqlar, 'Mening oilam — 8 gap'. L03 boshida yozma normativ (CORE 20). Coinlar jurnalga yoziladi.

intro: TO BE — ingliz tilidagi eng asosiy fe'l. O'zbek tilida 'men aqlliMAN' desak, '-man' qo'shimchasi ishini inglizchada 'am' bajaradi. Shuning uchun formula: Ega + am/is/are + sifat.

Bu darsda gapda OT yo'q — faqat sifat, shuning uchun a/an ham yo'q: I am happy. a/an faqat birlikdagi OT bor bo'lsa keladi: a student (3-dars); ot oldida sifat bo'lsa, a/an sifatga qaraydi: an old teacher (4-dars).
formulas: I am clever. / She is busy. / They are tired.
Men aqlliman. / U band. / Ular charchagan.
I am not hungry. / He isn't rich. / We aren't sad.
Men och emasman. / U boy emas. / Biz xafa emasmiz.
Are you tired? / Is she happy? / Am I late?
I'm, you're, he's, she's, it's, we're, they're; isn't, aren't
I'm fine. She's clever. They aren't busy.
Men yaxshiman. U aqlli. Ular band emas.
presentation: Kontekst: ustoz aytadi 'I am tired. I am not hungry. Are you tired?' — Men nima dedim? Bugungi mavzu shu: to be + adjective.
Men charchaganman. Och emasman. Charchadingizmi?
Adjective so'zining tarjimasi?
Sifat
Formulasi qanaqa ekan?
Subject + am/is/are + adjective
Subject nima degani?
Ega
Birinchi misol: I'm clever — tarjimasi?
Men aqlliman
Bu gapda ega qaysi? I uchun am/is/are dan qaysi biri?
I; am
You uchun? He/she/it uchun? We/they uchun?
are; is; are
'My sister' — u he/she/it/they dan qaysi biri o'rnida? 'Ali and Vali'-chi?
she; they
CCQ: 'She is tired' — bitta odammi yoki ko'pmi? Hozirgi holatmi?
Bitta (qiz); ha, hozirgi holat
Negative form nima degani? Uni yasash uchun nima qo'shamiz va qayerga?
Inkor; not — am/is/are dan keyin
Question form nima degani? Savol tuzish uchun nimani nimadan oldinga chiqaramiz?
Savol; am/is/are ni egadan oldinga
Bu gapda a/an bormi: 'I am clever'? Nega yo'q?
Yo'q — gapda ot yo'q, clever — sifat. a/an faqat birlikdagi ot bo'lsa keladi: a student
notes: O'quvchi 'I am a happy' deb qo'ysa — darrov to'xtating: gapda ot yo'q, shuning uchun a/an ham yo'q. (Ot bo'lsa a/an keladi: I am a student — 3-dars.) Bu eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.
Egani moslashtirish jadvalini doskaga chizing: my mother → she, my father → he, my parents → they, my phone → it, you and I → we, Ali and Vali → they.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Namuna: I — happy -> I am happy — Men xursandman -> I am not happy — Men xursand emasman -> Am I happy? — Men xursandmanmi? Kuchli va kuchsiz o'quvchini juftlang; kuchsiz o'quvchi doskadagi formula jadvaliga qarab aytishi mumkin.

Yangi so'zlar bilan gap tuzdirganda o'quvchi faqat o'zi haqida emas, sinfdoshi haqida ham tuzsin: 'Aziz is tall' — shunda is ham mashq bo'ladi. Har mashqdan oldin ICQ: 'Nechta gap? Yakkami yoki juftlikdami?'
mistakes: Savolda to be egadan oldinga chiqadi.
Isn't he clever? / Is he clever?

how: Sifatlar uch darsga bo'lingan: Common adjectives 1 (shu dars), Common adjectives 2 (3-dars), Common adjectives 3 (14-dars). CORE 20 — kundalik eng oddiy sifatlar, 0 dan kelgan o'quvchi ham eplaydi; STRONG va SUPER — ixtiyoriy.
Har so'zni 3 qadamda bering: (1) ustoz aytadi, sinf takrorlaydi; (2) o'quvchi tarjimasini aytadi; (3) o'quvchi o'zi haqida gap tuzadi.
core: They are not rich, they are poor.

lessons.title: TO BE + NOUN (birlik va ko'plik)
lessons.grammar_topic: To be + a/an + noun (birlik); To be + noun-s (ko'plik)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Level 2–3 (Exercise 1–7); Teacher's book: Lesson 3. Kasb so'zlari (Jobs) to'liq 4-darsda o'tiladi — bu darsda grammatika uchun 12 ta eng oddiy kasb ishlatiladi.
objectives: 'Subject + am/is/are + a/an + noun' (birlik) va 'Subject + are + noun-s' (ko'plik) formulalarida gap tuzadi.
a va an farqini biladi: undosh tovush oldida a, unli tovush oldida an (a teacher, an engineer).
Ko'plikda a/an tushib qolishini va otga -s qo'shilishini biladi (We are doctors).
Inkor va savol shaklini to be qoidasi bilan yasaydi (He isn't a driver. Is she a nurse?).
Yangi 20 ta CORE sifat bilan 'to be + adjective' gaplarini takrorlaydi va yangi mavzu bilan aralashtirmaydi.
materials: Formula jadvali (birlik / ko'plik) — doskada ikki ustun.
Kasb kartalari (Jony varag'i) yoki doskadagi oddiy chizmalar — 12 kasb: teacher, doctor, student, engineer, driver, nurse, cook, farmer, singer, lawyer, waiter, pilot (4-mashqda ham ishlatiladi).
Yozma normativ varag'i — L02 CORE 20
CORE 20 'Common adjectives 2' varag'i (vocab CORE ro'yxatidan chop etiladi: so'z, transkripsiya, tarjima, misol).
Kahoot: L02 banki (tizimda, 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi).
timeline: Salomlashish
How are you? — har o'quvchi takrorlanmagan javob beradi. Kechikkanlar 'May I come in?' deb kiradi (classroom vocabulary ishlaydi).
KAHOOT — L02: to be + adjective, Common adjectives 1
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi — L02 kahoot banki, qisqa versiya: birinchi 10 savol (to be + adjective 5 + Adjectives 1 5), 15 soniyadan; 1–3-o'rin 3/2/1 coin.
YOZMA NORMATIV — L02: Common adjectives 1 (CORE 20)
O'zbekcha 20 so'z -> inglizcha, 5 daqiqa; 3 tagacha imlo xatosi (so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato) — 2 coin. Xato so'zlarni daftarga alohida yozib oladi.
Mindset: 'Xato nima?'
Doskaga: 'Ahmoq xatosidan saboq olmaydi, aqlli — o'z xatosidan, dono — boshqalar xatosidan saboq oladi.' O'quvchilar daftar muqovasiga yozadi. Xulosa: sinfda xato qilish — o'rganish yo'li.
YANGI MAVZU — to be + a/an + noun (birlik)
Kontekst: kasb kartalari (I am a teacher. She is a doctor. He is an engineer.). Formula — savol-javob (presentation). a/an — bosh TOVUSHga qarab: an hour, a university. CCQ bilan.
Kim 1 daqiqada eng ko'p gapni tasdiq–inkor–savol qilib aytsa — 1 coin (I am a student / I am not a student / Am I a student?).
YANGI MAVZU — ko'plik
Ikkinchi formula: are + noun-s; a/an yo'q: We are teachers. Farq 2 ta: (1) a/an yo'qoladi, (2) -s qo'shiladi. This is an apple / These are apples. CCQ: 'We are doctors' — bitta odammi?
LUG'AT — Common adjectives 2
Ustoz o'qiydi → takror; har so'zga bitta 'to be + adjective' gap. Kuchli o'quvchilar STRONG/SUPER varaqni oladi; kuchsiz o'quvchi qolip bilan: The ___ is ___.
SINF MASHQLARI 1–5
Majburiy: 1–4 (4+6+8+7 daqiqa, tekshiruv bilan); ZAXIRA: 5. Kuchsiz o'quvchi: 3-mashqda 1–5-gaplar, formula jadvaliga qarab. Mashq 4 — rolli o'yin (kasb kartalari).
KOMBINATSIYA + uyga vazifa
Juftlikda: I — teacher -> I am a teacher -> I am not a teacher -> Am I a teacher? (+ tarjima) = 1 aylana; normativ: 1 daqiqada 3 aylana — 1 coin, 4 — 2 coin. Uyga: majburiy qism (~40 daqiqa).

intro: O'tgan darsda to be dan keyin SIFAT qo'ydik (I am clever) — gapda ot yo'q edi, shuning uchun a/an ham yo'q edi. Bugun OT qo'yamiz (I am a teacher). Birlikdagi ot oldida a/an keladi — bu eng muhim farq.
a — undosh tovush bilan boshlangan ot oldida (a doctor, a university /juː/); an — unli tovush bilan boshlangan ot oldida (an engineer, an hour /aʊə/). Yozilishiga emas, O'QILISHIGA qarab!
Ko'plikda a/an yo'q, otga -s qo'shiladi va to be faqat 'are' bo'ladi: We are doctors. They are students.
formulas: I am a teacher. / He is an engineer.
I am not a doctor. / She isn't a nurse.
Men shifokor emasman. / U hamshira emas.
Are you a student? / Is he a driver?
We are doctors. / They are students.
This is an apple. These are apples.
presentation: O'tgan mavzumiz nima edi? Adjective tarjimasi?
To be + adjective; sifat
Kontekst: ustoz kasb kartalarini ko'rsatib aytadi: 'I am a teacher. She is a doctor. He is an engineer.' Bugungi mavzumiz? Noun nima degani?
To be + a/an + noun; ot
Formulada ot qayerda keldi? Misollardagi otlar qaysilar?
Oxirida; teacher, engineer, doctor, nurse, driver
Qaysi otlar oldida an, qaysilarida a turibdi? Nimaga qarab?
Unli tovush — an; undosh — a
Nega 'an engineer', lekin 'a university'?
Yozilishiga emas, o'qilishiga qaraymiz: engineer — unli tovush; university /juː/ — undosh tovush
O'tgan darsdagi gaplarda (I am happy) a/an bor edimi? Nega?
Yo'q — gapda ot yo'q edi; a/an faqat birlikdagi OT bor bo'lsa keladi
'Men muhandisman' — qanday bo'ladi? Ega qaysi, ot qaysi?
I am an engineer; I; engineer
Inkor uchun nimani qayerga qo'yamiz?
not — am/is/are dan keyin, otdan oldin
Savol uchun am/is/are ni nima qilamiz? 'Men muhandismanmi?'
Oldinga chiqaramiz; Am I an engineer?
CCQ: 'She is a nurse' — bitta odammi yoki ko'pmi? Uning ishi nima?
Bitta; hamshira
Ikkinchi formulada 'plural' degan so'z bor — nima degani?
Ko'plik
Ko'plikda to be ning qaysi shakli? Birlikda bor, ko'plikda yo'q narsa nima?
are; a/an
Ko'plikda otga nima qo'shiladi? 'Biz shifokorlarmiz'?
-s; We are doctors
CCQ: 'We are doctors' — bitta odammi yoki ko'pmi? Nega a yo'q?
Ko'p (biz); ko'plikda a/an yo'q, otga -s qo'shiladi
notes: a/an ni 'unli HARF' deb emas, 'unli TOVUSH' deb tushuntiring va darrov 3 misol bering: an hour, a university, a European. Bu 12-darsda yana qaytadi.
Ko'plikda o'quvchilar 'We are a doctors' deydi — a/an ni doskadan ochiq o'chirib ko'rsating.

Qisqa hikoya aytib bering (o'z so'zingiz bilan): bir o'quvchi mavzularni tez 'o'tib' ketdi, lekin mashq qilmadi — testda oddiy gaplarda ham xato qildi. Xulosa: 'mavzu o'tildi ≠ o'zlashtirildi', shuning uchun har formula kombinatsiya va normativ bilan mustahkamlanadi.
Kasblarni bugun to'liq yodlatmang — faqat 12 ta kasb kartasi bilan ishlang; to'liq Jobs ro'yxati 4-darsda.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Namuna (birlik): I — teacher -> I am a teacher — Men o'qituvchiman -> I am not a teacher — Men o'qituvchi emasman -> Am I a teacher? — Men o'qituvchimanmi? Ko'plik: we — doctor -> We are doctors -> We aren't doctors -> Are we doctors? Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ — 1 daqiqada 3 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 4 aylana = 2 coin. Kuchli va kuchsiz o'quvchini juftlang; kuchsiz o'quvchi doskadagi formula jadvaliga qarab aytishi mumkin.
Har mashqdan oldin ICQ: 'Nechta gap? Yakkami yoki juftlikdami? a/an qachon kerak emas?'
mistakes: Gapda ot yo'q (clever — sifat) — a/an yo'q (2-dars).
Tartib: to be + ega + a/an + ot.

how: Sifatlar uch darsga bo'lingan: Common adjectives 1 (2-dars), Common adjectives 2 (shu dars), Common adjectives 3 (14-dars). Grammatika bilan bog'lash: har so'zga 'to be + adjective' gap (o'tgan mavzu); 'a/an + adjective + noun' — 4-darsda.
Juft so'zlarni birga bering: warm–cool, open–closed, wet–dry, sweet–sour, polite–rude, safe–dangerous, late–early, near–far.

Ixtiyoriy, jamlanma: 40 ta (CORE + STRONG) — og'zaki 4 daqiqa (+1 coin), yozma 10 daqiqa (+2 coin); 60 ta (+ SUPER) — og'zaki 6 daqiqa (+2 coin), yozma 15 daqiqa (+3 coin).

intro: Uchinchi formula avvalgi ikkitasini birlashtiradi: to be + a/an + SIFAT + OT. O'zbekchada 'men aqlli talabaMAN' — inglizchada 'I am a clever student'.

Muhim: a/an — birlikdagi OT uchun; ot oldida sifat bo'lsa, a/an sifat oldida turadi va sifatning bosh tovushiga qarab tanlanadi (a/an o'zidan keyingi birinchi so'zga qaraydi): a clever student (undosh), an old teacher (unli), an honest man (/ˈɒnɪst/ — h o'qilmaydi!). Gapda ot bo'lmasa — a/an yo'q: She is kind (2-dars).
Ko'plikda: are + sifat + ot-s. Sifat hech qachon -s olmaydi: kind doctors (kinds doctors — XATO).

presentation: O'tgan mavzu? Nechta shakli bor edi? Birlik formulasi?

Kontekst: ustoz hamshira rasmini ko'rsatadi — 'She is a nurse. She is kind.' Ikki gapni bitta gap qiling.

Bugungi mavzu? Oldingi formuladan farqi — a/an bilan ot orasiga nima qo'shildi?

Yo'q; yo'q — faqat otga

notes: Doskada uch formulani ustma-ust yozing va faqat farqni rangli marker bilan belgilang — o'quvchi 'yangi narsa oz' ekanini ko'rsin.
Egani moslash jadvalini doskada yana takrorlang: your sister → she, my dog → it, you and I → we, my parents → they (4-mashq).
Kasblarda -er/-or/-ist qo'shimchalarini ko'rsating: teach → teacher, act → actor, art → artist — so'zni eslab qolish osonlashadi.

Sinf qoidalarini o'quvchilar bilan kelishib oling — buyruq emas, shartnoma: (1) kechikkan o'quvchi 'Sorry, I'm late. May I come in?' deydi va doskaga 3 ta yangi so'z (tarjimasi bilan) yozadi; (2) telefonlar dars boshida qutiga (mas'ul o'quvchi yig'adi); (3) doska mas'uli — navbat bilan; (4) darsni qoldirgan o'quvchi mavzuni o'zi o'rganib keladi; (5) Progress test 1 — 7-dars boshida (L01–L06, 35 daqiqa), o'tish >=70%; past natija — 7 kun ichida qayta topshirish va qo'shimcha dars (guruhdan chiqarilmaydi). Qoidalarni plakatga yozib iling.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Bu darsda 3 formula navbat bilan: 1) sifat, 2) ot, 3) sifat + ot. Namuna (3-formula): She — kind nurse -> She is a kind nurse — U mehribon hamshira -> She isn't a kind nurse — U mehribon hamshira emas -> Is she a kind nurse? — U mehribon hamshirami? Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ — 1.5 daqiqada 2 aylana = 1 coin, 3 aylana = 2 coin. Kuchli va kuchsiz o'quvchini juftlang. Har mashqdan oldin ICQ: 'Nechta gap? Yakkami yoki juftlikdami?'

lessons.title: TO BE + PREPOSITION + PLACE
lessons.grammar_topic: To be + in / on / at / from + place (joy)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Level 6 (Exercise 5–6, prepozitsiyalar), Places ro'yxati; Teacher's book: Lesson 5 (in/on/at farqi, on holiday / on business).
objectives: 'Subject + am/is/are + in/on/at + place' formulasida tasdiq, inkor, savol tuzadi (I am at home).

in / on / at farqini asosiy qoida bilan biladi: in — chegara ichida (xona, park, shahar, davlat), on — yuzada (stol, devor), at — nuqta/manzil (uy, maktab, ish, bekat); bino bilan at ham, in ham to'g'ri.
'Where are you?' va 'Where are you from?' savollarini beradi va javob beradi.
20 ta CORE joy nomini biladi va har biri bilan qaysi predlog kelishini aytadi (at school, in the park, at the bus stop).
on holiday / on business / at work iboralarini ishlatadi.
materials: Doskada 3 ustunli jadval: IN / ON / AT (misollar bilan).
Yozma normativ varag'i — L04 CORE 20
Kahoot: L04 banki (tizimda, 'O'tgan dars Kahooti').
Places CORE 20 varag'i (vocab CORE ro'yxatidan chop etiladi: so'z, transkripsiya, tarjima, misol).
Mashq 5 uchun shahar xaritasi chizmasi (doskaga oddiy chizma: bank, park, school, hospital…).
IXTIYORIY (darsga kirmaydi): Navigate A1 Unit 1 videosi — bo'lsa, uyga tavsiya qilinadi.
timeline: Salomlashish + Where are you from?
Salomlashish (How are you?). Yangi savol kiritiladi: 'Where are you from?' — 'I'm from Bekobod.' Hammadan so'raladi.
KAHOOT — L04: to be + adjective + noun, Jobs
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi — L04 kahoot banki, qisqa versiya: birinchi 10 savol, 15 soniyadan; 1–3-o'rin 3/2/1 coin.
YOZMA NORMATIV — L04: Jobs (CORE 20)
O'zbekcha 20 so'z -> inglizcha, 5 daqiqa; 3 tagacha imlo xatosi (so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato) — 2 coin.
Mindset: 'qoshiqlab yeymiz'
To be 5 darsga bo'lib o'tildi: bir qozon oshni bir yo'la emas, qoshiqlab yeymiz. Har darsda bitta kichik qadam, lekin to'liq. Chala qolgan qadam keyingisini ham buzadi.
YANGI MAVZU — to be + in/on/at/from + joy
Kontekst: ustoz aytadi — I am at school. My father is at work. The keys are in my bag. From — preposition. IN/ON/AT jadvali + CCQ; eslatma: bino bilan at/in ikkalasi ham (at/in the shop).
LUG'AT — Places (CORE 20)
Har joy predlogi bilan: at school, at home, in the park, at the bus stop. Ustoz aytadi -> jo'r takror; o'quvchi: 'I am at …' / 'My mother is in …'. Where is …? savoli.
on holiday / on business / at work
Uchta ibora doskaga: I am on holiday (dam olishda), on business (xizmat safarida), at work (ishda). Har o'quvchi bittasi bilan gap tuzadi.
KOMBINATSIYA

Juftlikda: A ega + joy aytadi, B tasdiq, inkor, savol + tarjima = 1 aylana. I — at school -> I am at school -> I am not at school -> Am I at school? Warm-up 1 aylana; normativ 1 daqiqada 3 aylana — 1 coin, 4 — 2 coin.
SINF MASHQLARI 1–5
Majburiy: 1–5 (4 + 7 + 5 + 4 + 5 daqiqa). Har mashqdan oldin ICQ: 'Nechta gap? Yakkami yoki juftlikda?' Kuchsiz o'quvchi: 3-mashqda 1–5-bandlar, doskadagi qolipga qarab.

MAJBURIY (~40 daqiqa): ovozli normativ Places (L06 gacha), 2-mashq (AT/IN/ON, 12 so'z), 3-mashq (inkor va savol, 6 gap), 'Mening oilam hozir qayerda? — 8 gap'. L06 boshida yozma normativ Places.

intro: Beshinchi va oxirgi 'to be' formulasi: to be + PREDLOG + JOY (1 — sifat, 2 — a/an + ot, 3 — ot-s, 4 — a/an + sifat + ot, 5 — predlog + joy). O'zbekchada '-da' qo'shimchasi (uyDA, maktabDA) — inglizchada in / on / at.

IN — biror chegara ichida: in the box, in the room, in the park, in Tashkent (shahar/davlat ham 'ichida'). ON — yuzada, ustida: on the table, on the wall, on the beach. AT — nuqta, 'manzil': at home, at school, at work, at the bus stop, at the door. Bino/muassasa bilan at ham, in ham to'g'ri: at/in the shop, at/in the library (at — manzil sifatida, in — bino ichida ekani ta'kidlansa).
Boshqa predloglar (under, behind, next to, between…) 6-darsda alohida lug'at bo'lib o'tiladi; bu darsda ular faqat tanishtiriladi.
FROM — '-dan': I am from Bekobod. Savol: Where are you from? (where = qayer/qayerda — o'zi predlogsiz keladi: Where are you? — Qayerdasan?).

lessons.title: TO BE (PRESENT) — BOSS LEVEL + this/that/these/those + my/your
lessons.grammar_topic: To be (hozirgi zamon) — 5 formula birgalikda, savol so'zlari, qisqa javoblar; mini-blok: this/that/these/those + my/your
lessons.book_ref: Ixtiyoriy: Student's book — BOSS LEVEL jadvali (to be present), Exercise 7 (to be summary); Teacher's book: Lesson 6.
objectives: To be ning 5 formulasini bitta jadvalda ko'radi va istalgan formulada tez gap tuzadi.
What / Where / Who / How old savol so'zlari bilan to be savolini tuzadi va qisqa javob beradi (Yes, I am / No, he isn't).
CORE 20 o'rin predlogini biladi (sinfda 12 tasi real buyum bilan) va narsalar qayerdaligini aytadi (The cat is under the table).
Birinchi marta ingliz tilida qisqa matn o'qib, T/F savollariga javob beradi.
Progress test 1 (7-dars boshida) ga tayyor: 5 formula, predloglar, this/that + my/your va 100 ta CORE so'z (L02–L06: adjectives 1–2, jobs, places, prepositions).
this/that (birlik) va these/those (ko'plik) bilan yaqin/uzoq narsani ko'rsatadi.
'This is my… / These are your…' qolipida my/your ni ot bilan ishlatadi (his/her/our/their — ZAXIRA mashqda va uyga vazifada).
materials: BOSS jadvali (5 formula — grammar.formulas dagi 1–5) — doskaga yoziladi yoki plakat.
Predloglar uchun buyumlar: quti, ruchka, kitob, o'yinchoq (mushuk/it) — real narsalar bilan ko'rsatish.
Reading matni chop etilgan (har o'quvchiga).
Yozma normativ varag'i — L05 CORE 20. Progress test 1 varag'i (tizimdagi pt1) 7-darsda beriladi — bugun faqat brifing.
timeline: Salomlashish
How are you? / Where are you from? / Where is your mother now? — uch savol aylanma, har o'quvchi javob beradi.
KAHOOT — L05: to be + in/on/at/from + joy, Places
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi — L05 kahoot banki, qisqa versiya: birinchi 10 savol, 15 soniyadan; 1–3-o'rin 3/2/1 coin.
YOZMA NORMATIV — L05: Places (CORE 20)
O'zbekcha 20 so'z -> inglizcha, 5 daqiqa; 3 tagacha imlo xatosi (so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato) — 2 coin.
BOSS LEVEL — 5 formula
Savol-javob bilan BOSS jadvali doskaga: 1 sifat, 2 a/an + ot, 3 ot-s, 4 sifat + ot, 5 in/on/at/from + joy. Har formulaga +, –, ?. Qisqa javob: Yes, I am. / No, she isn't.
Savol so'zlari
What is your name? Where are you from? Who is he? How old are you? — 4 savol doskada; juftlikda so'rab-javob beriladi, keyin sherik almashadi.
LUG'AT — Prepositions of place (CORE 20; sinfda 12 tasi)
Real buyumlar: in, on, at, under, above, behind, in front of, next to, between, near, opposite, in the middle of. O'quvchi buyumni qo'yadi, sinf gap aytadi.
BOSS KOMBINATSIYA

A ega + kasb, B 5 formulada tasdiq gap + tarjima = 1 aylana. Namuna: he — doctor -> He is kind. He is a doctor. They are doctors. He is a kind doctor. He is at the hospital. 1.5 daq: 2 aylana — 1 coin, 3 — 2 coin.
SINF MASHQLARI 1–4 (ZAXIRA: 5–6)
Majburiy: 1–4; ZAXIRA: 5–6. 1 yakka (5), 2 juftlikda og'zaki (4), 3 doskadagi chizma bo'yicha (6), 4 yakka (6), tekshiruv (3). Kuchsizga: jadvalga qarab, har mashqda 5 band.
MINI-BLOK — This is my… / These are your…
Real buyumlar: This is my pen. These are your books. That is my bag. CCQ: 'that' — yaqinmi, uzoqmi? 'these' — bittami, ko'pmi? his/her/our — ZAXIRA (6-mashq).
READING — My family at home
Ustoz 1 marta o'qiydi, keyin o'quvchilar juftlikda navbat bilan o'qiydi. 1-topshiriq (T/F) va 2-topshiriq (savollar) sinfda; 3-topshiriq — ZAXIRA.
Progress test 1 haqida + uyga vazifa
Keyingi dars boshida 35 daqiqa: grammatika 50 (5 formula, predloglar, this/that + my/your), lug'at 40 (L02–L06 CORE), reading 10. O'tish >=70%; past natija — qayta topshirish, guruhdan chiqarilmaydi.

intro: BOSS LEVEL — yangi mavzu yo'q. 5 ta formula bitta jadvalda: 1) to be + adjective; 2) to be + a/an + noun (birlik); 3) to be + noun-s (ko'plik); 4) to be + a/an + adj + noun / adj + noun-s; 5) to be + in/on/at/from + place. Maqsad — o'quvchi o'ylanmasdan to'g'ri shaklni tanlashi.
Yangi qo'shiladigan kichik narsalar: savol so'zlari (What, Where, Who, How old) va qisqa javoblar (Yes, I am. No, I'm not. Yes, she is. No, they aren't).

MINI-BLOK 1 — KO'RSATISH: this (bu — yaqin, birlik), that (anavi — uzoq, birlik), these (bular — yaqin, ko'plik), those (anavilar — uzoq, ko'plik). This is a pen. That is a board. These are books. Those are windows.

MINI-BLOK 2 — EGALIK SIFATLARI (doim OT bilan): darsda faqat my (mening) va your (sening/sizning): This is my pen. These are your books. ZAXIRA (6-mashq, vaqt qolsa): his (uning — o'g'il), her (uning — qiz), our (bizning), their (ularning).
Ikkala mini-blok to be bilan ishlaydi: This is my pen. These are your books. Is that your teacher? — Yes, he is.

notes: Bu dars — Progress test 1 dan oldingi mustahkamlash. Yangi narsani ko'p bermang: predloglar, savol so'zlari va 'This is my… / These are your…' qolipi yetarli. Har mashqdan oldin ICQ: 'Nechta band? Yakkami yoki juftlikdami?'. Kuchsiz o'quvchi doskadagi BOSS jadvaliga qarab ishlaydi va har mashqda birinchi 5 bandni bajaradi.
Qisqa javobda qisqartma bo'lmaydi: 'Yes, I'm' — XATO; 'Yes, I am' — to'g'ri. Inkorda qisqartma bo'ladi: 'No, I'm not'.
Reading matnini avval ustoz o'qisin (talaffuz namunasi), keyin o'quvchilar juftlikda navbat bilan. Tarjimani so'zma-so'z emas, ma'no bilan so'rang.

Testga tayyorgarlik: Progress test 1 (7-dars boshida, 35 daqiqa) — grammatika 50 (am/is/are + a/an; inkor va savolga aylantirish; chizma bo'yicha predloglar; this/that + my/your), lug'at 40 (L02–L06 CORE: o'zbekcha -> inglizcha, moslashtirish, antonimlar), reading 10 (True/False). Shu turlarni uyga 'Test namunasi' va sinf mashqlari orqali bir marta ko'rsating.

MINI-BLOK (this/that, my/your) — 6 daqiqa, chuqur emas: 22-darsda (possessives) va 23-darsda (determiners) to'liq qaytiladi. Hozir bola 'This is my pen', 'Is that your teacher?' desa yetadi. CCQ: 'That is a board' — doska yaqinmi yoki uzoqmi? (uzoq) Bittami yoki ko'pmi? (bitta)

BOSS KOMBINATSIYA: Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha gap tuzib, o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi. Bugun 1 aylana = 5 formulada tasdiq gap. Namuna: A: he — doctor -> B: He is kind — U mehribon. He is a doctor — U shifokor. They are doctors — Ular shifokorlar. He is a kind doctor — U mehribon shifokor. He is at the hospital — U shifoxonada. Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ — 1.5 daqiqada 2 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 3 aylana = 2 coin. Juftlikka kuchli va kuchsiz o'quvchini qo'ying.

how: Predloglarni real buyum bilan ko'rsating (quti, ruchka, kitob) — bu darsning eng qiziq qismi. Sinfda CORE 20 dan 12 tasi: in, on, at, under, above, behind, in front of, next to, between, near, opposite, in the middle of. Qolgan 8 tasi (below, beside, far from, inside, outside, among, on the left, on the right) — varaqdan birga o'qiladi va ovozli normativda. Har predlogga 'The … is … the …' gap.

reading.title: My family at home
text: My name is Nilufar. I am fourteen and I am a student. I am from Bekobod. Now I am at home with my family. Our house is big and clean. It is near the park.
My father is an engineer. He is at work now. My mother is a nurse. She isn't at the hospital today — she is in the kitchen. She is a very good cook!

My brother Aziz is ten. He is a funny boy. He is in the garden behind the house. His football is under the tree. My grandparents are old but they are healthy. They are in the living room. The TV is in front of them.
Our cat Mimi is small and lazy. Where is she? She is on the sofa, between my grandfather and my grandmother. We are a happy family!

lessons.title: PRESENT CONTINUOUS
lessons.grammar_topic: Present continuous — hozirgi davomiy zamon (am/is/are + verb-ing)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Unit 2 — Present continuous (uyga, IXTIYORIY); Reading Topic 10–12 (IXTIYORIY); Teacher's book: Lesson 9.
objectives: 'Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing' formulasida hozir bo'layotgan ish-harakatni aytadi (I am sleeping).
-ing qo'shish qoidalarini biladi: play → playing, write → writing (e tushadi), swim → swimming (undosh ikkilanadi), lie → lying (-ie → -y).
Inkor va savol shaklini to be qoidasi bilan yasaydi; Wh-savollar (What are you doing?) tuzadi.
now, at the moment, right now, Look! Listen! belgi so'zlarini ishlatadi.
20 ta CORE fe'lni biladi; harakat fe'llari bilan 'hozir nima qilyapman' gapini tuzadi, holat fe'llariga (know, want, like) -ing qo'shmaydi.
materials: TEST pt1 varaqlari (har o'quvchiga) + kalit (ustozda)
Formula jadvali (+ / – / ?) va -ing qoidalari plakati (4 qoida + w/x/y istisnosi; holat fe'llari ro'yxati).
Harakat rasmlari yoki mime kartalari — CORE ro'yxatidagi harakat fe'llari (vocab ro'yxatidan chop etiladi yoki kartochkaga yoziladi).
Listening: skript (Listening bo'limi, transcript — ustoz o'qiydi); Reading matni — uyga (tizimda).
timeline: Salomlashish + test yo'riqnomasi
Davomat. Test qoidalari: telefonlar yig'iladi, 35 daqiqa, ism-familiya varaqqa, bo'limlar tartibi: grammatika -> lug'at -> reading.
TEST — Progress test 1 (L01–L06)
Varaq: tizimdagi pt1 (har o'quvchiga), kalit ustozda. Grammatika 50 / Lug'at 40 / Reading 10. Telefonlar yig'iladi. Natija va tahlil — 8-darsda.
Tanaffus
Varaqlar yig'iladi. Ustoz doskaga formula jadvali (+ / – / ?) va -ing qoidalari ustunlarini yozadi.
YANGI MAVZU — Present continuous
Kontekst: ustoz kitob o'qiydi — 'What am I doing?' — 'You are reading.' Formula +/–/?, Wh-savol, qisqa javob; -ing imlosi (4 qoida); holat fe'llari -ing olmaydi; CCQ.
LUG'AT — Common verbs 1 (CORE 20, TPR)
Ustoz fe'lni aytadi, o'quvchi harakat qiladi; keyin o'quvchi harakat qiladi, sinf aytadi: 'He is drinking!'. Holat fe'llari (know, want, like) — -ing siz: I know.
KOMBINATSIYA — Present continuous
Juftlikda, 1 aylana: I — read -> I am reading — Men o'qiyapman -> I am not reading — Men o'qimayapman -> Am I reading? — Men o'qiyapmanmi? Normativ: 1 daqiqada 3 aylana — 1 coin, 4 — 2 coin.
SINF MASHQLARI 1–3 (ZAXIRA: 4–5)
Majburiy: 1–3 (~13 daqiqa + tekshiruv); ZAXIRA: 4–5. Kuchsiz o'quvchi: 2-mashqda 1–6-gaplar, doskadagi formulaga qarab; 3-mashqda kuchli + kuchsiz juftlik.
LISTENING — skript (ustoz o'qiydi)
Ustoz skriptni 2 marta o'qiydi (ism harflab aytiladi). 1-marta — 1-topshiriq (kim nima qilyapti), 2-marta — True/False; javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Uyga vazifa
MAJBURIY: ovozli normativ Common verbs 1 (L08 gacha), 2–3-mashqlar, Reading 'Sunday afternoon at our house'. L08 boshida yozma normativ (CORE 20).
Yakun
Har o'quvchi bitta gap: 'Now I am …-ing' — sinf tarjima qiladi. Test natijasi — 8-darsda.

intro: Bugundan ZAMONLAR boshlanadi. Birinchi zamon — Present Continuous: HOZIR bo'layotgan ish. Formula: ega + am/is/are + fe'l + ing. Ya'ni to be ning hozirgi shakli + fe'l-ing.
O'zbekchada '-yapman / -yapti': I am sleeping — uxlayapman; It is raining — yomg'ir yog'yapti.

-ING qoidalari: (1) oddiy: play → playing, read → reading; (2) fe'l -e bilan tugasa e tushadi: write → writing, make → making, come → coming; (3) qisqa (bir bo'g'inli) fe'l 'undosh+unli+undosh' bilan tugasa oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: swim → swimming, run → running, sit → sitting, stop → stopping — lekin w, x, y ikkilanmaydi: snow → snowing, fix → fixing, play → playing; (4) -ie → -ying: lie → lying, die → dying. Ikki bo'g'inli fe'lda urg'u oxirgi bo'g'inda bo'lsa ikkilanadi (begin → beginning), aks holda yo'q (open → opening, visit → visiting).
Belgi so'zlar: now, at the moment, right now, today (hozirgi vaziyat), Look! Listen! (hozir bo'layotgan narsaga e'tibor).
formulas: I am sleeping. You are playing. He is reading. It is raining.
Men uxlayapman. Sen o'ynayapsan. U o'qiyapti. Yomg'ir yog'yapti.
I am not sleeping. She isn't working. They aren't listening.
Men uxlamayapman. U ishlamayapti. Ular eshitmayapti.
Are you studying now? Is it raining? Are they coming?
Hozir o'qiyapsanmi? Yomg'ir yog'yaptimi? Ular kelyaptimi?
What are you doing? Where is she going? Why are they crying?
Nima qilyapsan? U qayerga ketyapti? Ular nega yig'layapti?
Yes, S + am/is/are. / No, S + am/is/are + not.
Is he working? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.

e tushadi; oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi (w, x, y — ikkilanmaydi); -ie → -y
presentation: (Ustoz kitob o'qib turadi) What am I doing? Men hozir nima qilyapman?

Inkor uchun nima qilamiz? 'Men o'ynamayapman'?
To be dan keyin not; I am not playing

To be oldinga; Are you reading?

write ga -ing qo'shsak? swim ga-chi? Nega?
writing (e tushadi); swimming (undosh ikkilanadi)
'Men javobni bilaman' — I am knowing the answer?
Yo'q: I know the answer. know, want, like, need, see, hear, have (ega) -ing olmaydi
notes: Bu darsda ikkita yangi narsa bor: FE'L va -ING. To be qismi o'quvchiga tanish — shuni ta'kidlang: 'yangi narsa oz'.
-ing qoidasini doskada 3 ustunda qoldiring; har yangi fe'lni o'quvchi o'zi ustunga joylasin.

'Now I am go to school' — eng ko'p xato: fe'lga -ing qo'shilmaydi. 'I going' — to be tushadi. Ikkalasini ochiq ko'rsating. CCQ: 'He is reading' — hozirmi yoki har kunmi? (hozir) Tugadimi? (yo'q). ICQ har mashq oldidan: 'Yakkami, juftlikdami? Nechta gap?'
Present continuous ni odatiy ish uchun ishlatmang (I am go to school every day — XATO) — bu 9-darsda Present simple bilan solishtiriladi.
Holat fe'llari odatda -ing olmaydi: know, want, like, need, see, hear, have (ega bo'lmoq). I know the answer (I am knowing — XATO). have 'yemoq' ma'nosida -ing oladi: We are having lunch.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q.

Progress test 1 (pt1, L01–L06) — dars boshida 35 daqiqa; varaq va kalit tizimda. O'tish: >=70/100. 50–69 — xatolar varag'i va 7 kun ichida 70% dan past bo'limlarni qayta topshirish; <50 — ota-onaga xabar, 1 qo'shimcha mashg'ulot, 7 kun ichida to'liq qayta topshirish. Guruhdan chiqarilmaydi. Tahlil — 8-darsda.
mistakes: I am going to school now.

how: Fe'llar 4 darsga bo'lingan: Common verbs 1–4 — 7, 11, 18, 19-darslar. Bu darsda — eng ko'p ishlatiladigan 20 ta CORE fe'l. Fe'llarni HARAKAT bilan bering (TPR): o'quvchi 'drink' deganda ichish harakatini qiladi.

Bugun harakat fe'llariga darhol -ing qo'shiladi (Present continuous): I am eating. Holat fe'llari (be, have — ega bo'lmoq, see, know, want, like; STRONG: need, hear) -ing olmaydi — ro'yxatda ularni belgilab qo'ying.
core: I want to be a doctor.
super: Put the book on the table.
normativ: Ovozli (Telegram, L08 gacha): CORE 20 fe'l — har biri + o'z gapi + tarjima, 2 daqiqa; harakat fe'llari -ing bilan (I am eating), holat fe'llari -ing siz (I know) — 1 coin ('ovozli_normativ' cheki: 3 band).
Yozma (L08 boshida): CORE 20 fe'l o'zbekcha beriladi, 5 daqiqada inglizchasini yozish; 3 tagacha imlo xatosi (so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato) — 2 coin.
Ixtiyoriy, jamlanma: 40 ta (CORE + STRONG) — yozma 10 daqiqa (+2 coin); 60 ta (+ SUPER) — yozma 15 daqiqa (+3 coin).

class_ex.title: Progress test 1 (L01–L06): ustoz uchun o'tkazish tartibi va ball jadvali
class_ex.instr: Test 7-dars boshida, salomlashishdan (3 daqiqa) keyin yoziladi: 35 daqiqa, yakka, qog'ozda. Grammatika 50 + Lug'at 40 + Reading 10 = 100 ball. Tahlil — 8-darsdagi 'TEST TAHLILI' bosqichida.
items: 1. Darsdan oldin: har o'quvchiga 1 ta o'quvchi varag'ini chop eting (3–10-bo'limlar: savollar, C chizmasi va Reading matni — javoblarsiz) + 2–3 ta zaxira. Kalit (shu bo'limlarning javoblari) va ball varag'i faqat ustozda.
2. Salomlashishdan keyin telefonlar yig'iladi; partada faqat ruchka. Varaqlar yuzini pastga qilib tarqatiladi; o'quvchi ism-familiya, guruh va sanani yozadi.
3. Proyektorga faqat taymer (35:00) va bo'lim vaqtlari chiqariladi: Grammatika 15 · Lug'at 12 · Reading 8 daqiqa. Savollar va kalit proyektorga CHIQARILMAYDI.
4. 'Start' deb taymerni yoqing. 15-daqiqada 'Lug'at bo'limiga o'ting', 27-daqiqada 'Readingga o'ting', 32-daqiqada '3 daqiqa qoldi' deng. Erta tugatgan o'quvchi keyingi bo'limga o'tishi mumkin.
5. Test paytida javob tushuntirilmaydi va so'z tarjima qilinmaydi — faqat topshiriq sharti (instr) o'zbekcha qayta o'qib beriladi. Ko'chirilgan javob — 0 ball.
6. 35-daqiqada varaqlar yig'iladi. Shu darsda kalit ko'rsatilmaydi va tahlil qilinmaydi — natija va xatolar 8-darsdagi 'TEST TAHLILI' (7 daqiqa) bosqichida ko'riladi.

7. Tekshirish (8-darsgacha), har band uchun kalitdagi BARCHA to'g'ri variantlar qabul qilinadi. Grammatika A: to be to'g'ri — 1 ball, a/an (yoki X) to'g'ri — 1 ball. B: inkor — 1, savol — 1 (to'liq va qisqartma shakl — bir xil ball; so'z tartibi xato — 0; faqat '?' tushib qolsa — ball kesilmaydi). C: to'g'ri predlog — 2 ball ('next' o'zi yozilsa — 1). D: har bo'shliq — 1 ball (bosh harf xatosi ballni kesmaydi).

8. Lug'at A: to'g'ri — 1; bitta harf imlo xatosi — 0.5; boshqa so'z yoki 2+ xato — 0. B: to'g'ri harf yoki to'g'ri so'z — 1. C: to'g'ri — 1; bitta harf imlo xatosi — 0.5. Reading: har to'g'ri T/F — 2 ball (T/F, True/False, Yes/No — hammasi qabul).

9. Natija tizimga bo'limlar kesimida kiritiladi: Grammatika (50), Lug'at (40), Reading (10) + jami (100). 70% chegarasi: Grammatika 35, Lug'at 28, Reading 7 (Reading ballari 2 tadan: 8 va 10 — yetarli, 6 va past — 70% dan past).

10. Qayta topshirish: faqat 70% dan past bo'lim(lar), shu bo'lim vaqtida (15 / 12 / 8 daqiqa), format, band soni va ball o'zgarmaydi. Kalit tahlilda ko'rilgani uchun ustoz bandlardagi ega va otlarni almashtiradi (masalan, 'I ___ student.' -> 'You ___ doctor.'; Lug'at A — shu darslar CORE ro'yxatidan boshqa 20 so'z; Reading — ismlar va joylar almashtiriladi, T/F javoblari qayta tuziladi).
answers: 70–100: O'TDI -> 8-darsdan davom etadi. 70% dan past bo'limi bo'lsa — shu bo'lim bo'yicha uyga 1 ta qo'shimcha mashq (qayta topshirish shart emas).
50–69: xatolar varag'i (har xato -> to'g'ri shakl + o'z gapi) keyingi darsgacha to'ldiriladi -> 7 kun ichida FAQAT 70% dan past bo'lim(lar) qayta topshiriladi.
0–49: ota-onaga xabar (shu hafta ichida) -> 1 ta qo'shimcha (remedial) mashg'ulot, zaif bo'limlar bo'yicha -> 7 kun ichida to'liq test qayta topshiriladi.
Qayta topshirishda ham jami <50: rahbar bilan suhbat — takror guruh taklif qilinadi. Guruhdan chiqarish yo'q.
Misol 2: Grammatika 30 · Lug'at 29 · Reading 6 = 65 -> xatolar varag'i + Grammatika (30 < 35) va Reading (6 < 7) 7 kun ichida qayta topshiriladi; Lug'at (29 >= 28) qayta yozilmaydi.
Misol 3: Grammatika 22 · Lug'at 18 · Reading 4 = 44 -> ota-onaga xabar, 1 remedial mashg'ulot, so'ng 7 kun ichida to'liq qayta topshirish.

class_ex.title: Grammatika B — inkor va savol, 5 formula (5 × 2 = 10 ball)
class_ex.instr: Write each sentence in the negative (–) and as a question (?). (Har gapni inkor (–) va savol (?) shaklida yozing.)
items: 5. Your friends are in the park.
answers: 1. (–) I am not late. / I'm not late.  (?) Am I late?
2. (–) She is not a nurse. / She isn't a nurse. / She's not a nurse.  (?) Is she a nurse?
3. (–) We are not students. / We aren't students. / We're not students.  (?) Are we students?
4. (–) He is not a clever businessman. / He isn't a clever businessman. / He's not a clever businessman.  (?) Is he a clever businessman?
5. (–) Your friends are not in the park. / Your friends aren't in the park.  (?) Are your friends in the park?
why: 1-formula: S + am/is/are + sifat. 'I amn't' — XATO (inkor qismi 0).
2-formula: S + is + a/an + ot (birlik); a tushib qolsa — shu qism 0.
3-formula: S + are + ot-s (ko'plik) — a/an YO'Q ('We are a students' — XATO).
4-formula: S + is + a/an + sifat + ot; sifat otdan OLDIN.
5-formula: S + are + in/on/at + joy; savolda are egadan oldinga chiqadi ('Your friends are in the park?' — savol emas, 0).
class_ex.note: Har band — bitta formula (L06 BOSS jadvali raqamlari bilan). Inkor — 1 ball, savol — 1 ball. To'liq va qisqartma shakl bir xil baholanadi.

class_ex.instr: Read the text "My house and my street". Write T (true) or F (false). (Matnni o'qing. Gap matnga mos bo'lsa T, mos bo'lmasa F yozing.)
box: Hi! My name is Jasur. I am twelve. My house is small and new. It is next to a mosque and opposite the market. The bus stop is near my house. My uncle is a farmer. He is in front of the house with a big dog. My sister is a student. She is on the balcony with a book. My grandfather is not at home. He is at the bus stop. Is your house near a market?
Glossary: uncle — amaki, tog'a · balcony — balkon · with — bilan
items: 1. The house is big and old.
2. The market is opposite the house.
3. The farmer is in front of the house.
4. The dog is on the balcony.
5. The grandfather is near the house.
why: "My house is small and new" — big/old emas (antonimlar).
"It is ... opposite the market" — uy bozor ro'parasida bo'lsa, bozor ham uy ro'parasida.
"My uncle is a farmer. He is in front of the house" — farmer = amaki.
"He is in front of the house with a big dog" — it amaki bilan, uy oldida; balkonda — opa/singil.
"He is at the bus stop" + "The bus stop is near my house" — demak bobo uy yaqinida.
class_ex.note: Original matn, 78 so'z; faqat to be, o'rin predloglari (next to, opposite, near, in front of, on, at) va my/your. L06 dagi 'My family at home' matnidan boshqa syujet. 2, 3 va 5-bandlar matndagi gapni aynan takrorlamaydi (teskari munosabat, sinonim, ikki gapni bog'lash). Har to'g'ri javob — 2 ball.

Yakun
Har o'quvchi: 'Tonight I am going to …' — bitta gap; xohlovchilar bitta kelishilgan reja ('I'm meeting … at …').

intro: BE GOING TO — reja, niyat: 'men … -moqchiman'. Formula: ega + am/is/are + going to + FE'L (1-shakl). I am going to sleep — Men uxlamoqchiman.
To be bo'lgani uchun inkor va savol o'sha-o'sha: I'm not going to sleep. Are you going to sleep?

Present continuous ham kelajak uchun ishlatiladi — boshqa odam bilan KELISHILGAN, tayyorlangan reja bo'lsa (uchrashuv belgilangan, chipta olingan, stol band qilingan): I'm meeting Ali at 5. We're flying to Dubai on Monday. Going to — o'zim qaror qilgan NIYAT (vaqt aytilishi ham mumkin): I'm going to get a new job. I'm going to clean my room tomorrow. Going to yana — ko'rinib turgan dalilga asoslangan bashorat: Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.
O'zbek tilida ham shunday: 'Ertaga Toshkentga ketyapman' (aniq reja, hozirgi zamon shakli) — 'Toshkentga bormoqchiman' (niyat).
Diqqat: 'I'm going to go out' (going to + go) va 'I'm going out' (present continuous, go fe'li) — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, lekin ma'nosi boshqacha.
formulas: I am going to sleep. She is going to cry. It is going to rain.
Men uxlamoqchiman. U yig'lamoqchi. Yomg'ir yog'moqchi.

notes: Ko'p uchraydigan xato: o'quvchilar 'going to' ni 'going' (present continuous) bilan adashtiradi. Doskaga: going to + V1 (fe'l) / going + joy (I'm going to school — bu 'maktabga ketyapman', going to = 'ga').
'gonna' (og'zaki) — eshitib tanisin, lekin yozmasin.

Progress test 1 tahlili (dars boshida, 7 daqiqa): har o'quvchiga ball va bo'limlar natijasi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 5 savol doskada. O'tish — >=70%; <70% olganlarga 7 kun ichida qayta topshirish sanasi beriladi.
Everyday activities keyingi darsdagi Present simple uchun poydevor — 'har kuni' ma'nosini hozircha bermang, faqat iboralar.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Namuna: I — wake up -> I'm going to wake up at 6 — Men 6 da uyg'onmoqchiman -> I'm not going to wake up at 6 — Men 6 da uyg'onmoqchi emasman -> Am I going to wake up at 6? — Men 6 da uyg'onmoqchimanmi? Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ — 1 daqiqada 3 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 4 aylana = 2 coin.

Juftlik mashqidan oldin ICQ: 'Nechta gap? Kim savol beradi, kim javob?' Kombinatsiya va speaking paytida xatolarni daftarga yozib boring, oxirida 3 tasini doskada birga tuzating (kechiktirilgan tuzatish).

reading.title: Plans for the weekend
text: It is Friday evening and my family is talking about the weekend. My father is going to wash the car and fix the door in the kitchen. He isn't going to rest — he is very busy on Saturday!
My mother is going to go shopping in the morning. She is meeting her friend Malika at the market at 9. In the afternoon she is going to cook plov for our guests.
My brother is going to play football, of course. His team is playing at the stadium at 4 on Saturday. He isn't going to do his homework — and my mother isn't happy about it.

And me? On Saturday I am going to sleep in! Then I am going to read a book and listen to music. On Sunday we are visiting our grandparents in the village. We are leaving at 8 in the morning. What are you going to do this weekend?

tasks.title: Ikki shaklni toping
tasks.instr: Matndan 6 ta 'going to' gapini va 4 ta kelajak ma'nosidagi present continuous gapini yozing. Nega present continuous ishlatilgan?
answers: going to (9 ta, istalgan 6 tasi): My father is going to wash the car and fix the door. He isn't going to rest. My mother is going to go shopping. She is going to cook plov. My brother is going to play football. He isn't going to do his homework. I am going to sleep in. I am going to read a book and listen to music. What are you going to do this weekend?
present continuous — kelajak (4 ta): She is meeting her friend at 9. His team is playing at 4 on Saturday. We are visiting our grandparents on Sunday. We are leaving at 8.
Sabab: bular boshqalar bilan kelishilgan reja (do'st bilan uchrashuv, o'yin jadvali, qarindoshlar kutmoqda, jo'nash vaqti belgilangan). 'My family is talking' — hozir bo'layotgan ish, kelajak emas.

lessons.title: PRESENT SIMPLE (base form)

lessons.book_ref: Ixtiyoriy manba: Student's book — Level 16 (Present simple base form), Reading Topic 15–24, Writing 'About myself'; Teacher's book — Lesson 15.
objectives: I/you/we/they bilan odatiy ish-harakatni Present simple da aytadi: I go to school every day (to be YO'Q!).
Inkor (don't + V1) va savol (Do + S + V1?) shakllarini tuzadi; qisqa javob beradi (Yes, I do / No, I don't).
every day, usually, on Mondays, at 7 o'clock kabi belgi so'zlarni ishlatadi; Present continuous (hozir) bilan farqini biladi.

timeline: Salomlashish
How are you? Ustoz namuna: 'I get up at 6. I drink tea.' — 'What do you do every morning?' 2–3 o'quvchi javob beradi.
KAHOOT — L08: going to vs present continuous, Everyday activities 1
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi — L08 kahoot banki, qisqa versiya: birinchi 10 savol, 15 soniyadan; 1–3-o'rin 3/2/1 coin.
YOZMA NORMATIV — L08: Everyday activities 1 (CORE 20)
O'zbekcha 20 so'z -> inglizcha, 5 daqiqa; 3 tagacha imlo xatosi (so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato) — 2 coin.
YANGI MAVZU — Present simple (I/you/we/they)
Kontekst: ustoz o'z kuni haqida 4 gap. Formula jadvali (+ / – / ? / qisqa javob) — savol-javob (presentation) va CCQ. 'I am go' xatosini 3–4 marta ataylab aytib, o'quvchilar tuzatadi.
Present simple vs present continuous
Doskada ikki ustun: every day -> I go / now -> I am going. CCQ bilan; keyin 2-mashq (Every day yoki now?) juftlikda, 8 band, tekshiruv.
LUG'AT — Everyday activities 2
CORE 20: ustoz o'qiydi -> jo'r takror -> tarjima. Juftlikda: 'I … every day.' -> 'Do you … every day?' — 'Yes, I do. / No, I don't.'
KOMBINATSIYA

A ega+ibora, B +/–/? gap va tarjima = 1 aylana: you — play football -> You play football — Sen futbol o'ynaysan -> You don't… — …o'ynamaysan -> Do you…? — …o'ynaysanmi? Warm-up 1; 1 daq: 3 aylana 1 coin, 4 — 2 coin.

Majburiy: 1, 3, 4 (20 band, ~16 daqiqa + tekshiruv; 2-mashq oldingi bosqichda). ZAXIRA: 5 (Find someone who). Kuchsiz: 1-mashqda 1–6-bandlar; tez tugatgan: o'zi haqida 2 gap.

Jasurning kuni: ustoz skriptni 2 marta o'qiydi. 1-eshitish — vaqtlar (6 bo'shliq), 2-eshitish — True/False (4). Javoblar doskada tekshiriladi.

intro: PRESENT SIMPLE — odatiy, doim, har kuni bo'ladigan ish: I go to school every day — Men har kuni maktabga boraman. Formula juda oddiy: ega + fe'l (1-shakl). TO BE YO'Q!
Bu darsda faqat I / you / we / they (base form). He/she/it (fe'lga -s) — keyingi dars.
Inkor: ega + do not (don't) + V1. Savol: Do + ega + V1? Qisqa javob: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Belgi so'zlar: every day / week / morning, always, usually, often, sometimes, never, on Mondays, at 7 o'clock, in the morning (adverbs of frequency — 10-darsda batafsil).
Present continuous bilan farq: NOW → I am going (hozir); EVERY DAY → I go (odat). 'I am go to school every day' — XATO.
formulas: I go to school every day. We drink tea. They go for a walk.
Men har kuni maktabga boraman. Biz choy ichamiz. Ular sayrga chiqadi.
I don't go to school on Sunday. We don't eat meat.
Men yakshanba maktabga bormayman. Biz go'sht yemaymiz.
Do you go to school? Do they play football?
Sen maktabga borasanmi? Ular futbol o'ynaydimi?
What do you do every morning? Where do you live?
Har ertalab nima qilasan? Qayerda yashaysan?
Yes, S + do. / No, S + don't.
Do you like tea? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
every day → V1 / now → am/is/are + V-ing
I play football every day. / I am playing football now.
Har kuni futbol o'ynayman. / Hozir futbol o'ynayapman.
presentation: Kontekst: ustoz aytadi 'I get up at 6. I drink tea. I go to work. I don't watch TV in the morning.' — Men nima haqida gapirdim? Hozirmi yoki har kunmi?
Ustozning har kungi ishi — odat
Bugun nihoyat mavzuda nima yo'q?
To be
Mavzu nomi? Nechaga bo'linadi? Bugun qaysi? Qavsda nima yozilgan?
Present simple; 2; birinchisi; base form
Tasdiq formulasi?
Subject + verb + signal words
'Har kuni maktabga boraman'? Ega qaysi? Fe'l qaysi? Orasida am/is/are bormi?
I go to school every day; I; go; yo'q
Qulog'ingizga 'I am go' to'g'ri tuyuladi — bu to'g'ri deganimi?
Yo'q — qoidani, formulani eslaymiz
'Men har kuni futbol o'ynayman'?
I play football every day
Inkorda ega bilan fe'l orasiga nima qo'yilgan? To'liq shakli?
don't; do not
'Men har kuni futbol o'ynamayman'?
I don't play football every day
Savolda nima oldinga chiqadi? 'Sen maktabga borasanmi?'
Do; Do you go to school?
Bu zamonni qachon ishlatamiz? Hozir qilayotgan ish uchun qaysi zamon?
Odatiy, har kungi ish; Present continuous
CCQ: 'I play football every day' — hozir o'ynayapmanmi? Bu odatmi? 'I am playing football now' — hozirmi?
Yo'q; ha, odat; ha, hozir
notes: O'quvchilar ko'pincha 'I am go' deydi: oldingi darslarda I dan keyin am kelishiga o'rganib qolgan. Bu xatoni darsda 3–4 marta ataylab aytib, o'quvchilarga tuzattiring.
Faqat I/you/we/they — he/she/it ni bermang; o'quvchi 'he go' desa 'keyingi darsda' deb qo'ying.
Belgi so'zlar bilan taqqoslash jadvalini (now / every day) doskada dars oxirigacha qoldiring.

Writing 'About myself': uyda 60–80 so'zli qoralama (bugungi uyga vazifa, 4-mashq) → ustoz draft_check_a1 belgilari bilan qaytaradi → o'quvchi tuzatadi va 10 daqiqada qaramasdan mashq qiladi. Zanjir: qoralama L09 → WRITING NORMATIV L10 (10 daqiqa yozish, 12' bosqich) → SPEAKING NORMATIV L11 (sinfda); writing_a1 >=14/20.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Namuna: you — play football -> You play football — Sen futbol o'ynaysan -> You don't play football — Sen futbol o'ynamaysan -> Do you play football? — Sen futbol o'ynaysanmi? Har mashqdan oldin ICQ: 'Nechta gap? Yakkami yoki juftlikdami?' Speaking paytida xatolarni yozib boring, oxirida 3 tasini doskada birga tuzating.

reading.title: My day
text: My name is Dilnoza. I am fifteen and I live in Bekobod with my parents and two brothers. I get up at 6 o'clock every day. I don't like early mornings, but I don't have a choice! I make my bed, brush my teeth and have breakfast with my family. We usually drink tea and eat bread with butter.

I leave home at 7:30 and I catch the bus. I arrive at school at 8. I study very hard because I want to go to university. After school I come home, have lunch and take a nap. Then I go to English classes at Jony Academy three times a week. I learn new words and revise lessons every evening.
In the evening we have dinner together. I do the washing-up and my brothers take out the rubbish. We don't watch TV a lot — we chat and read. I go to bed at 10.
On Sundays I don't get up at 6! I sleep in, I go for a walk with my friends and we eat out. Do you like Sundays? I do!
glossary: three times a week — haftada 3 marta
take a nap — biroz uxlab olmoq

intro: Present simple da HE / SHE / IT uchun fe'lga -s (yoki -es) qo'shiladi: He plays football. She goes to school. It rains in autumn.

-ES qoidasi: fe'l -o, -sh, -ch, -x, -ss bilan tugasa: go → goes, do → does, watch → watches, wash → washes, fix → fixes, miss → misses. Undosh + y → -ies: study → studies, fly → flies, cry → cries (lekin play → plays — unli + y). Maxsus: have → has.
Inkor: he/she/it + doesn't + V1 (He doesn't play). Savol: Does + he/she/it + V1? (Does she go?). Muhim: doesn't/does bo'lganda fe'l -s OLMAYDI — -s 'does' ichiga o'tib ketadi.

Chastota ravishlari (adverbs of frequency): always (100%) — usually — often — sometimes — rarely/seldom — never (0%). O'rni: oddiy fe'ldan OLDIN (She always drinks tea), to be dan KEYIN (She is always late).
Talaffuz: -s → /s/ (works, gets), /z/ (plays, goes), /ɪz/ (watches, washes).

-s talaffuzini alohida mashq qiling: /s/ /z/ /ɪz/ — o'quvchilar 'watchs' deydi.
Chastota ravishi o'rni: 'I always am late' — XATO. To be dan keyin: I am always late. Bu qoidani 2 misol bilan bering, ko'p chuqurlashmang.

reading.title: My friend Aziz
text: My best friend is Aziz. He is fifteen and he lives in Bekobod, near my house. He is tall, funny and very hard-working. He studies at my school, but he isn't in my class.

Aziz always gets up at 6 o'clock. He never sleeps in! He has breakfast with his family and then he rides his bike to school. He usually arrives early. After school he goes to the gym three times a week. He loves sport — he plays football at the weekend and he sometimes watches basketball on TV.
In the evening Aziz does his homework and helps his mother. He doesn't watch TV a lot and he doesn't play video games. He often reads books about animals — he wants to be a vet.
Aziz is a good friend. He always helps me with maths and I help him with English. We hardly ever argue!

intro: IMPERATIVE — buyruq, iltimos, maslahat, yo'l ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Ega (you) AYTILMAYDI, gap fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan boshlanadi.
POSITIVE: Verb (+ object)! — Stay indoors! (ichkarida qol) / Go away! (yo'qol) / Help me with my homework, please (uyga vazifamga yordam bering).
NEGATIVE: Don't + verb! — Don't run in the hallway! (koridorda yugurma) / Don't eat too much (ko'p yema) / Don't close the door (eshikni yopma).
MULOYIM: please — boshida yoki oxirida: Please sit down. / Sit down, please.
LET'S: Let's + verb — 'keling, …-aylik': Let's go! Let's not talk. (Let's not — inkor.)
Buyruq gap uchun to be: Be quiet! Be careful! Don't be late! (be — asosiy shakl).
Vaqt so'zlari (now, today, tomorrow, later) buyruq gapda odatda OXIRIDA: Come here now! Call me tomorrow. Finish your homework today.
CAN — qila olmoq (hozir): I can swim — suza olaman. can't = cannot: I can't drive — hayday olmayman. Savol: Can you cook? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
Buyruq va so'rov birga: Open the window! (buyruq) → Can you open the window, please? (muloyim so'rov). Can I come in? — ruxsat so'rash.
can dan keyin TO yo'q, -s yo'q: He can swim (He can swims — XATO). Hamma shaxsda bir xil.

Buyruq gapda 'You' YOZILMAYDI: 'You sit down' xato (bu darak gap).

reading.title: How to make a good cup of tea
text: Do you want a perfect cup of tea? Follow these steps. First, boil some fresh water. Don't use old water from the kettle — fresh water tastes better.

Then, warm the teapot: pour a little hot water into it, wait ten seconds and pour it out. Put one teaspoon of tea for each person into the pot. Add the hot water and wait for three to five minutes. Don't wait too long — then the tea is bitter!
Now pour the tea into cups. Add milk or sugar if you like. In Uzbekistan, people usually drink green tea without milk. In Britain, people often add milk.
Finally, sit down, relax and enjoy your tea. Don't drink it too fast — it's hot! And remember: always wash the teapot afterwards.

lessons.title: INDEFINITE ARTICLE + COUNTABLE / UNCOUNTABLE NOUNS
lessons.grammar_topic: a / an; sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar; ko'plik yasalishi
lessons.book_ref: Student's book (ixtiyoriy): Level 14 (a/an mashqi, 50 gap), Animals, Fruits and vegetables ro'yxatlari; Teacher's book: Lesson 12; kitob audio (ixtiyoriy, ZAXIRA): Audio 36, 42.
objectives: a/an ni so'zning bosh TOVUSHIga qarab tanlaydi (an hour, a university, a European, an umbrella).
Sanaladigan (countable) va sanalmaydigan (uncountable) otlarni farqlaydi: a book / books; water (a water — XATO).
Ko'plik yasash qoidalarini biladi: -s, -es (box → boxes), -ies (baby → babies), -ves (wolf → wolves), maxsus (child → children, mouse → mice, sheep → sheep).
Hayvonlar va meva-sabzavotlar bo'yicha 20 ta CORE so'zni biladi va ular bilan a/an, ko'plik gaplarini tuzadi.
Ustoz o'qigan dialogdan xarid ro'yxatini (son + ot, ko'plik) yozib oladi va eshitgan otlarini sanaladigan / sanalmaydiganga ajratadi.

intro: A/AN — noaniq artikl: o'zbekchada yo'q, inglizchada majburiy. Faqat BIRLIKDAGI SANALADIGAN ot oldida: a book, an apple. Ko'plikda yo'q (books), sanalmaydiganda yo'q (water).

a — undosh TOVUSH oldida, an — unli TOVUSH oldida. Yozilishiga emas, o'qilishiga qaraymiz: an hour /aʊə/ (h o'qilmaydi), a university /juː/ (y tovushi bilan boshlanadi), a European /jʊə/, an umbrella /ʌ/, an MP /em/.
Ot oldida sifat bo'lsa, a/an sifatga qaraydi: a red apple, an ugly doll, an old car.
Sanalmaydigan otlar (uncountable): water, milk, sugar, rice, money, bread, information, homework — a/an yo'q, ko'plik -s yo'q. Miqdor: some water, a glass of water, a cup of tea (13-darsda batafsil).

Ko'plik: -s (cats); -es (s, sh, ch, x, o dan keyin: buses, boxes, tomatoes); undosh + y → -ies (babies, cherries); -f/-fe → -ves (wolves, knives); maxsus: man → men, woman → women, child → children, mouse → mice, sheep → sheep, fish → fish, foot → feet, tooth → teeth.
formulas: a + undosh tovush; an + unli tovush
a ball, a university, a European / an umbrella, an hour, an apple
to'p, universitet, yevropalik / soyabon, soat, olma
a red apple; an ugly doll; an old man
qizil olma; xunuk qo'g'irchoq; keksa odam

Yo'q: books

Uncountable nouns; yo'q — a/an ham, -s ham yo'q

Sifatga (red — undosh)
an hour — nega an, axir h undosh-ku? a university — nega a?
O'qilishiga qarab: hour /aʊə/ unli bilan boshlanadi; university /juː/ y tovushi bilan
notes: Bahs usuli: doskaga 'a red apple' yozing va so'rang — a sifatga qaraydimi yoki otga? 'Sifatga' deganlar, keyin 'otga' deganlar qo'l ko'taradi; so'ng 'an old car' / 'an ugly doll' bilan tekshiriladi — javob: sifatga.
an hour, a university, a European — bu uchtasini doskada qoldiring; testda tushadi.
Sanalmaydigan otlar ro'yxati (70 ta) 13-darsda batafsil; bugun faqat 8–10 tasi: water, milk, tea, sugar, rice, bread, money, meat.
Ko'plik qoidalarini hayvon/meva so'zlari bilan mashq qiling: cherry → cherries, tomato → tomatoes, wolf → wolves, sheep → sheep, mouse → mice.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Namuna: You — apple -> You have an apple — Sizda olma bor -> You don't have an apple — Sizda olma yo'q -> Do you have an apple? — Sizda olma bormi? Sanalmaydigan bilan: You — rice -> You have rice -> You don't have rice -> Do you have rice? Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q.
ICQ (juftlik mashqidan oldin): 'Nechta mahsulot aytasiz? (6) Kim boshlaydi? (xaridor)'. Speaking vaqtida xatolarni to'xtatmasdan yozib boring, oxirida 3 tasini doskada birga tuzating.

how: CORE — 10 hayvon + 10 meva/sabzavot (eng keraklilari); STRONG/SUPER — ixtiyoriy davomi. Qolgan hayvon nomlari 27-darsda (Common nouns — REVISION) takrorlanadi; kitobdagi to'liq ro'yxatlar — ixtiyoriy.
Har so'zni a/an va ko'plik bilan birga yodlating: a dog — dogs; an apple — apples; a sheep — sheep.

class_ex.title: WRITING NORMATIV — About my friend
class_ex.instr: 60–80 so'z, 10 daqiqa. Qoralama, daftar, telefon — mumkin emas. Sarlavha yozilmaydi. Tugagach so'zlarni sanab, oxiriga yozing.
items: 1. Who is your best friend? How old is he/she? Where does he/she live?
3. What does he/she do every day? (kamida 4 ta fe'l + -s; always, usually, sometimes)
4. What does he/she like? What doesn't he/she like?
5. What do you do together? (We often…)
6. Ixtiyoriy: What can he/she do? (can bilan 1–2 gap)
answers: Namuna (L10 qoralama namunasi, ustoz uchun; 69 so'z): My best friend is Sardor. He is fourteen and he lives near my house. He is tall and very kind. He is also clever. Sardor gets up at six o'clock every day. He always goes to school by bike. After school he usually plays football and he sometimes reads books. He likes pizza. He doesn't like tea. We often do our homework together. He is a very good friend.
Ixtiyoriy plus: can (L11) bilan 1–2 gap — masalan: He can swim very well. Bu majburiy emas, lekin to'g'ri ishlatilsa Grammatika mezonida hisobga olinadi.

Tekshirish tartibi: (1) so'zlarni sanang (60–80; 48 dan kam bo'lsa Topshiriq mezoni 3 dan yuqori bo'lmaydi); (2) writing_a1 ning 4 mezoni bo'yicha 0–5 ball: Topshiriq / Grammatika (he/she + -s, doesn't, chastota ravishi o'rni) / Lug'at va imlo / Gap tuzilishi (bosh harf, nuqta, and kamida 2 marta); (3) yig'indi 0–20.

reading.title: At the market
text: On Sunday my mother and I are at the market. It is a big and noisy market in Bekobod. My mother has a list: apples, tomatoes, onions, a watermelon and a kilo of rice.
First we are at the fruit shop. An old man is selling apples and grapes. 'A kilo of apples is 8,000 so'm,' he says. My mother is choosing red apples. I want a banana, but bananas aren't on the list!
Then we are at the vegetable shop. A young woman is selling carrots, cucumbers and potatoes. Potatoes are cheap today. My mother is buying two kilos of potatoes and an onion.
Look! A cat is sitting under the table. It is watching the fish shop. Fish is expensive today, so the cat isn't happy. And a dog is eating a tomato! What a funny market!

intro: THERE IS / THERE ARE — 'bor' ma'nosida, biror joyda nimadir borligini aytish uchun: There is a cat in the room — Xonada mushuk bor. O'zbekchada 'bor' gap oxirida, inglizchada 'there is' gap boshida!
Birlik: there is + a/an + ot. Ko'plik: there are + SOME + ot-s. Sanalmaydigan: there is + SOME + ot (milk, water, money).
SOME — tasdiq gapda ('bir nechta', 'ozgina'). ANY — inkor va savolda: There aren't any cats. Are there any cats? There isn't any milk. Is there any milk?
Qisqa javob: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. Yes, there are. / No, there aren't. Nechta / qancha: How many + ko'plik ot? How much + sanalmaydigan ot? (kuchli guruh uchun).
formulas: There is + a/an + noun / There isn't a … / Is there a …?
There is a cat in the room. There isn't a cat. Is there a cat?
Xonada mushuk bor. Mushuk yo'q. Mushuk bormi?
There are + some + noun-s / There aren't any … / Are there any …?
There are some cats. There aren't any cats. Are there any cats?
Bir nechta mushuk bor. Birorta ham mushuk yo'q. Birorta mushuk bormi?
There is + some + uncount. / There isn't any … / Is there any …?
There is some milk in the fridge. There isn't any milk. Is there any milk?
Muzlatgichda ozgina sut bor. Umuman sut yo'q. Sut bormi?
Yes, there is/are. / No, there isn't/aren't.
Is there a bank here? — Yes, there is.
Bu yerda bank bormi? — Ha, bor.
How many + ko'plik? / How much + sanalmaydigan?
How many apples are there? How much milk is there?
Nechta olma bor? Qancha sut bor?

to be oldinga; bormi; Is there a computer in the room?
CCQ: 'There is a cat in the room' — mushuk nechta? Qayerda? Hozirmi?
Bitta; xonada; ha, hozir
Ko'plik: 'Xonada mushuklar bor'? a/an o'rniga nima?
There are some cats in the room; some
Inkorda some o'rniga nima keldi? Savolda?
any; any
Demak: darak — ? inkor — ? savol — ? Sanalmaydigan ot (milk) bilan-chi?
some; any; any; There is some milk / There isn't any milk / Is there any milk?
CCQ: 'There aren't any bananas' — banan bormi? Bitta bo'lsa ham bormi?
Yo'q; yo'q — birorta ham yo'q
notes: some/any ni rangli bo'r bilan ajrating: SOME (+) — yashil, ANY (–, ?) — qizil. Sanalmaydigan otda ham xuddi shu qoida. O'quvchilar jadvalni daftarga shu ranglarda ko'chiradi.
'There is a milk' — XATO; sanalmaydigan ot oldida a/an yo'q: some milk / a glass of milk.
O'quvchilar 'In the room is a cat' deydi (o'zbekcha tartib). There is gap BOSHIDA — doskada 'THERE IS' ni katta yozing.

Differensiatsiya: How many / How much — faqat kuchli guruhga (formula 5). Kuchsiz o'quvchi 1–3-formulani doskadagi jadvalga qarab aytadi; kuchli o'quvchi har gapga joy qo'shadi (in the kitchen, on the table).

Progress test 2 — 14-dars boshida, 35 daqiqa (L07–L13): grammatika 50, lug'at 30, listening 10, reading 10; was/were va there was/were KIRMAYDI. O'tish >=70%. Takror: L07–L13 formulalari va CORE so'zlari.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Namuna: cat -> There is a cat in the room — Xonada mushuk bor -> There isn't a cat in the room — Xonada mushuk yo'q -> Is there a cat in the room? — Xonada mushuk bormi? Ko'plik: apples -> There are some apples -> There aren't any apples -> Are there any apples? Sanalmaydigan: milk -> There is some milk -> There isn't any milk -> Is there any milk? Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ (ko'p formulali dars) — 1.5 daqiqada 2 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 3 aylana = 2 coin.

ICQ (har mashqdan oldin): 'Yakkami yoki juftlikdami? Necha daqiqa? Inkorda some yoki any?' Speaking va kombinatsiya paytida xatolarni daftarga yozib boring, oxirida 3 tasini doskada birga tuzating (kechiktirilgan tuzatish).

text: Open our fridge! What is there? There is some milk and there is some butter. There are six eggs and there are two big tomatoes. There is a bottle of water and there is some juice, too.

Is there any meat? No, there isn't any meat today — my father is at the market now. Is there any cheese? Yes, there is a little cheese. There are some apples, but there aren't any bananas. My little brother loves bananas, so he isn't happy!
Today is my mother's birthday, so there is a big cake in the fridge! There are some candles on the table, too.
And on the fridge there is a photo of our family and there are some magnets from Samarkand and Bukhara.

intro: Rieltor bir oilaga yangi kvartirani ko'rsatmoqda. Ikki marta eshitasiz. Topshiriqni bajaring.
transcript: AGENT: Hello! I'm Nodira. Come in, please. This is the flat. It's on the fourth floor.
MOTHER: Oh, it's nice! How many rooms are there?
AGENT: There are three rooms. And this is the kitchen. There is a big fridge, and there are some chairs.
BOY: But there isn't a table!
AGENT: No, there isn't.
MOTHER: Are there any shelves?
AGENT: Yes, there are some shelves. There is some rice, some tea and some sugar on the shelves. They are a present for you.
BOY: Is there any milk in the fridge?
AGENT: No, there isn't any milk. There isn't any food in the fridge.
MOTHER: Is there any hot water in the bathroom?
AGENT: Yes, there is. And there is a small window, too.
MOTHER: Thank you. We like it!
