lessons.title: TO BE (PAST) — was / were
lessons.grammar_topic: To be o'tgan zamon: was / were (birlik, ko'plik, you), inkor, savol; there was / there were
lessons.book_ref: IXTIYORIY: Student's book Level 7–10 (to be past), 'was/were' mashqi (50 ta gap); Teacher's book Lesson 7; kitob CD Audio 1–5 (alifbo) — ZAXIRA.
objectives: was / were ni egaga qarab tanlaydi: I/he/she/it → was; you/we/they → were.
To be ning 5 formulasini o'tgan zamonda tuzadi (I was strong / He was a doctor / She was a kind teacher / I was at home).
Inkor (wasn't / weren't) va savol (Was he…? Were you…?) shakllarini yasaydi; qisqa javob beradi.
yesterday, last week, ago, then kabi o'tgan zamon belgilarini ishlatadi; there was / there were (bor edi) bilan gap tuzadi.
Qisqa dialogni eshitib, kim qayerda bo'lganini aniqlaydi va harflab aytilgan ismni yozadi.
materials: TEST pt2 varaqlari (har o'quvchiga) + kalit (ustozda).
was/were jadvali doskada: singular / plural / you; there was / there were.
Listening skripti (ustoz o'qiydi). ZAXIRA: alifbo plakati va kitob CD Audio 1–5.
CORE 20 'Adjectives 3' varag'i.
timeline: Salomlashish + test yo'riqnomasi
Where were you yesterday? — javob namunasini ustoz beradi: I was at home. Test qoidasi: telefonlar yig'iladi, alohida o'tiriladi, savol faqat qo'l ko'tarib.
TEST — Progress test 2 (L07–L13)
Varaq: pt2, kalit ustozda. Grammatika 50 / Lug'at 30 / Listening 10 (ustoz skriptni 2 marta o'qiydi) / Reading 10. Telefonlar yig'iladi. Natija va tahlil — 15-darsda.
Tanaffus
Test — o'zini tekshirish, jazo emas. 'Xato qilyapsizmi — o'rganyapsiz'.
YANGI MAVZU — was/were (+ there was/were)
am/is → was, are → were; you — har doim were. Inkor wasn't/weren't, savol Was/Were oldinga + qisqa javob. CCQ bilan. There is/are → there was/were: 1 formula, 2 misol.
LUG'AT — Common adjectives 3
Ustoz o'qiydi → jo'r takror → o'tgan zamonda gap: 'I was worried yesterday'. Juft so'zlar: lovely/horrible, typical/unusual, brave/afraid.
KOMBINATSIYA — was/were
A: she — sick; B: She was sick — U kasal edi -> She wasn't sick — U kasal emas edi -> Was she sick? — U kasalmidi? = 1 aylana. Warm-up 1; 1 daq: 3 = 1 coin, 4 = 2 coin.
SINF MASHQLARI 1–3 (ZAXIRA: 4–5)
Majburiy: 1–3 (was/were — 7 band; Hozirgidan o'tganga — 6 band; Where were you? — speaking 5 daq). ZAXIRA: 4–5. Kuchsiz: jadvalga qarab; tez tugatgan: ZAXIRA 4.
LISTENING — skript (ustoz o'qiydi)
Ustoz skriptni 2 marta o'qiydi (1-marta tabiiy, 2-marta sekinroq). 1) Kim qayerda edi — 5 ta; 2) True/False — 4 ta. Juftlikda solishtirish, keyin kalit.
Uyga vazifa

MAJBURIY (~45 daqiqa): ovozli normativ Common adjectives 3 (L15 gacha), was/were mashqi, Reading, WRITING — Hometown: ustoz qaytargan qoralamani tuzatib, 10 daqiqada qaramasdan vaqtga mashq (L15 da WRITING NORMATIV, L16 da SPEAKING NORMATIV).
Yakun
Har o'quvchi bitta gap: 'Yesterday at 6 I was …' — sinf tarjima qiladi.

intro: O'tgan zamon — o'zbekchada '-edi' (kuchli EDIM, shifokor EDI). Inglizchada am/is → WAS, are → WERE. Boshqa hech narsa o'zgarmaydi: 5 formula shundayligicha qoladi.
Ega birlik (I, he, she, it, my mother, Ali) → was. Ega ko'plik (we, they, my parents, Ali and Vali) → were. YOU — birlik bo'lsa ham, ko'plik bo'lsa ham WERE.
Belgi so'zlar: yesterday (kecha), last week/month/year (o'tgan hafta/oy/yil), two days ago (2 kun oldin), then (o'shanda), in 2020.
There is / there are ning o'tgan zamoni: there was + a/an + birlik; there were + some + ko'plik ('bor edi'). Inkor: there wasn't a… / there weren't any…; savol: Was there a…? / Were there any…?
formulas: I/he/she/it + was + adj / a-an noun / adj+noun / place
I was strong. He was a doctor. She was a kind teacher. I was at home.
Men kuchli edim. U shifokor edi. U mehribon o'qituvchi edi. Men uyda edim.
we/they/you + were + adj / noun-s / adj+noun-s / place
We were tired. They were great athletes. You were at school.
Biz charchagan edik. Ular ajoyib sportchilar edi. Sizlar maktabda edingiz.
I wasn't a vet. They weren't barbers.
Men veterinar emas edim. Ular sartarosh emas edi.
Was he kind? Were you at home?
Yes, S + was/were. / No, S + wasn't/weren't.
Was it cold? — Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
Where were you yesterday? — I was at the gym.
Kecha qayerda eding? — Sport zalda edim.
There was + a/an + birlik / There were + some + ko'plik
There was a cat in the garden. There were some children in the park.
Bog'da mushuk bor edi. Parkda bir nechta bola bor edi.
presentation: Shuncha payt to be dedik — hozirgi zamon shakllari qaysi? Nechta formula?
am/is/are; 5 ta
'I am a teacher' — qaysi zamon? Bugun qaysi zamon?
Hozirgi; o'tgan
Doskadagi jadvalda o'tgan zamon birlik shaklida am/is o'rnida nima turibdi?
was
'Men kuchli edim'? 'I am strong' dan nima o'zgardi?
I was strong; faqat am → was
CCQ: 'I was at home yesterday.' — Bu gap hozir haqidami? Kecha haqidami?
Yo'q, hozir haqida emas; ha, kecha haqida
'U o'qituvchi edi'? 'U aqlli haydovchi edi'? 'U maktabda edi'?
He was a teacher. He was a clever driver. He was at school.
Ko'plik uchun qaysi so'z? 'Biz qo'pol edik'? 'Ular mehnatkash farroshlar edi'?
were; We were rude. They were hard-working janitors.
'Sen qassob eding' — you birlik, lekin was emas — nima?
were — you har doim were
'Sizlar qassob edinglar' — birlikdan farqi?
You were butchers — a/an yo'q, -s bor
Inkorda nima qo'shamiz? Savolda nima qilamiz?
not — was/were dan keyin; was/were oldinga
'Kecha uyda edingmi?' — qisqa javob?
Were you at home yesterday? — Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
'Parkda bolalar bor edi' — there are → ? 'Bog'da mushuk bor edi'?
There were some children in the park. There was a cat in the garden.
notes: Eng ko'p xato: 'you was'. Doskaga katta qilib: YOU = WERE (har doim). 'I' bilan chalkashadi — I was, lekin you were.
wasn't /ˈwɒznt/, weren't /wɜːnt/ talaffuzini alohida mashq qiling — o'quvchilar 'vosnt' deydi.

Progress test 2 natijasi va tahlili — 15-darsda. Qoida: >=70/100 — o'tdi; 50–69 — xatolar varag'i va 7 kun ichida 70% dan past bo'limlarni qayta topshirish; <50 — ota-onaga xabar, 1 ta qo'shimcha mashg'ulot, 7 kun ichida to'liq qayta topshirish. Guruhdan chiqarish yo'q.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Namuna: they — tired -> They were tired — Ular charchagan edi -> They weren't tired — Ular charchagan emas edi -> Were they tired? — Ular charchagan edimi? Warm-up — 1 aylana; normativ: 1 daqiqada 3 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 4 aylana = 2 coin.

Speaking (3-mashq) oldidan ICQ: 'Nechta savol berasiz? Kim yozadi?' Xatolarni darrov to'xtatmang — yozib boring, oxirida 3 tasini doskada tuzating. Listening: ism harflanganda to'xtamang, 2-marta sekinroq o'qing.

how: CORE 20 — eng kerakli A1–A2 sifatlar: ovozli va yozma normativ hamda Progress test 3 shular bo'yicha. STRONG/SUPER — ixtiyoriy. Har so'z o'tgan zamonda gapda ishlatiladi: 'The film was awful'.
core: My sister was sick last week.
I was afraid of the dog.
strong: I was excited before the trip.
She was nervous before the test.
My parents were proud of me.
normativ: Ovozli (Telegram, L15 gacha): CORE 20 sifatning har biri + o'tgan zamonda o'z gapi + tarjima, 2 daqiqa — 1 coin ('ovozli_normativ' cheki: 3 band).
Yozma (15-dars boshida): CORE 20 so'z o'zbekcha beriladi, 5 daqiqada inglizchasini yozish; 3 tagacha imlo xatosi (so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato) — 2 coin.
Ixtiyoriy, jamlanma: 40 ta (CORE + STRONG) — og'zaki 4 daqiqa (+1 coin), yozma 10 daqiqa (+2 coin); 60 ta (+ SUPER) — og'zaki 6 daqiqa (+2 coin), yozma 15 daqiqa (+3 coin).

class_ex.title: Progress test 2 (L07–L13): ustoz uchun o'tkazish tartibi va ball jadvali
class_ex.type: Faqat ustozga (proyektorga chiqarilmaydi). 14-dars, 35 daqiqa, 100 ball, 4 bo'lim
class_ex.instr: Test 7–13-darslar grammatikasi va lug'atidan tuzilgan: present continuous, going to va present continuous (kelajak), present simple (do/does, -s/-es), buyruq gap, can/can't, a/an, ko'plik, there is/are + some/any. was/were va past simple KIRMAYDI. Bo'limlar: Listening 10 ball, Grammatika 50 ball, Lug'at 30 ball, Reading 10 ball.
items: 1. Dars oldidan: har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa test varag'i chop eting (Listening 1–5, Grammatika 1–25, Lug'at 1–30 va A–L ta'riflar ro'yxati, Reading matni va 1–5 gaplar). Listening skripti va javob kalitlari faqat ustozda qoladi — o'quvchiga berilmaydi, proyektorga chiqarilmaydi.

2. Testdan oldin (taymerdan tashqari, 2 daqiqa): telefon va daftarlar sumkaga olinadi, o'quvchilar alohida o'tiradi. Varaqlarni yuzini pastga qilib tarqating. Proyektorga faqat taymer va hozirgi bo'lim nomini chiqaring.

3. Vaqt taqsimoti (jami 35 daqiqa, ustoz ovoz chiqarib e'lon qiladi): 0–5 daq — Listening (hamma birga); 5–20 — Grammatika (A, B, C qismlar); 20–28 — Lug'at (A va B qismlar); 28–35 — Reading. Har bo'lim tugashidan 1 daqiqa oldin ogohlantiring.

4. Listening (5 daq): avval 30 soniya beriling — o'quvchilar 1–5 bo'shliqlarni o'qib chiqsin. Skriptni 2 marta o'qing: 1-marta tabiiy, sekinroq tezlikda; 20 soniya pauza; 2-marta yana to'liq. Familiyani harfma-harf, har harf orasida kichik pauza bilan ayting; vaqtni 'six forty-five' deb o'qing, raqam bilan yozib ko'rsatmang. Rollarni ovoz ohangi bilan farqlang (Teacher / Nilufar).
5. Grammatika (15 daq) va Lug'at (8 daq): savollarga javob bermang, so'z tarjima qilib bermang. Faqat topshiriq tushunarsiz bo'lsa, qavsdagi o'zbekcha ko'rsatmani qayta o'qib bering.

6. Reading (7 daq): o'quvchi matnni o'qiydi va har gapga TRUE yoki FALSE yozadi. 35:00 tugagach barcha varaqlarni yig'ing; gaplashish yoki ko'chirish bo'lsa — birinchi marta ogohlantiring, takrorlansa ishni yig'ib oling va ball varag'iga izoh yozing.

7. Tekshirish (kalitlar shu testning keyingi bo'limlarida): MCQ — faqat bitta harf; 2 ta harf belgilansa 0. Grammatika B qism — to'liq to'g'ri shakl 2 ball, imlo xatosi bo'lsa 0 (masalan, 'tomatos'). C qism — xatoni topsa 1, to'g'ri tuzatsa yana 1. Lug'at A — bitta harf xatosi 0.5, ikki va undan ko'p — 0. Listening — familiya harfma-harf to'g'ri bo'lishi shart (katta-kichik harf farqi yo'q); vaqt 6:45, 6.45 yoki six forty-five — hammasi to'g'ri.

8. Natijani tizimga bo'limlar kesimida kiriting (Listening /10, Grammatika /50, Lug'at /30, Reading /10, Jami /100) va har bo'lim foizini belgilang: 70% dan past bo'lim = Listening < 7, Grammatika < 35, Lug'at < 21, Reading < 7.

9. Keyingi darsda natijani har o'quvchiga alohida ayting (guruh oldida ball o'qilmaydi). Test tahlilida xatolarni og'zaki muhokama qiling, kalitni o'quvchilarga tarqatmang — qayta topshirishda ham shu varaq ishlatiladi (MCQ variantlari va Reading gaplari tartibini almashtirib chop eting).
answers: 70–100 ball — O'TDI. Keyingi qadam: xatolar test tahlilida og'zaki ko'rib chiqiladi; 70% dan past bo'lim bo'lsa ham qayta topshirish shart emas, ustoz shu bo'lim bo'yicha 1 ta qo'shimcha uyga vazifa beradi.

50–69 ball — QISMAN QAYTA TOPSHIRISH. O'quvchi xatolar varag'ini to'ldiradi (har xato: noto'g'ri javob → to'g'ri javob → qoida → o'z misoli). 7 kun ichida faqat 70% dan past bo'limlar qayta topshiriladi (Listening < 7, Grammatika < 35, Lug'at < 21, Reading < 7). Yangi bo'lim bali eskisining o'rniga yoziladi.

0–49 ball — REMEDIAL. O'sha kuni ota-onaga xabar beriladi (natija va reja). 1 ta qo'shimcha mashg'ulot (7–13-darslar formulalari va CORE so'zlari, ustoz bilan), so'ng 7 kun ichida testni TO'LIQ qayta topshiradi.
Qayta topshirishda ham 50 dan past — rahbar bilan suhbat (o'quvchi, ota-ona, ustoz), takror guruh taklif qilinadi. Hech qaysi holatda guruhdan chiqarish yo'q.

class_ex.title: Grammatika A (1–10) — 20 ball (10 × 2): to'g'ri shaklni tanlang
class_ex.type: Grammatika bo'limi 50 ball, 15 daqiqa (A + B + C). A qism: MCQ
class_ex.instr: Choose the correct answer: A, B, C or D. (To'g'ri javobni tanlang: A, B, C yoki D. Faqat bitta harfni aylantiring.)
items: 1. Look! The baby ___ now. A) sleep B) sleeps C) is sleeping D) are sleeping
2. What ___ you doing? — I'm reading a book. A) do B) are C) is D) does
3. Look at the black clouds! It ___ rain. A) is going to B) is going C) going to D) are going to
4. We have train tickets. We ___ our grandmother on Saturday. A) is visiting B) visiting C) are visiting D) are visit
5. ___ your brother go to school every day? A) Do B) Does C) Is D) Are
6. My sister ___ TV every evening. A) watch B) watchs C) watches D) is watch
7. They ___ coffee. They only drink tea. A) doesn't drink B) don't drink C) not drink D) aren't drink
8. ___ in the classroom! A) Not run B) Don't to run C) You don't running D) Don't run
9. My grandfather is 80, but he ___ swim very well. A) can B) cans C) can to D) is can
10. Sorry, I ___ help you now. I'm very busy. A) don't can B) can't C) can't to D) not can
answers: B — Wh-savol: What + are + you + V-ing? (L7)
A — It is going to rain: belgi bor, going to + V1 (L8)
C — aniq kelishilgan reja (vaqt aniq): are + V-ing (L8)
A — can + V1, -s va to yo'q (L11)

class_ex.type: a / an / – ; ko'plik (-s, -es, -ies, mice) ; there is / are ; some / any
class_ex.instr: Write the correct word. For a / an / –, write a, an or – (nothing). (To'g'ri so'zni yozing. a / an / – bo'lsa: a, an yoki – (hech narsa) yozing.)

14. There are three ___ (mouse) in the kitchen!

18. There ___ (is / are) two chairs in the room.
19. There are ___ (some / any) oranges in the bag.
20. Are there ___ (some / any) apples on the table?
why: a/an keyingi so'zga qaraydi: red — undosh tovush → a (L12)

class_ex.title: Grammatika C (21–25) — 10 ball (5 × 2): xatoni toping va tuzating
class_ex.type: Har gapda bitta xato. Xatoni topsa 1 ball, to'g'ri tuzatsa yana 1 ball
class_ex.instr: Each sentence has ONE mistake. Underline it and write the correct sentence. (Har gapda BITTA xato bor. Xatoning tagiga chizing va gapni to'g'ri yozing.)
items: 21. She go to school every day.
22. Look! The children playing in the garden.
24. I am going to buying a new bag.
25. There is two cats in the garden.
answers: go → goes: She goes to school every day.
playing → are playing: Look! The children are playing in the garden.
likes → like: Does he like tea?
buying → buy: I am going to buy a new bag.
is → are: There are two cats in the garden.
why: present continuous: are + V-ing, to be tushmasin (L7)

reading.title: Yesterday was a strange day
text: Yesterday was a strange day. In the morning the weather was lovely and sunny. I was at school at 8 o'clock. My teacher wasn't in the classroom — she was ill. The lesson was with a new teacher. He was young and very strict!
At 12 o'clock I was at home. My mother was at work and my father was in the garden. The kitchen was empty and I was hungry. The fridge was empty, too!
In the evening the weather was awful — cold and rainy. My friends and I were at the stadium. The match was boring and our team was slow. We were wet and tired, but we were happy — we were together.

intro: Ustoz va o'quvchilar kecha soat 6 da qayerda bo'lganlari haqida gaplashadi. Ikki marta eshitasiz. Topshiriqni bajaring.
transcript: TEACHER: Good morning, everyone! Where were you yesterday at six o'clock? Madina?
MADINA: I was at the hospital. My grandmother was sick, and I was very worried.
TEACHER: Oh, I'm sorry. And you, Timur?
TIMUR: I was at the stadium. The match was awful, and I was angry! My brother wasn't with me. He was at the library.
TEACHER: And you? You are a new student. What's your name?
NIGORA: Nigora. N-I-G-O-R-A.
TEACHER: Thank you. Where were you at six, Nigora?
NIGORA: My parents and I weren't at home. We were at my aunt's house. It was her birthday, and the cake was lovely!
TEACHER: And me? I was at school. I was ready for our lesson!

homework.title: MAJBURIY — WRITING — Hometown (tuzatilgan qoralama, vaqtga mashq)
homework.instr: Ustoz qaytargan qoralamadagi belgilarni tuzating, so'ng matnni 10 daqiqada qaramasdan qayta yozib mashq qiling (kitob qoidasi: avval bexato, keyin vaqtga). L15 — WRITING NORMATIV.
items: 1) Ustoz qo'ygan belgilarni (G, Sp, WO, ^, P, ?) birma-bir tuzating — to'g'ri variantni o'zingiz toping.
2) Tuzatilgan matnni bir marta ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
3) Taymerni 10 daqiqaga qo'ying va matnni qaramasdan qayta yozing (60–80 so'z).
4) Tuzatilgan matn bilan solishtiring, xatolarni qizil bilan belgilang; kerak bo'lsa yana bir marta yozing.
5) Reja: Qayerda? (My hometown is … It is …) → Qanday? (3 sifat) → there is / there are (3 gap) → You can … (2 gap) → Fikringiz (My favourite place is … / I love …).
answers: Namuna (faqat ustozga, original): My hometown is Chust. It is a small town in the Namangan region. It is old, green and quiet. There is a big bazaar in the centre. There are many shops and two parks. There are some old houses near the river. There isn't a cinema. You can buy fruit and knives at the bazaar. You can swim in the river in summer. My favourite place is the big park. I love my hometown. (74 so'z)

Tekshirish (L15 WRITING NORMATIV dagi kabi, writing_a1): 1) Topshiriqni bajarish (mazmun va hajm); 2) Grammatika (to be, there is/are, some, can); 3) Lug'at va imlo; 4) Gap tuzilishi va bog'lanish. 4 × 0–5 = 20; normativ >=14/20.
Qoralamadagi belgilar — draft_check_a1 (G, Sp, WO, ^, P, ?, ✓); to'g'ri javob yozib berilmaydi, o'quvchi o'zi tuzatadi.
Tayyorlik belgisi: 10 daqiqaga sig'di va 3 tagacha xato — L15 ga tayyor.
homework.note: Manba: rahbar xlsx (IELTS 1.0 writing mavzusi 'Hometown'), IELTS 1.0 kitobi writing normativ qoidasi (avval bexato, keyin vaqtga). Namuna original — kitob matni ko'chirilmagan. Zanjir: L13 qoralama → L14 tuzatish va vaqtga mashq → L15 WRITING NORMATIV → L16 SPEAKING NORMATIV.

lessons.title: PAST SIMPLE — regular verbs
lessons.grammar_topic: Past simple to'g'ri fe'llar bilan: V-ed / didn't + V1 / Did … + V1?
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Level 23 (V-ed — 50 gap, inkor — 50, savol — 50), Family and relatives (40) — ixtiyoriy mashq manbai; Teacher's book: Lesson 21.
objectives: To'g'ri fe'llarga -ed qo'shib o'tgan zamon gaplarini tuzadi (I worked yesterday); yozuv qoidalarini biladi (play → played, stop → stopped, study → studied, live → lived).
Inkor (didn't + V1) va savol (Did + S + V1?) tuzadi; -ed faqat tasdiq gapda qolishini biladi.
-ed talaffuzini farqlaydi: /t/ (worked), /d/ (played), /ɪd/ (wanted, needed).
14-darsdagi was/were bilan bog'laydi: to be — was/were; boshqa fe'llar — -ed.

Kontekst: ustozning kechagi kuni (presentation[1]). S + V-ed; didn't + V1; Did + S + V1? 'didn't worked' — xato. Yozuv qoidalari; talaffuz /t/ /d/ /ɪd/.

intro: PAST SIMPLE — o'tgan zamon: kecha, o'tgan hafta bo'lgan, TUGAGAN ish. To'g'ri (regular) fe'llarga -ED qo'shiladi: work → worked, play → played. I worked yesterday — Men kecha ishladim.

Yozuv qoidalari: (1) oddiy: work → worked; (2) -e bilan tugasa faqat -d: live → lived, like → liked; (3) undosh + y → -ied: study → studied, cry → cried (play → played — unli + y); (4) qisqa fe'l 'undosh+unli+undosh' → oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: stop → stopped, plan → planned.
Talaffuz: -ed → /t/ jarangsizdan keyin (worked, watched, stopped), /d/ jaranglidan keyin (played, lived, cleaned), /ɪd/ faqat t/d dan keyin (wanted, needed, visited).
Inkor: didn't + V1 (I didn't work — -ed YO'Q!). Savol: Did + ega + V1? (Did you work?). -ed faqat tasdiq gapda. Hamma ega bilan bir xil (he worked, they worked).

reading.title: My grandmother's story
text: Yesterday my grandmother talked about her life. She lived in a small village near Bukhara. Her family was big — she had five brothers and two sisters. Her father worked as a farmer and her mother cooked for ten people every day!

My grandmother didn't study at university. She finished school and started work at 17. She worked at a cotton factory. She liked her job, but it was hard. In 1975 she married my grandfather. He worked as a teacher in Bekobod, so she moved to Bekobod.
They had four children — my mother, my two uncles and my aunt. My grandmother cleaned, cooked and looked after the children. She didn't have a lot of free time, but she always smiled.
Did she travel a lot? No, she didn't. Did she visit Tashkent? Yes, she did — only once, in 1990. 'I didn't need a lot,' she says. 'I loved my family and my family loved me.'

intro: NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR — o'tgan zamonda -ed OLMAYDI, o'zining alohida 2-shakli bor: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate. Bularni yodlash kerak — kitobda qofiya (ohangdosh) guruhlarga bo'lib berilgan: bring–brought, buy–bought, think–thought, catch–caught, teach–taught.
Formula: ega + V2. He went to Tashkent — U Toshkentga bordi. Inkor va savol — to'g'ri fe'llardagidek, V1 bilan: He didn't go. Did he go? (V2 faqat tasdiqda).
3-shakl (V3: gone, seen, eaten) hozircha faqat jadvalda yodlanadi — u keyingi darajada (Present perfect) kerak bo'ladi.
Ba'zi fe'llar 3 shaklda ham bir xil: cut–cut–cut, put–put–put, cost–cost–cost, hit–hit–hit.
formulas: He went to Tashkent. I rang her. We built this house.

He didn't go to Tashkent. I didn't ring her.

Jadval mashqi (ixtiyoriy): vaqt qolsa, o'quvchi bitta qofiya guruhini qaramasdan aytadi.

Kuchsiz o'quvchi sinf mashqlarida jadvalga qarab ishlaydi; kuchli o'quvchi 4-mashqdan keyin o'zi haqida 3 gap tuzadi. Kombinatsiyada eshitilgan 2–3 xato oxirida doskada tuzatiladi. Reading Topic 69–77 (kitob) — IXTIYORIY.

how: Kitobdagi irregular verbs jadvallaridan eng ko'p ishlatiladigan 60 tasi — bu dars; qolganlari 17-darsda (Irregular verbs 2). CORE 20 — majburiy, STRONG/SUPER — ixtiyoriy. Har fe'l 3 shaklda yodlanadi (V1 – V2 – V3), transkripsiya — 3 shakl uchun. Gaplar — V2 bilan.

reading.title: Last weekend
text: Last weekend was great. On Saturday I woke up at 8 and had a big breakfast. Then my father drove me to my grandparents' village. My grandmother made samsa and I ate five! My grandfather told me stories about his life. He was a soldier and he saw many countries.

In the afternoon my cousins came. We went to the river and swam. My cousin Bobur caught a fish, but it was very small, so he threw it back. We ran, we sang and we laughed a lot. I didn't want to go home!

On Sunday I slept in. Then I did my homework and read a book. In the evening my mother bought a cake because it was my sister's birthday. She got a lot of presents. I gave her a notebook. Did she like it? Yes, she did!
What did you do last weekend?

homework.title: MAJBURIY — Xatoni tuzating
homework.instr: Har gapda bitta xato.

homework.title: MAJBURIY — WRITING — My last weekend (qoralama)
homework.instr: 60–80 so'z (8–10 gap) yozing; tarjimon va boshqa birovning yordamisiz. Qoralamani keyingi darsgacha ilovada ustozga yuboring — ustoz xatolarni belgilab qaytaradi (draft_check_a1). Tuzating va uyda 10 daqiqada qaramasdan yozib mashq qiling. L17 — WRITING NORMATIV, L18 — SPEAKING NORMATIV.
items: 1) Qayerda edingiz: Last weekend I was … / Last weekend was …
2) Shanba — 3 ish (V-ed va V2): On Saturday morning I … Then I … In the afternoon I …
3) Yakshanba — 3 ish: On Sunday I … In the evening I …
4) Kim bilan, qayerda: … with my family / with my friends, at home / in the park / in the village.
5) 1 ta didn't gap va baho: I didn't … It was great / boring.
Vaqt so'zlari: on Saturday morning, then, in the afternoon, in the evening.
answers: Namuna (faqat ustozga; WRITING bosqichida 1 marta ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi, nusxa tarqatilmaydi): Last weekend was very good. On Saturday morning I got up at nine and had breakfast with my family. Then I cleaned my room and helped my father in the garden. In the afternoon I played football with my friends. On Sunday we visited my grandparents in their village. My grandmother made plov and we ate it in the garden. I didn't watch TV. In the evening I did my homework. It was a great weekend. (76 so'z)

Tekshirish: (1) so'zni sanang — 60–80; 5 reja bandi bormi (V-ed va V2, 1 ta didn't gap, vaqt so'zlari). (2) writing_a1 ning 4 mezoni, har biri 0–5: Topshiriqni bajarish / Grammatika / Lug'at va imlo / Gap tuzilishi va bog'lanish. (3) Normativ (L17) >=14/20.

Qoralamaga faqat draft_check_a1 belgilari yoziladi (to'g'ri javob yozib berilmaydi): G — grammatika (masalan 'I didn't went' → I didn't go, 'I goed' → I went), Sp — imlo, WO — so'z tartibi, ^ — so'z tushib qolgan, P — bosh harf/tinish belgisi, ? — ma'no tushunarsiz, ✓ — yaxshi ibora.
Grammatika chegarasi: past simple (regular L15 + irregular L16), was/were, didn't + V1; but/so/because hali shart emas (L18 dan) — and va then yetarli.
homework.note: Manba: rahbar rejasi (IELTS 1.0 xlsx — 7 ta writing normativ), IELTS 1.0 kitobidagi writing normativ qoidasi. Namuna — original.

lessons.title: PAST SIMPLE — irregular verbs 2 + PAST CONTINUOUS (when / while)
lessons.grammar_topic: Past continuous (was/were + V-ing) va past simple bilan birga: when / while
lessons.book_ref: Ixtiyoriy (uyda): Student's book — Level 12 (was/were + -ing, 50 gap), Past simple vs Past continuous (A–E), Irregular verbs jadvali (2-qism); Reading Topic 9 va 13; Teacher's book: Lesson 10.
objectives: 'Subject + was/were + verb-ing' formulasida o'tgan zamonda davom etayotgan ishni aytadi (I was sleeping at 10 last night).
Present continuous bilan farqini biladi: faqat to be o'zgaradi (am/is/are → was/were).
Inkor (wasn't/weren't + -ing) va savol (Was/Were + S + -ing?) tuzadi; 'What were you doing at 8?' savoliga javob beradi.
yesterday at 5, at that time, last night, all day kabi belgi so'zlarni ishlatadi.
20 ta CORE fe'lni (Irregular verbs 2) 3 shaklda biladi va past simple / past continuous gaplarda ishlatadi.
Irregular verbs ro'yxatini davom ettiradi: CORE 20 — majburiy, STRONG/SUPER 40 — ixtiyoriy.
when / while: qisqa ish — past simple, uzoq (fon) ish — past continuous: When the phone rang, I was sleeping. While I was cooking, he came.

'My last weekend' WRITING NORMATIVini topshiradi: 60–80 so'z, 10 daqiqa, qaramasdan (past simple: V-ed, V2, didn't); writing_a1 >=14/20. Zanjir: qoralama L16 → WRITING NORMATIV L17 (bugun, 10 daqiqa yozish, 12' bosqich) → SPEAKING NORMATIV L18 (sinfda).
materials: Formula jadvali: Present continuous / Past continuous yonma-yon + when / while qatori.
Soat chizmasi (doskada): 'Yesterday at 7 / 9 / 12 / 18 / 22' — vaqt chizig'i; when/while uchun uzun to'lqinli chiziq va uni kesgan nuqta.
Yozma normativ varag'i — L16 CORE 20
CORE 20 'Irregular verbs 2' varag'i (vocab CORE ro'yxatidan chop etiladi: 3 shakl, transkripsiya, tarjima, misol).
Kahoot: L16 banki (tizimda, 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi).
Reading matni (rejada); Listening — ustoz o'qiydigan skript (listening.transcript, 2 marta).
WRITING NORMATIV — My last weekend: bo'sh yozuv varaqlari (har o'quvchiga), reja savollari proyektorda (7-mashq); writing_a1 rubrikasi (8-mashq) va namuna (7-mashq javobi) — faqat ustozda.
timeline: Salomlashish + What were you doing at 8 last night?
Ustoz o'zi javob beradi: 'I was watching TV.' 5–6 o'quvchidan so'raydi (qolganlar KOMBINATSIYA da); javob to'liq gap bilan, kerak bo'lsa ustoz yordamida.
KAHOOT — L16: Past simple (irregular), Irregular verbs 1
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi — L16 kahoot banki, qisqa versiya: birinchi 10 savol, 15 soniyadan; 1–3-o'rin 3/2/1 coin.
YOZMA NORMATIV — L16: Irregular verbs 1 (CORE 20)
O'zbekcha 20 so'z -> inglizcha (3 shakl), 5 daqiqa; 3 tagacha imlo xatosi (so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato) — 2 coin.
WRITING NORMATIV — My last weekend

60–80 so'z, 10 daqiqa, L16 qoralamasi (ustoz tekshirgan) asosida, qaramasdan; writing_a1 >=14/20. SPEAKING NORMATIV — L18 da. 1' tarqatish (reja savollari proyektorda) + 10' yozish + 1' yig'ish; karta va rubrika — sinf mashqlari oxirida (7–8).
YANGI MAVZU — Past continuous + when/while
Present continuous -> am/is/are o'rniga was/were. Vaqt chizig'i: 'Yesterday at 9 I was sleeping'. Inkor, savol, Wh-savol. Keyin when/while: vaqt chizig'i + 2 CCQ (presentation 11–12).
LUG'AT — Irregular verbs 2
CORE 20 — 3 shakl, guruhlab (ring–rang–rung, sink–sank–sunk; learnt, burnt, dreamt, smelt). Har fe'lga bitta gap, ba'zilari when bilan: 'When the phone rang, I was sleeping.'
KOMBINATSIYA

Juftlikda, 1 aylana = +/–/? + tarjima: I — sleep at 10 -> I was sleeping at 10 -> I wasn't sleeping at 10 -> Was I sleeping at 10? Warm-up 1 aylana (qisqa); normativ: 1 daqiqada 3 aylana = 1 coin, 4 = 2 coin.
SINF MASHQLARI 1–5 (Alibi)

Majburiy: 1–5 (3+3+4+2+5 daqiqa, tekshiruv bilan); 3 — when/while; 5 — 'Alibi' o'yini, oxirida ustoz 2–3 xatoni doskaga yozadi. 6 (Tarjima) — sinfda o'tilmaydi (WRITING NORMATIV vaqti), xohlovchilarga uyda ixtiyoriy.
READING — Yesterday at 6 o'clock
Matn rejada: True/False (6), savollarga javob (6). 3-topshiriq (was/were + -ing gaplarini topish) — vaqt qolsa, aks holda uyda ixtiyoriy.
LISTENING — skript (ustoz o'qiydi)
Ustoz skriptni 2 marta o'qiydi (rollarni ovoz bilan farqlaydi): 1-marta — jadval (5 kishi + familiya), 2-marta — when/while gaplari. Tekshiruv doskada.
Uyga vazifa

Majburiy (~45 daqiqa): ovozli normativ Irregular verbs 2 (L18 gacha), 'was / were + -ing' (8), 'Savol tuzing' (6), 'Kecha kechqurun — 8 gap', SPEAKING (ovozli mashq) — My last weekend (6 savol, ≈1 daqiqa, baholanmaydi). 18-dars boshida yozma normativ, keyin SPEAKING NORMATIV — My last weekend (butun guruh, sinfda).

intro: Past continuous — o'tgan zamonda DAVOM ETAYOTGAN ish: 'Kecha soat 9 da men uxlayotgan edim'. Formula: ega + was/were + fe'l-ing.
Present continuous dan farqi faqat to be da: am/is/are → was/were. -ing qoidalari o'sha-o'sha (writing, swimming, playing).

Qachon ishlatiladi: (1) o'tgan zamonda aniq vaqtda davom etayotgan ish — yesterday at 5, at that time, at 10 last night; (2) uzoq davom etgan ish — all day, all evening; (3) bugun: 'when' / 'while' bilan — When the phone rang, I was sleeping.
Belgi so'zlar: yesterday at …, at that time, last night, all day/evening, at this time yesterday.

PAST SIMPLE bilan birga: qisqa ish — past simple, uzoq (fon) ish — past continuous. When the phone RANG, I WAS SLEEPING. While I was cooking, he came. when odatda qisqa ish (V2) oldida, while — uzoq ish (was/were + -ing) oldida. Ikki uzoq ish bir vaqtda — while bilan: While I was cooking, my brother was watching TV. (16-darsdagi V2 shakllar shu yerda kerak.)
formulas: I was sleeping. You were playing. She was reading. They were listening.
Men uxlayotgan edim. Sen o'ynayotgan eding. U o'qiyotgan edi. Ular tinglayotgan edi.
I wasn't sleeping. We weren't cooking.
Men uxlamayotgan edim. Biz pishirmayotgan edik.
Was he working? Were you studying at 8?
U ishlayotgan edimi? Soat 8 da o'qiyotgan edingmi?
What were you doing at 5? Where was she going?
Soat 5 da nima qilayotgan eding? U qayerga ketayotgan edi?
Yes, S + was/were. / No, S + wasn't/weren't.
Were they sleeping? — Yes, they were.
Present cont.: am/is/are + V-ing / Past cont.: was/were + V-ing
Now I am reading. Yesterday at 9 I was reading.
Hozir o'qiyapman. Kecha 9 da o'qiyotgan edim.
When + past simple, past continuous / While + past continuous, past simple
When the phone rang, I was sleeping. While I was cooking, he came.
Telefon jiringlaganda uxlayotgan edim. Ovqat pishirayotganimda u keldi.
presentation: O'tgan dars qaysi mavzu? 'Men kecha kinoga bordim'?
Past simple (noto'g'ri fe'llar); I went to the cinema yesterday.
'I went' — ish tugaganmi? Endi Present continuous ni eslang: 'Men hozir o'qiyapman'? Davom etyaptimi?
Ha, tugagan (qisqa ish); I am reading now — hozir, davom etyapti
Bugungi mavzu? Tarjimasi?
Past continuous; o'tgan davomiy zamon

Doskada vaqt chizig'i: uzun to'lqinli chiziq 'I was sleeping' (22:00–07:00), uni kesgan nuqta 'the phone rang' (02:00). 'When the phone rang, I was sleeping.' Qaysi ish uzoq davom etdi? Qaysi biri uni bo'ldi?
I was sleeping — uzoq ish (past continuous); the phone rang — qisqa ish, uni bo'ldi (past simple)
'While I was cooking, my brother came.' Qaysi ish uzoq? Qaysi biri qisqa? while dan keyin qaysi zamon?
was cooking — uzoq; came — qisqa; while + past continuous, when + past simple
notes: DARS KARTASI: L16 (past simple — irregular, Irregular verbs 1) -> bugun past continuous + when/while, Irregular verbs 2. Doskaga: S + was/were + V-ing | wasn't/weren't + V-ing | Was/Were + S + V-ing? | When + V2, was/were + V-ing. Darsda: YOZMA NORMATIV dan keyin WRITING NORMATIV — My last weekend (12'). Tayyorlash: L16 yozma normativ varag'i, writing normativ varaqlari, CORE 20 varag'i, listening skripti. Majburiy uy vazifasi — 5 band (~45 daqiqa).
Vaqt chizig'i eng yaxshi tushuntirish: doskaga kecha kunini chizing (7:00 — 9:00 — 12:00 — 18:00 — 22:00) va har nuqtada 'I was …-ing' yozdiring.

past simple (L15–16) + past continuous = when/while: qisqa ish — V2 (rang, came), uzoq fon ish — was/were + -ing. Doskada vaqt chizig'ini chizing va 2 CCQ bering: 'Qaysi ish uzoq davom etdi? Qaysi biri uni bo'ldi?' Kuchsiz o'quvchi 3-mashqda fe'llar ro'yxatiga qarab ishlaydi.
'you was' xatosi yana chiqadi — YOU = WERE eslatmasi doskada qolsin.
Alibi o'yini (Mashq 5) — sinfning eng sevimli o'yini bo'ladi; vaqtni nazorat qiling.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Namuna: I — sleep at 10 -> I was sleeping at 10 — Men soat 10 da uxlayotgan edim -> I wasn't sleeping at 10 — Men soat 10 da uxlamayotgan edim -> Was I sleeping at 10? — Men soat 10 da uxlayotganmidim? Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ — 1 daqiqada 3 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 4 aylana = 2 coin.
mistakes: When I was come home, my mum cooked.
When I came home, my mum was cooking.
qisqa ish — V2 (came), uzoq fon — was/were + -ing (was cooking).

how: Irregular verbs 2 — noto'g'ri fe'llarning ikkinchi qismi: CORE 20 — majburiy (3 shaklda), STRONG/SUPER — ixtiyoriy. O'xshash guruhlar bilan o'rgating: ring–rang–rung, sink–sank–sunk; learn–learnt, burn–burnt, dream–dreamt, smell–smelt; blow–blew–blown, draw–drew–drawn. Har fe'lga bitta gap — and/but/so/because/when bilan.

class_ex.title: WRITING NORMATIV — My last weekend
class_ex.instr: 60–80 so'z, 10 daqiqa. Qoralama, daftar, telefon — mumkin emas. Sarlavha yozilmaydi. Tugagach so'zlarni sanab, oxiriga yozing.
items: 1) Where were you last weekend? How was it? (Last weekend I was … / Last weekend was …)
2) What did you do on Saturday? — 3 ta ish (V-ed va V2)
3) What did you do on Sunday? — 3 ta ish
4) Who were you with? Where? (with my family / with my friends)
5) What didn't you do? Was it great or boring? (I didn't … It was …)
Vaqt so'zlari: on Saturday morning, then, in the afternoon, in the evening.
answers: Namuna (L16 qoralama namunasi, faqat ustozga; 76 so'z): Last weekend was very good. On Saturday morning I got up at nine and had breakfast with my family. Then I cleaned my room and helped my father in the garden. In the afternoon I played football with my friends. On Sunday we visited my grandparents in their village. My grandmother made plov and we ate it in the garden. I didn't watch TV. In the evening I did my homework. It was a great weekend.

reading.title: Yesterday at 6 o'clock
text: Yesterday at 6 o'clock in the evening my family was at home. My mother was cooking dinner in the kitchen and she was listening to music. My father was sitting on the sofa. He was reading a newspaper, but he wasn't reading carefully — he was sleeping a little!
My sister was doing her homework. She was writing and she was looking at her phone at the same time. My brother was playing a computer game. He was winning, so he was shouting: 'Yes! Yes!'

And me? I was standing at the window. It was snowing. The children in the street were throwing snowballs and laughing. The cars were moving slowly. Our dog was watching the children, too. He wasn't happy — he was inside!
What were you doing yesterday at 6 o'clock?

intro: Kecha maktab yonida velosiped o'g'irlandi. Politsiyachi uch kishidan so'raydi: soat 8 da nima qilayotgan edingiz?
Ikki marta eshitasiz. Topshiriqni bajaring: 1-marta — jadval, 2-marta — gaplar.
transcript: OFFICER: Good evening. Somebody stole a red bike near the school yesterday. What were you doing at 8 o'clock yesterday evening?
ANVAR: I was at home. My brother and I were watching football on TV. The wind blew, so I shut the window.
OFFICER: What's your surname, please?
ANVAR: Rashidov. R-A-S-H-I-D-O-V.
OFFICER: Thank you. And you, madam?
LOLA: I was cooking plov in the kitchen. When the phone rang, I was cooking. It was my sister.
OFFICER: OK, I understand. And you, young man?
TIMUR: I was walking my dog in the park. While I was walking, I saw a boy on a red bike. He was riding very fast.
OFFICER: A red bike! Thank you, Timur. Can you show me the park?
TIMUR: Yes, of course.

intro: BOG'LOVCHILAR ikki oddiy gapni bitta murakkab gapga bog'laydi — IELTS da murakkab gap yuqori ball beradi.
AND (va): qo'shimcha, bir yo'nalishdagi fikr. I played football and went to school. He didn't study and didn't get into university.

BUT (lekin, ammo): qarama-qarshi yoki kutilmagan fikr. Ko'pincha + but –: I played football, but I didn't go to school. Lekin +/+ ham bo'ladi: It was cold, but we went out. Qoida — ma'noda, ishorada emas.
SO (shuning uchun): SABAB + so + NATIJA. I was ill, so I didn't go to school.
BECAUSE (chunki): NATIJA + because + SABAB. I didn't go to school because I was ill. Because oldinda kelsa — vergul: Because I was ill, I didn't go to school (kasal bo'lganim uchun).

WHEN (…ganda, …gach): When I wake up, I go for a run (odat — present). When they finished, they left (ketma-ket ikki ish — ikkala past simple). When the phone rang, I was sleeping (davomiy fon — past continuous, qisqa ish — past simple). Ikki davomiy ish bir vaqtda — odatda while: While it was raining, I was reading.
ALTHOUGH (garchi…-sa ham): Although it was cold, we went out. HOWEVER (biroq) — yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan: It was cold. However, we went out.
formulas: I played football and went to school. He didn't study hard and didn't get into university.
Men futbol o'ynadim va maktabga bordim. U qattiq o'qimadi va universitetga kirmadi.
I played football, but I didn't go to school. It was cold, but we went out.
Men futbol o'ynadim, lekin maktabga bormadim. Sovuq edi, lekin biz tashqariga chiqdik.
I was ill, so I didn't go to school.
Men kasal edim, shuning uchun maktabga bormadim.
result + because + cause / Because + cause, result
We stayed indoors because it was raining. Because it was raining, we stayed indoors.
Yomg'ir yog'ayotgani uchun biz ichkarida qoldik.
When + present, present (odat); When + past simple, past simple / past continuous; While + past continuous, past continuous
When I wake up, I go for a run. When they finished, they left. When the phone rang, I was sleeping. While it was raining, I was reading.
Uyg'onganimda yugurgani chiqaman. Tugatganlarida ketishdi. Telefon jiringlaganda men uxlayotgan edim. Yomg'ir yog'ayotganda men kitob o'qiyotgan edim.
Although + gap, gap / Gap. However, gap.
Although it was cold, we went out. It was cold. However, we went out.
Sovuq bo'lsa ham, chiqdik. Sovuq edi. Biroq, chiqdik.
presentation: Bugun nima o'tamiz? Conjunctions nima degani? Nechta?
Bog'lovchilar; 7 ta (and, but, so, because, when, although, however)
and tarjimasi? Qanday fikrlarni bog'laydi?
va; qo'shimcha, bir yo'nalishdagi fikrlarni (+/+ yoki –/–)
'Men futbol o'ynadim va maktabga bordim'? 'Men yaxshi o'qimadim va universitetga kirmadim'?
I played football and went to school. I didn't study hard and didn't get into university.
but tarjimasi? Qanday holatda? 'Men futbol o'ynadim, lekin maktabga bormadim'?
lekin; qarama-qarshi yoki kutilmagan fikr (It was cold, but we went out); I played football, but I didn't go to school
so tarjimasi? Formula? Cause / result nima?
shuning uchun; cause + so + result; sabab / natija
'Men kasal edim, shuning uchun maktabga bormadim'? Sabab qaysi? Natija?
I was ill so I didn't go to school; kasal edim; bormadim
because tarjimasi? so ning teskarisi — birinchi nima keladi?
chunki; result + because + cause
'Men maktabga bormadim chunki kasal edim'? Because oldinda kelsa nima kerak?
I didn't go to school because I was ill; vergul
when — 3 holat: hozirgi odat? ketma-ket ikki o'tgan ish? davomiy fon + qisqa ish? Ikki davomiy ish uchun qaysi so'z?
When I wake up, I go… / When they finished, they left / When the phone rang, I was sleeping / while: While it was raining, I was reading
'Telefon jiringlaganda men uxlayotgan edim'?
When the phone rang, I was sleeping
notes: so va because — bir-birining teskarisi: doskada bitta gapni ikki xil yozing: I was ill, SO I stayed at home. / I stayed at home BECAUSE I was ill.
when + past simple + past continuous — 17-darsdagi past continuous takrori; 3-mashq shu uchun. Kitob A–E mashqlari (past simple vs continuous) — faqat ixtiyoriy uyga.

although/however — faqat kuchli o'quvchilarga; testda tushmaydi. Kuchsiz o'quvchi: 1-mashqda 1–6 band; kuchli — hammasi + o'z gapi. Speaking normativi paytida xatolarni yozib boring, oxirida 3 tasini doskada tuzating.

PROGRESS TEST 3 — L14–L18: was/were, past simple (regular/irregular), past continuous + when/while, conjunctions; lug'at L14–L18 CORE; listening, reading, writing 5–6 gap. O'tish >=70%. Test 19-dars boshida, 35 daqiqa; dars oxirida qamrovni 1 marta ko'rsating.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Bugun A sabab va natijani aytadi: 'tired — sleep' -> I was tired, so I slept — Men charchagan edim, shuning uchun uxladim -> I wasn't tired, so I didn't sleep — Men charchamagan edim, shuning uchun uxlamadim -> Why did you sleep? — Because I was tired. — Nega uxlading? — Charchaganim uchun. Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ — 1 daqiqada 3 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 4 aylana = 2 coin.

reading.title: A bad day
text: Yesterday was a bad day for Aziz. He woke up late because his alarm clock didn't ring. He didn't have breakfast, so he was hungry all morning. When he was running to the bus stop, it started to rain and he didn't have an umbrella!

He arrived at school late, but the teacher didn't shout at him because she understood — the rain was terrible. In the maths lesson Aziz didn't understand the new rule, so he asked the teacher and she explained it again.

After school he went to the shop and bought bread. When he was walking home, he met his friend Bobur. Bobur lent him an umbrella, so Aziz didn't get wet again. At home his mother made hot tea and Aziz felt better.
Although it was a bad day, it ended well. 'Bad days happen,' his mother said, 'but good friends help.'

lessons.title: TO BE (FUTURE) — will be + FUTURE SIMPLE — will
lessons.grammar_topic: will be / won't be / Will … be?; will + V1 / won't / Will …?; will vs going to
lessons.book_ref: IXTIYORIY: Student's book — BOSS LEVEL (to be future jadvali); Level 21 (will — 30 gap, WILL or GOING TO); Common verbs ro'yxati (4-qism); Reading Topic 57–68.
objectives: will be bilan to be ning 5 formulasini kelasi zamonda tuzadi (I will be a lawyer / We will be at home).
Inkor (won't be) va savol (Will you be…?) shakllarini yasaydi; 'will' ning o'zi emas, 'will be' ekanini biladi.
'Subject + will + V1' formulasida kelasi zamon gaplarini tuzadi (I will go to Tashkent tomorrow); hamma ega bilan will bir xil.
Inkor (won't + V1) va savol (Will + S + V1?) tuzadi; qisqa javob beradi (Yes, I will / No, I won't).
will (o'sha zahoti qaror, taxmin, va'da: I think it will rain / I'll help you) ni going to (oldindan reja, 8-darsda o'tilgan) dan bitta CCQ orqali ajratadi.
Darsning birinchi qismidagi 'will be' bilan bog'laydi: will + be = to be ning kelasi zamoni; will + boshqa fe'l = future simple.
20 ta CORE fe'lni (Common verbs 4) biladi va har biri bilan will-gap tuzadi; 'My daily routine' qoralamasini uyda yozadi (writing normativ — 20-darsda).
materials: TEST pt3 varaqlari (har o'quvchiga) + kalit (ustozda)
Doskada WILL ≠ WILL BE jadvali (+ / – / ?) va 1 qator: hozirgi qaror/taxmin/va'da — will; oldindan reja — going to.
Common verbs 4 — CORE 20 varag'i (vocab ro'yxatidan chop etiladi).
Listening: skript (Listening bo'limi, transcript — ustoz o'qiydi); Reading matni — uyga (tizimda).
timeline: Salomlashish + test yo'riqnomasi
Davomat. Test qoidalari: telefonlar yig'iladi, 35 daqiqa, ism-familiya varaqqa; tartib: grammatika -> lug'at -> listening (ustoz o'qiydi) -> reading -> writing.
TEST — Progress test 3 (L14–L18)
Varaq: tizimdagi pt3 (har o'quvchiga), kalit ustozda. Grammatika 50 / Lug'at 20 / Listening 10 / Reading 10 / Writing 10. Telefonlar yig'iladi. Natija va tahlil — 20-darsda.
Tanaffus
Varaqlar yig'iladi. Ustoz doskaga WILL ≠ WILL BE jadvalini (+ / – / ?) yozadi.
YANGI MAVZU — will be + will
Kontekst: 'What will you be in 2035?' — 'I will be a doctor.' Avval will be (+/–/?), keyin will + V1 (+/–/?, qisqa javob, Wh-). will vs going to — 1 CCQ: 'I'll help you' — hozir qaror qildimi? (Ha).
LUG'AT — Common verbs 4
CORE 20: ustoz o'qiydi -> sinf takrorlaydi -> har fe'l bilan will-gap va tarjima: 'I will check my answers.' — Men javoblarimni tekshiraman.
KOMBINATSIYA — will
Juftlikda, 1 aylana: I — go -> I will go — Men boraman -> I won't go — Men bormayman -> Will I go? — Men boramanmi? Normativ: 1 daqiqada 3 aylana — 1 coin, 4 — 2 coin.
SINF MASHQLARI 1–3 (ZAXIRA: 4–6)
Majburiy: 1–3 (20 band, ~15 daqiqa + tekshiruv); ZAXIRA: 4–6. Kuchsiz o'quvchi: 1–2-mashqda doskadagi jadvalga qarab; 3-mashqda kuchli + kuchsiz juftlik.
LISTENING — skript (ustoz o'qiydi)
Ustoz skriptni 2 marta o'qiydi. 1-marta — ob-havo jadvali (kun, ob-havo, harorat); 2-marta — True/False (will / won't); javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Uyga vazifa + WRITING — My daily routine (reja va namuna)

Reja proyektorda, ustoz namunani 1 marta o'qiydi; qoralama L20 gacha ustozga. MAJBURIY: ovozli normativ Common verbs 4 (L20 gacha), 'will — to'ldiring', Reading 'Our trip to Samarkand', 'My daily routine' qoralamasi (60–80 so'z). L20 boshida yozma normativ (CORE 20); zanjir: qoralama L19 → WRITING NORMATIV L20 (10 daqiqa yozish, 12' bosqich) → SPEAKING NORMATIV L21 (sinfda).
Yakun
Har o'quvchi bitta gap: 'Tomorrow I will …' — sinf tarjima qiladi. Test natijasi va tahlil — 20-darsda.

intro: Kelasi zamonda to be ning BITTA shakli bor: WILL BE (hamma ega uchun). O'zbekcha 'bo'laman / bo'ladi / bo'lamiz'.
Xato: 'I will a doctor' — be tushib qoladi. To be — 'bo'lmoq' fe'li; will — faqat kelasi zamon belgisi. Ikkalasi birga: will be.
Inkor: will not be = won't be /wəʊnt biː/. Savol: Will + ega + be + …? Be joyida qoladi, faqat will oldinga chiqadi.
FUTURE SIMPLE — kelasi oddiy zamon: ega + WILL + fe'l (1-shakl). I will go there — Men u yerga boraman. Will hamma ega bilan bir xil (he will, they will) — -s yo'q, to yo'q.
Inkor: will not = won't + V1 (I won't play). Savol: Will + ega + V1? (Will you come tomorrow?). Qisqa javob: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
Darsning birinchi qismida 'will be' o'tildi — bu o'sha will! will + be (bo'lmoq) = I will be a doctor; will + go = I will go. Ya'ni will dan keyin istalgan fe'l.

WILL vs GOING TO (bugun faqat 1 CCQ, mashq — ZAXIRA): will — hozir qaror qilyapsiz (I'm thirsty — I'll drink water), taxmin (I think it will rain), va'da (I will help you). Going to — oldindan reja (I'm going to visit Samarkand next month) yoki aniq belgi bor (Look at the clouds — it's going to rain).
Belgi so'zlar: tomorrow, next week/year, soon, in 2030, I think…, I promise…, probably.
formulas: S + will be + adj / a-an noun / adj+noun / place
I will be healthy. I will be a lawyer. He will be a great lifeguard. We will be at home.
Men sog'lom bo'laman. Men huquqshunos bo'laman. U zo'r qutqaruvchi bo'ladi. Biz uyda bo'lamiz.
S + will be + noun-s / adj + noun-s
We will be bodyguards. They will be strict teachers.
Biz qo'riqchi bo'lamiz. Ular qattiqqo'l o'qituvchi bo'lishadi.
I will go there. She will call you. It will rain tomorrow.
Men u yerga boraman. U senga qo'ng'iroq qiladi. Ertaga yomg'ir yog'adi.
I won't play football. They won't study tomorrow.
Men futbol o'ynamayman. Ular ertaga o'qimaydi.
Will you go to Tashkent tomorrow? Will he come?
Yes, S + will. / No, S + won't.
Will it rain? — Yes, it will. / No, it won't.
What will you do tomorrow? When will they arrive?
Ertaga nima qilasan? Ular qachon keladi?
will — hozirgi qaror/taxmin/va'da; going to — reja
I'm cold. I'll close the window. / I'm going to buy a car next year.
Sovqotdim. Derazani yopaman. / Kelasi yil mashina olmoqchiman.
presentation: Kontekst: 'Today I am a teacher. In 2035 I … a pilot.' Kelasi zamonda to be ning shakli qaysi?
will be
Will ning o'zimi? Nega be kerak?
Yo'q, will be — be 'bo'lmoq' degani, will faqat zamon belgisi
'Men sog'lom bo'laman' — to be + adjective?
I will be healthy
'Sen rassom bo'lasan' — to be + noun? 'Biz modelyer bo'lamiz' — ko'plik?
You will be an artist. We will be models.
Bugungi mavzu? Tarjimasi? Formulasi?
Future simple; kelasi oddiy zamon; S + will + verb
'Men u yerga boraman'? 'Men futbol o'ynayman' (ertaga)?
I will go there. I will play football.
CCQ: 'The bag is heavy. — I'll help you.' Bu qaror oldindan rejalanganmi yoki hozir qilindimi?
Hozir (o'sha zahoti) — shuning uchun will. Oldindan reja bo'lsa — going to (8-dars).
Darsning birinchi qismidagi 'I will be a doctor' — bu ham will-mi? Farqi?
Ha; will + be (bo'lmoq) — will dan keyin istalgan fe'l keladi
Inkor formulasi? 'Men futbol o'ynamayman'?
S + won't + V; I won't play football
'Sen ertaga Toshkentga bormaysan'?
You won't go to Tashkent tomorrow
Savol formulasi? 'Ertaga Toshkentga borasanmi?' 'Ertaga darsga kelasanmi?'
Will + S + V; Will you go to Tashkent tomorrow? Will you come to the lesson tomorrow?
he bilan: 'U keladi' — will ga -s qo'shamizmi?
He will come — yo'q
notes: Kelasi zamon oson ko'rinadi, shuning uchun o'quvchilar be ni tushirib qoldiradi. Doskaga: WILL ≠ WILL BE. 'I will a teacher' ni ochiq xato qilib yozing va o'quvchilar to'g'rilasin.

will va going to farqi A1 uchun qiyin: bugun faqat 1 CCQ ('I'll help you' — hozir qaror qildimi? — Ha). Qoida: oldindan reja → going to; hozirgi qaror/taxmin/va'da → will. 'will yoki going to?' mashqi — ZAXIRA.
'I'll' qisqartmasini og'zaki nutqda ishlating: I'll help you. Yozuvda ham ruxsat.
'Will you…?' — iltimos ma'nosi ham bor: Will you open the door? (bu keyinroq).
Lug'at — Common verbs 4 (Common verbs 1–4 — 7, 11, 18, 19-darslar). CORE — kundalik fe'llar; har birini will bilan gapda bering: I will check it tomorrow.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q.

Progress test 3 (pt3, L14–L18) — dars boshida 35 daqiqa; varaq va kalit tizimda. O'tish: >=70/100. 50–69 — xatolar varag'i va 7 kun ichida 70% dan past bo'limlarni qayta topshirish; <50 — ota-onaga xabar, 1 qo'shimcha mashg'ulot, 7 kun ichida to'liq qayta topshirish. Guruhdan chiqarilmaydi; qayta topshirishda ham <50 — rahbar bilan suhbat. Tahlil — 20-darsda.
mistakes: I will be not at home.
I will not be at home. / I won't be at home.

how: Common verbs 4 — fe'llarning oxirgi qismi. CORE — kundalik A1/A2 fe'llar; STRONG/SUPER — qiyinroq fe'llar (ixtiyoriy, jamlanma 40/60). Mashq: har CORE fe'l bilan will-gap va tarjima: I will check my answers. — Men javoblarimni tekshiraman.
strong: Connect the phone to the wifi.
The dog was attacking the cat.
The sun will rise at 6 tomorrow.
super: Bu ish ingliz tilini talab qiladi.
He was suffering from a headache.
U bosh og'rig'idan azob chekayotgan edi.
Why are you staring at me?
We will purchase a new car.
The teacher will assess our tests.
I dream of a big house.
normativ: Ovozli (Telegram, L20 gacha): CORE 20 fe'l — har biri + o'z gapi (will bilan) + tarjima, 2 daqiqa — 1 coin ('ovozli_normativ' cheki: 3 band).
Yozma (L20 boshida): CORE 20 fe'l o'zbekcha beriladi, 5 daqiqada inglizchasini yozish; 3 tagacha imlo xatosi (so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato) — 2 coin.
Ixtiyoriy, jamlanma: 40 ta (CORE + STRONG) — yozma 10 daqiqa (+2 coin); 60 ta (+ SUPER) — yozma 15 daqiqa (+3 coin).

class_ex.title: Progress test 3 (L14–L18): ustoz uchun o'tkazish tartibi va ball jadvali
class_ex.instr: Test 19-darsda, 35 daqiqa, jami 100 ball. Qamrov — faqat 14–18-darslar: was/were, past simple (to'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar, didn't + V1, Did … + V1?), past continuous + when/while, bog'lovchilar and/but/so/because/when; lug'at — Common adjectives 3, Family and relatives, Irregular verbs 1–2, Common verbs 3. Barcha matn va skriptlar original.
items: 1. Darsdan oldin: Variant A varag'ini (Listening savollari, Grammatika A–D, Lug'at 1–2, Reading matni va savollari, Writing — 8 qatorli joy) har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa + guruh uchun 2 ta zaxira nusxa chop eting. Ball varag'ini guruh ro'yxati bilan chop eting. Variant B (qayta topshirish uchun) va barcha kalitlar o'quvchilarga ko'rsatilmaydi.

2. Boshlashdan oldin (2 daqiqa, 35 daqiqaga kirmaydi): telefonlar yig'iladi, partalar alohida, varaqqa ism va sana yoziladi. 'O'quvchi uchun yo'riqnoma' ni ovoz chiqarib o'qing yoki proyektorga chiqaring.

3. Proyektorga FAQAT yo'riqnoma, taymer va joriy bo'lim nomi chiqariladi. Listening skripti, kalitlar, reading javoblari va namuna javob proyektorga CHIQMAYDI — test davomida 'Javobni ko'rsat' tugmasini bosmang.

4. 0–5 daqiqa — LISTENING (hamma birga): o'quvchilar 30 soniya savollarni o'qiydi; ustoz skriptni o'rtacha tezlikda, aniq talaffuz bilan 2 marta o'qiydi (orasida 15 soniya pauza); 2-o'qishdan keyin 1 daqiqa javob yozishga.

5. 5–18 daqiqa — GRAMMATIKA A–D (13 daqiqa). 18–24 — LUG'AT 1–2 (6 daqiqa). 24–29 — READING (5 daqiqa). 29–35 — WRITING (6 daqiqa). Har bo'lim oxiridan 1 daqiqa oldin ogohlantiring va keyingi bo'limga o'tishni ayting; varaq yig'ilmaydi, lekin ortga qaytish faqat oxirgi daqiqalarda.
6. Test vaqtida ustoz savol mazmunini tushuntirmaydi, tarjima qilmaydi — faqat ko'rsatmani o'zbekcha takrorlashi mumkin. Ko'chirish aniqlansa — o'sha bo'lim 0 ball, sababi ball varag'iga yoziladi.

7. Tekshirish — Grammatika (50): har javob 2 ball. A va D — faqat to'liq to'g'ri so'z (bosh harf talab qilinmaydi). B — didn't + V1 va Did … + V1 ikkala qismi to'g'ri bo'lsa 2 ball; 'didn't went', 'Did you saw' — 0 ball; qo'shimcha to'g'ri, lekin bitta harf xatosi (studyed, stoped) — 1 ball. C — har gapda 2 ta fe'l, har biri 1 ball (was/were + V-ing yoki V2). C da uzoq davom etgan (fon) ish — faqat was/were + V-ing qabul qilinadi; 'my sisters watched', 'I did my homework' kabi javob — o'sha fe'l uchun 0 ball.
8. Tekshirish — Lug'at (20): har so'z 1 ball; bitta harf xatosi — 0.5; ikki va undan ko'p — 0. V1 → V2 jadvalida learnt/learned ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

9. Tekshirish — Listening (10) va Reading (10): har savol 2 ball. Listening bo'shliqlarida raqam yoki so'z (7 / seven) ikkalasi to'g'ri; ma'noni buzmaydigan imlo xatosi (dificult) — 2 ball. Reading: faqat TRUE/FALSE (T/F yozsa ham qabul).

10. Tekshirish — Writing (10): writing_a1 rubrikasi bo'yicha 4 mezon × 0–5 = 20 ball, so'ng × 0.5 (masalan, 15/20 → 7.5). Avval gaplarni sanang (5–6), past simple fe'llarni va bog'lovchilarni belgilang (kamida 2 ta: and/but/so/because/when).

11. Natija tizimga bo'limlar kesimida (Grammatika, Lug'at, Listening, Reading, Writing) test kunining o'zida yoki ertasi kuni kiritiladi. 20-darsda ishlar qaytariladi va eng ko'p takrorlangan 3 ta xato (odatda: you was, didn't went, when/while da zamon) 5 daqiqa sinfda tahlil qilinadi.
answers: 70–100 — O'TDI → guruh bilan 20-darsdan davom etadi. Xatolar 20-darsdagi tahlilda ko'riladi.

50–69 — QAYTA TOPSHIRISH → o'quvchi 'xatolar varag'i' ni to'ldiradi (har xato: noto'g'ri javob → to'g'ri javob → qoida, o'zbekcha 1 gap) va 7 kun ichida FAQAT o'z maksimumining 70% idan past bo'limlarni Variant B dan qayta topshiradi: Grammatika < 35/50, Lug'at < 14/20, Listening < 7/10, Reading < 7/10, Writing < 7/10. Yangi bo'lim bali eskisining o'rniga yoziladi.

0–49 — ota-onaga xabar beriladi (ustoz yoki administrator, test kunidan 2 kun ichida) → 1 ta qo'shimcha (remedial) mashg'ulot (30–40 daqiqa, eng zaif 2 bo'lim: was/were va didn't + V1 formulalari, V1 → V2 jadvali, when/while vaqt chizig'i) → so'ng 7 kun ichida Variant B to'liq (35 daqiqa) qayta topshiriladi.
Guruhdan chiqarish YO'Q. Qayta topshirishda ham jami < 50 bo'lsa — o'quvchi va ota-ona rahbar bilan suhbatga chaqiriladi (takror guruh — IELTS 1.0 ni qaytadan o'qish taklifi).

class_ex.title: O'quvchi uchun yo'riqnoma (Progress test 3)
items: 1. The test is 35 minutes, 100 points, 5 parts. (Test 35 daqiqa, 100 ball, 5 bo'lim.)
2. Order: Listening (5 min) → Grammar (13 min) → Vocabulary (6 min) → Reading (5 min) → Writing (6 min). (Tartib: Listening → Grammatika → Lug'at → Reading → Writing.)
3. Write your name and the date at the top. Use a pen. (Varaqning yuqorisiga ism va sanani yozing. Ruchka bilan yozing.)
4. No phones, no talking, no dictionaries. (Telefon, gaplashish va lug'at mumkin emas.)
5. 70 points or more — you pass. (70 ball va undan ko'p — o'tdingiz.)

reading.title: Our trip to Samarkand
text: Next Saturday my class will go to Samarkand. We will leave Bekobod at 6 in the morning by bus. The trip will take four hours, so I will take a book and my headphones.

homework.title: MAJBURIY — WRITING — My daily routine (qoralama)
homework.instr: 60–80 so'z (8–10 gap) yozing; tarjimon va boshqa birovning yordamisiz. Qoralamani keyingi darsgacha ilovada ustozga yuboring — ustoz xatolarni belgilab qaytaradi (draft_check_a1). Tuzating va uyda 10 daqiqada qaramasdan yozib mashq qiling. L20 — WRITING NORMATIV, L21 — SPEAKING NORMATIV.
items: 1) Ertalab — turish vaqti + 3 ish: I get up at … First I … Then I …
2) Maktab — qachon, qanday boriladi: At … I go to school by bus / on foot.
4) Kechqurun va uxlash vaqti: In the evening I … I go to bed at …
5) Dam olish kuni farqi: On Sundays I …
Shart: kamida 4 ta vaqt (at seven o'clock, at half past …), 3 ta chastota ravishi (always, usually, sometimes, never), 2 ta bog'lovchi (and, but, so, because).
answers: Namuna (faqat ustozga; WRITING bosqichida 1 marta ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi, nusxa tarqatilmaydi): I usually get up at half past six. First I wash my face and brush my teeth. Then I have breakfast with my family. I always eat bread and eggs. At half past seven I go to school by bus. After school I have lunch and do my homework. I sometimes play football with my friends. In the evening I watch TV. I go to bed at ten because I am tired. On Sundays I get up at nine. (79 so'z)

Tekshirish: (1) so'zni sanang — 60–80; 5 reja bandi, 4 vaqt, 3 chastota ravishi, 2 bog'lovchi bormi. (2) writing_a1 ning 4 mezoni, har biri 0–5: Topshiriqni bajarish / Grammatika / Lug'at va imlo / Gap tuzilishi va bog'lanish. (3) Normativ (L20) >=14/20.

Qoralamaga faqat draft_check_a1 belgilari yoziladi (to'g'ri javob yozib berilmaydi): G — grammatika (masalan 'I gets up' → I get up), Sp — imlo, WO — so'z tartibi ('I get always up' → I always get up — chastota ravishi asosiy fe'ldan oldin; 'I every day get up' → I get up every day — vaqt iborasi gap oxirida), ^ — so'z tushib qolgan, P — bosh harf/tinish belgisi, ? — ma'no tushunarsiz, ✓ — yaxshi ibora.
Grammatika chegarasi: present simple (I), chastota ravishlari, vaqt (at … o'clock / half past), by bus / on foot, and / but / so / because. Bugungi will talab qilinmaydi (mavzu — har kungi odatlar).

YANGI MAVZU — Conditionals 0/1
Kontekst: If you heat ice, it melts (doim) va If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home (ertaga). Zero: If + present, present; First: If + present, will + V1. Vergul; if dan keyin will yo'q. CCQ.
LUG'AT — Common nouns 2
Rasm -> so'z -> jo'r takror; xona bo'yicha: living room / bedroom / kitchen. Har so'z bilan if-gap: If you are tired, sit on a chair.
KOMBINATSIYA

2 formula × 2 tartib; +, –, ? + tarjima: I — have time, call you -> If I have time, I will call you -> If I don't have time, I won't call you -> Will you call me if you have time? 1.5 daq: 2 aylana — 1, 3 — 2 coin.

Majburiy: 1–4 (tanlash 3, zero 5, first 6, zanjir o'yini 6 daqiqa); 2–3-mashqda sinfda 1–5-bandlar. ZAXIRA: 5 (tarjima). ICQ: 'Nechta gap? Yakkami, juftlikdami?' Kuchli — 4-mashqda zanjirni boshlaydi.
READING — If it rains on Sunday
Glossary doskada. O'quvchilar o'zi o'qiydi -> 1-topshiriq (T/F) -> 2-topshiriq (savol-javob) -> 3-topshiriq (zero yoki first). Javoblar matndan asoslanadi.

intro: CONDITIONAL — shartli gap: IF (agar) qatnashgan gaplar. Ikki qism: if-qism (shart) va asosiy qism (natija).
ZERO CONDITIONAL — doim to'g'ri narsalar, tabiat qonunlari, odatlar: If + present simple, present simple. If the sun shines, ice melts (quyosh charaqlasa, muz eriydi). If I am tired, I sleep.
FIRST CONDITIONAL — kelajakdagi real shart: If + present simple, will + V1. If he comes, we will go to the park (u kelsa, parkka boramiz). If it rains, I will stay at home.
Tartib: if-qism oldinda → VERGUL: If it rains, I will stay. If-qism orqada → vergulsiz: I will stay if it rains.
MUHIM: if dan keyin will YO'Q, present simple: If it WILL rain — XATO; If it rains — to'g'ri. He/she/it da -s esdan chiqmasin: If he comes.
formulas: If the sun shines, ice melts.
Ice melts if the sun shines.
If he comes, we will go to the park.
We will go to the park if he comes.
If you don't study, you won't pass.
What will you do if it rains?

notes: Zero va first farqini oddiy bering: zero — 'doim shunday' (fizika, odat), first — 'ertaga bo'lsa'. Chuqur nazariya kerak emas.
Kitobdagi Level 22 mashqlari — IXTIYORIY (kuchli o'quvchilarga uyda); sinfda tizimdagi 1–4-mashqlar yetarli (5 — ZAXIRA). Kuchsiz o'quvchiga doskadagi jadvalga qarab ishlashga ruxsat bering.
'If' ni 18-darsda o'tilgan 'when' bilan adashtirmang: if — shart, bo'lishi noaniq (agar …sa), when — vaqt (…ganda).

Zero yoki first — ma'noga qarab: umumiy haqiqat — zero (If you don't water plants, they die), aniq holat yoki ogohlantirish — first (If you don't water your plants this week, they will die). Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri; 2- va 3-mashqning 8-bandidagi 'eat too much' gaplari shuni ko'rsatadi.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Bugun 2 formula × 2 tartib (if oldinda / orqada). First: I — have time, call you -> If I have time, I will call you — Vaqtim bo'lsa, senga qo'ng'iroq qilaman -> If I don't have time, I won't call you — Vaqtim bo'lmasa, senga qo'ng'iroq qilmayman -> Will you call me if you have time? — Vaqting bo'lsa, menga qo'ng'iroq qilasanmi? Zero: you heat ice — it melts -> If you heat ice, it melts -> If you don't heat ice, it doesn't melt -> Does ice melt if you heat it? Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ — 1.5 daqiqada 2 aylana = 1 coin, 3 aylana = 2 coin.

class_ex.title: Zero conditional
class_ex.type: To'ldirish (yakka, 5 daqiqa; sinfda 1–5-bandlar, 6–8 — kuchli o'quvchilarga yoki uyga)
class_ex.instr: Present simple bilan to'ldiring (umumiy haqiqat).
items: If you heat water to 100 degrees, it ______ (boil).
If the sun sets, it ______ (get) dark.
If you mix red and blue, you ______ (get) purple.
If you drop a glass, it ______ (break).
If you don't water plants, they ______ (die).
If he ______ (eat) too much, he feels sick.

class_ex.title: First conditional
class_ex.type: To'ldirish (juftlikda, 6 daqiqa; sinfda 1–5-bandlar, 6–8 — kuchli o'quvchilarga yoki uyga)
class_ex.instr: If-qismda present simple, asosiy qismda will.
items: If it ______ (rain) tomorrow, I ______ (stay) at home.
If she ______ (pass) the exam, she ______ (be) happy.
If they ______ (not / leave) now, they ______ (miss) the bus.
If the train ______ (arrive) on time, we ______ (catch) it.
If you ______ (eat) too much, you ______ (feel) sick.
class_ex.note: Sinfda 1–5-bandlar majburiy; 6–8 — tez tugatganlarga. 8-band: 'If you eat too much, you will feel sick' (aniq holat, first) ham, 2-mashqning 8-bandidagi 'If he eats too much, he feels sick' (odat, zero) ham to'g'ri — ma'no farqini so'rang.

class_ex.title: Zanjir (chain) o'yini
class_ex.instr: 1-o'quvchi: 'If it is sunny tomorrow, I will go to the park.' 2-o'quvchi natijani shartga aylantiradi: 'If I go to the park, I will play football.' 3-o'quvchi: 'If I play football, I will be tired.' … Zanjir uzilmasin! 10 ta gap — hammaga 1 coin. Oxirida ustoz eshitgan 2–3 xatoni doskaga yozadi, sinf tuzatadi.
answers: Namuna zanjir: If it is sunny tomorrow, I will go to the park. -> If I go to the park, I will play football. -> If I play football, I will be tired. -> If I am tired, I will go to bed early. -> If I go to bed early, I will get up early. -> If I get up early, I will have a big breakfast.
Tekshiruv: if-qismda present simple (will yo'q), natijada will + V1; if-qism oldinda — vergul.

class_ex.title: WRITING NORMATIV — My daily routine
class_ex.instr: 60–80 so'z, 10 daqiqa. Qoralama, daftar, telefon — mumkin emas. Sarlavha yozilmaydi. Tugagach so'zlarni sanab, oxiriga yozing.
items: 1. What time do you get up? What do you do in the morning? (First… Then…)
2. When do you go to school? How do you go there? (by bus / on foot)
3. What do you do after school?
4. What do you do in the evening? What time do you go to bed?
5. What is different at the weekend? (On Sundays I…)
Shart: kamida 4 ta vaqt (at seven o'clock, at half past…), 3 ta chastota ravishi (always, usually, sometimes…), 2 ta bog'lovchi (and, but, so, because).
answers: Namuna (L19 qoralama namunasi, ustoz uchun; 79 so'z): I usually get up at half past six. First I wash my face and brush my teeth. Then I have breakfast with my family. I always eat bread and eggs. At half past seven I go to school by bus. After school I have lunch and do my homework. I sometimes play football with my friends. In the evening I watch TV. I go to bed at ten because I am tired. On Sundays I get up at nine.
Ixtiyoriy plus: if-gap (bugungi mavzu) — masalan: If it rains, I go to school by bus. Majburiy emas; to'g'ri ishlatilsa Grammatika mezonida hisobga olinadi, xato bo'lsa ball kamaytirilmaydi.

Tekshirish tartibi: (1) so'zlarni sanang (60–80; 48 dan kam bo'lsa Topshiriq mezoni 3 dan yuqori bo'lmaydi); (2) writing_a1 ning 4 mezoni bo'yicha 0–5 ball: Topshiriq (5 reja bandi, 4 vaqt) / Grammatika (I + V1, -s qo'shilmaydi; chastota ravishi o'rni) / Lug'at va imlo / Gap tuzilishi (bosh harf, nuqta; and, but, so, because kamida 2 marta); (3) yig'indi 0–20.

Natija: >=14/20 — normativ + XP. <14 — xatolar draft_check_a1 belgilari bilan qaytariladi, o'quvchi tuzatib keyingi dars ZAXIRA vaqtida yoki darsdan keyin qayta yozadi (SPEAKING NORMATIV — My daily routine baribir L21 da).
class_ex.note: Manba: rahbar rejasi (IELTS 1.0 xlsx — 7 ta writing normativ), IELTS 1.0 kitobidagi writing normativ qoidasi. Namuna — original (L19 qoralama namunasi).

reading.title: If it rains on Sunday
text: My family always makes plans for Sunday, but our plans depend on the weather. If it is sunny, we go to the park and have a picnic. My father plays football with my brother and my mother reads under a tree. If it is very hot, we go to the swimming pool.
If it rains, we stay at home. My mother cooks something delicious and we watch a film together. If there is no electricity, we play chess by candlelight!

This Sunday my cousins from Tashkent will come. If they come in the morning, we will go to the mountains. If they come late, we will stay in the city and visit the museum. If they don't come, I will be sad — but I will call them and we will talk a lot.
What will you do this Sunday if it is sunny?

lessons.title: SUBJECT vs OBJECT PRONOUNS + LIKE / WOULD LIKE
lessons.grammar_topic: Ega olmoshlari (I, you, he…) va to'ldiruvchi olmoshlari (me, you, him…); like + V-ing/noun, would like + to V/noun
lessons.book_ref: Student's book (ixtiyoriy): Level 18 (me/you/him mashqlari), Level 19 (like / would like), Sports and exercise (50), Reading Topic 36–43; Teacher's book: Lesson 17.
objectives: Ega olmoshi (I, you, he, she, it, we, they) gap BOSHIDA, to'ldiruvchi olmoshi (me, you, him, her, it, us, them) fe'l/predlogdan KEYIN kelishini biladi.
'He knows me', 'I play with them', 'Give it to her' kabi gaplarni to'g'ri tuzadi.
Otni olmoshga almashtiradi: 'Lisa called John' → 'She called him'.
with / for / to dan keyin doim object pronoun kelishini biladi (with them, for us).
20 ta CORE sport so'zini biladi; 'My daily routine' haqida ≈1 daqiqa gapiradi (speaking_a1 >=11/15).
like (umuman yoqtiraman) va would like (hozir xohlayman) farqini biladi: I like tea. I would like a cup of tea.

YANGI MAVZU — Subject/object pronouns + like/would like

intro: SUBJECT PRONOUN — ega olmoshi: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Gapning EGASI — doim gap boshida. OBJECT PRONOUN — to'ldiruvchi olmoshi: me, you, him, her, it, us, them — fe'ldan yoki predlogdan KEYIN, gap o'rtasida/oxirida.
Tarjimada farq: I — men, me — meni/menga; he — u, him — uni/unga; they — ular, them — ularni/ularga.

Ko'p uchraydigan xato: 'I play with THEM' — o'zbekchada 'ular bilan' (ular = they deb o'ylab xato qilinadi). Predlogdan keyin (with, for, to, about) DOIM object pronoun: with them, for us, to me, about her.
You va it ikkala ustunda bir xil: You love me — I love you. It is nice — I like it.

LIKE — yoqtirmoq, yaxshi ko'rmoq (umuman, doim): I like football. I like playing football (like + V-ing). WOULD LIKE — xohlamoq (hozir, muloyim): I would like a hamburger. I would like to play football (would like + to + V).
Qisqartma: I'd like = I would like. Savol: Would you like…? (muloyim taklif) — javob: Yes, please. / No, thank you. 'Do you like…?' esa umuman yoqtirish haqida: Do you like tea? — Yes, I do.
would like hamma ega bilan bir xil: I'd like, he'd like, they'd like (would o'zgarmaydi, -s yo'q).
formulas: I / you / he / she / it / we / they + verb
I am clever. She plants flowers. They call clients.
Men aqlliman. U gul ekadi. Ular mijozlarga qo'ng'iroq qiladi.
verb + me / you / him / her / it / us / them
He knows me. I respect her. People call them.
U meni biladi. Men uni hurmat qilaman. Odamlar ularga qo'ng'iroq qiladi.
with / for / to / about + object pronoun
I play with them. He takes gifts for us. Give it to me.
Men ular bilan o'ynayman. U biz uchun sovg'a oladi. Uni menga ber.
She loves him. We help them. They know us.
U uni sevadi. Biz ularga yordam beramiz. Ular bizni biladi.
Lisa called John. → She called him.
The teacher praised the students. → She praised them.
Ustoz o'quvchilarni maqtadi. → U ularni maqtadi.
I like hamburgers. She likes football.
Men gamburgerni yoqtiraman. U futbolni yoqtiradi.
I like playing football. He likes reading.
Men futbol o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman. U o'qishni yaxshi ko'radi.
S + would like ('d like) + noun / to + V1
I would like a cup of tea. She'd like to play tennis.
Men bir piyola choy xohlayman. U tennis o'ynashni xohlaydi.
Would you like + noun / to + V1? — Yes, please. / No, thank you.
Would you like some juice? — Yes, please. Would you like to play chess? — No, thank you.
Sharbat xohlaysizmi? — Ha, iltimos. Shaxmat o'ynashni xohlaysizmi? — Yo'q, rahmat.
presentation: Bugungi mavzu nomi? Subject pronoun nima degani?
Subject vs object pronouns; ega olmoshi
Gapning egasi gapning qayerida? Demak ega olmoshlari qayerda?
Boshida; boshida
Object pronoun tarjimasi? To'ldiruvchi gapning qayerida?
To'ldiruvchi olmoshi; o'rtasida/oxirida, fe'ldan keyin
Jadvalga qarang: 'men' — I; 'meni, menga' — ? Qanaqa qo'shimcha qo'shildi?
me; -ni, -ga
'U meni biladi'? Ega qaysi? Nega? Object qaysi? Nega?
He knows me; He — gap boshida; me — fe'ldan keyin
Common errors: 'Men ular bilan o'ynayman'? Nega them, they emas?
I play with them; gap oxirida, predlogdan keyin
Qaysi so'zlardan keyin ehtiyot bo'lamiz?
with, for, to, about — predloglar
'U biz uchun sovg'a oladi'?
He takes gifts for us
'Lisa called John' — otlarni olmoshga almashtiring
She called him
you va it — ikkala ustunda qanday?
Bir xil: you/you, it/it
Bugungi mavzu? like tarjimasi?
Would like vs like; yoqtirmoq
'Men futbol o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman'? like dan keyin fe'l kelsa nima qo'shamiz?
I like playing football; -ing
Fe'lsiz: 'Men gamburgerni yoqtiraman'? 'Futbolni yoqtiraman'?
I like hamburgers. I like football.
would like tarjimasi? Undan keyin fe'l kelsa oldiga nima qo'yamiz?
xohlamoq; to
'I like tea' — hozir choy so'rayapmanmi yoki umuman yoqtiramanmi? 'I'd like tea' chi? 'Would you like tea?' ga javob?
umuman yoqtiraman; hozir xohlayman (so'rov); Yes, please. / No, thank you.
notes: Bu mavzuda boshlovchilar eng ko'p adashadi: doskadagi ikki ustunni rangli qilib dars oxirigacha qoldiring; har gapda o'quvchi 'ega qani? to'ldiruvchi qani?' deb topsin.
'Me and my friend go…' (og'zaki AmE) — o'rgatmang; 'My friend and I go…'.

Kombinatsiya va mashqlarda xatoga to'xtatmang — oxirida 2–3 tipik xatoni doskada birga tuzating. Differensiatsiya: kuchsizlarga jadval doskada va 3-mashq (tanlash); kuchlilarga ZAXIRA 5-mashq va o'zi haqida 'I like … / I'd like …' 2 gap.
Sport lug'ati bilan bog'lash: 'Do you like football? — Yes, I like IT. I play IT with THEM.'
mistakes: Would you like tea? — Yes, I do.

how: CORE 20 — majburiy; STRONG va SUPER — ixtiyoriy. Har so'zni object pronoun bilan ishlating: 'Chess? I play it with him.'
core: Do you like basketball? — I love it!
Basketbolni yoqtirasanmi? — Men uni juda yaxshi ko'raman!
I jog with her every morning.
Men u bilan har kuni ertalab yengil yuguraman.
They work out at the gym.
Our team is strong. I love it.
Jamoamiz kuchli. Men uni yaxshi ko'raman.
strong: He has a lot of strength.
There is a competition on Sunday.
Our team is in the tournament.
I do a workout every day.
They want to win the tournament.
We play ping pong at school.
super: He wants to break a record.
Har kuni o'zingga qiyin vazifa qo'y!
We have fun at the stadium.
He scores a goal every game.
normativ: Ovozli (Telegram): CORE 20 — so'z + o'z gapi (5 tasida object pronoun: 'I play it with them') + tarjima, 2 daqiqa; 22-darsgacha — 1 coin (ovozli_normativ cheki).
Yozma — 22-dars boshida, 5 daqiqa: o'zbekcha 20 so'z -> inglizcha, 3 tagacha imlo xatosi — 2 coin. STRONG/SUPER — ixtiyoriy (jamlanma 40/60).

class_ex.title: SPEAKING NORMATIV — My daily routine
class_ex.instr: Savollar proyektorda. Har o'quvchi ≈1 daqiqa qoralamaga qaramasdan gapiradi (savollar — reja); to'xtab qolsa ustoz shu ro'yxatdan 1–2 yordamchi savol beradi. Kutayotganlar: sinfdoshidan 1 ta yaxshi gap va 1 ta xatoni yozib boradi.
items: 1. What time do you usually get up?
2. What do you do in the morning?
3. How do you go to school?
4. What do you do after school?
5. What do you usually do in the evening?
6. What do you do at the weekend?
answers: Namuna javob (A1, ≈1 daqiqa): On weekdays I get up at seven o'clock. First I make my bed, then I wash my face and get dressed. I have breakfast with my family. I usually eat eggs and bread. I go to school on foot because it is near my house. After school I have lunch and I do my homework. I sometimes help my mother in the kitchen. In the evening I often watch TV. I go to bed at half past ten. At the weekend I get up late.
O'tish: speaking_a1 >=11/15 — normativ + XP; <11 — keyingi dars boshida yoki ilovada ovozli (48 soat ichida, o'sha rubrika).
Tartib: 1' tushuntirish + har o'quvchi ≈1 daqiqa; 10 kishidan ko'p bo'lsa qolganlar ZAXIRA mashq vaqti hisobidan yoki keyingi dars Salomlashish vaqtida (3 tagacha), qolgani ilovada ovozli.

Eslatma: namunada bugungi yangi grammatika (object pronouns, would like) talab qilinmaydi — normativ YANGI MAVZU dan oldin o'tadi; o'quvchi L19 qoralamasi va L20 WRITING NORMATIV dagi o'z matnini og'zaki aytadi. Tekshiring: present simple (I), vaqt (at seven o'clock), chastota ravishlari (usually, often, sometimes), bog'lovchilar (first, then, because).
class_ex.note: Zanjir: L19 qoralama → L20 WRITING NORMATIV → L21 SPEAKING NORMATIV (My daily routine). Manba: rahbar xlsx (IELTS 1.0 Speaking/Writing mavzulari), kitob qoidasi (avval writing, keyin speaking); namuna javob original.

reading.book_ref: Kitob (ixtiyoriy): Reading Topic 36–43 (uyga). Pastdagi matn — sinfda.
reading.title: My team
text: My name is Jasur. I play football for the school team. Our coach is Mr Karimov. He is strict, but we love him. He teaches us a lot and he never shouts at us.
My best friend Bobur is in the team, too. He is a goalkeeper. The ball never gets past him! I play with him every day and I learn a lot from him.
We train three times a week. First we warm up, then we do push-ups and run. After training we cool down and the coach talks to us about the game.

On Saturday there is a big tournament. Our parents always come and watch us. My mother doesn't understand football, but she loves it because I play it! Do we win? Not always. But we always have fun, and that is important for us.

answers: No, he never shouts at them.
No, it never gets past him.

tasks.title: Olmoshlarni toping
tasks.instr: Matndagi barcha object pronounlarni toping va har biri kimni/nimani bildirishini yozing (him = Mr Karimov). Keyin matndagi subject pronounlarni (4 xil) yozing.
answers: him — 4 marta: Mr Karimov (we love him), Bobur (past him, with him, from him).
us — 5 marta: jamoa / o'yinchilar (teaches us, shouts at us, talks to us, watch us, for us).
it — 2 marta: football (she loves it, I play it).
Subject: I (Jasur), he (Mr Karimov; Bobur), we (jamoa), she (Jasurning onasi).

transcript: ADMIN: Hello! Welcome to Star Sports Club.
TIMUR: Hi! Yes, I'd like to join a team.
ADMIN: Great. What's your name?
TIMUR: Timur Rakhimov. That's R-A-K-H-I-M-O-V.
ADMIN: How old are you, Timur?
TIMUR: I'm fifteen.
ADMIN: Which sport would you like to play?
TIMUR: I like football, but my friends play basketball. I play with them after school. So I'd like to join the basketball team.
ADMIN: Good. The team trains on Wednesday at five. Come early and warm up with them.
TIMUR: Wednesday is fine for me.
ADMIN: And your phone number?
TIMUR: It's 90 314 27 58.
ADMIN: Would you like to try swimming too? It keeps you fit.
TIMUR: No, thank you. I don't like swimming. But I'd like a club T-shirt, please!
ADMIN: Here you are. See you on Wednesday!

homework.title: MAJBURIY — WRITING — My home (qoralama)
homework.instr: 60–80 so'z (8–10 gap) yozing; tarjimon va boshqa birovning yordamisiz. Qoralamani keyingi darsgacha ilovada ustozga yuboring — ustoz xatolarni belgilab qaytaradi (draft_check_a1). Tuzating va uyda 10 daqiqada qaramasdan yozib mashq qiling. L22 — WRITING NORMATIV, L23 — SPEAKING NORMATIV.
items: 1) Qayerda, uy yoki kvartira: I live in a house / flat in … It is near …
3) Mehmonxona / oshxonada nima bor — there is / are + 2 ta o'rin predlogi (on, next to, opposite — L06): There is … on … / There are … next to …
4) Mening xonam — 2–3 gap: My room is … There is …
5) Fikr: I like my room because … / I would like …
answers: Namuna (faqat ustozga; WRITING bosqichida 1 marta ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi, nusxa tarqatilmaydi): I live in a house in Samarkand. It is near my school. There are five rooms in our house: a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom and two bedrooms. The living room is big. There is a TV on the wall and there is a carpet on the floor. My room is small but nice. There is a bed next to the window and there is a desk opposite the door. I like my room because it is quiet. (79 so'z)

Sifat OT bilan (my book), olmosh OT O'RNIDA (mine). Jadval: my/mine, your/yours, his/his, her/hers, its/—, our/ours, their/theirs. its ≠ it's. Whose…? CCQ — presentation.
