intro: SIFAT otni tasvirlaydi va OT BILAN keladi; OLMOSH otning O'RNIDA keladi. Egalik shakllarida ham shunday.
POSSESSIVE ADJECTIVE (egalik sifati) + OT: my book (mening kitobim), your house, her pet, his friend, its tyre, our car, their toys.

POSSESSIVE PRONOUN (egalik olmoshi) — OTSIZ, '-niki': This book is mine (meniki). That house is yours (seniki). The cat is hers (uniki). The dog is his (uniki). This car is ours (bizniki). These toys are theirs (ularniki).
Jadval: my → mine | your → yours | his → his | her → hers | its → (yo'q) | our → ours | their → theirs. his ikkalasida bir xil; its ning olmoshi yo'q.
its (uning — egalik) ≠ it's (it is / it has). The car lost its tyre. / It's my car.
Savol: Whose book is this? (kimniki?) — It's mine. / It's Aziz's. Whose is this? — Hers.
Ikki tomonini yodlang: TARJIMASI va undan keyin NIMA KELISHI (ot bormi, yo'qmi).

notes: Doskada ikki ustun: chapda sifat + OT (my book), o'ngda olmosh + NUQTA (mine.). O'quvchi 'mine book' desa — o'ng ustunga ishora qiling.
'Whose?' savolini kiriting — olmoshlar javobda tabiiy chiqadi: Whose pen is this? — Mine!
Sifatlar revision — 'My family' matnini boyitish uchun: 'My mother is caring and reliable.'
EXIT TEST — 28-darsda: yozma 45 daqiqa (L01–L27) + speaking; o'tish >=70%. Bugun eslating: har darsning grammatikasi va CORE 20 so'zini takrorlash boshlanadi.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Bugun formula ikkita (sifat + ot / olmosh otsiz), shuning uchun har bosqichda 2 gap. Namuna: she — bag -> This is her bag — Bu uning sumkasi / This bag is hers — Bu sumka uniki -> This isn't her bag — Bu uning sumkasi emas / This bag isn't hers — Bu sumka uniki emas -> Is this her bag? — Bu uning sumkasimi? / Is this bag hers? — Bu sumka unikimi? Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ — 1.5 daqiqada 2 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 3 aylana = 2 coin.

ICQ (mashqdan oldin): 'Nechta gap? Yakkami, juftlikdami? Qavsdagi qismni nima bilan almashtiramiz?' 4-mashq (Whose is it?) va juftlik ishida xatolarni to'xtatmasdan yozib boring, oxirida 3 tasini doskada birga tuzating.

class_ex.instr: 60–80 so'z, 10 daqiqa. Qoralama, daftar, telefon — mumkin emas. Sarlavha yozilmaydi. Tugagach so'zlarni sanab, oxiriga yozing.
items: 1. Do you live in a house or a flat? Where is it?
2. How many rooms are there? What are they?
3. What is there in your living room or kitchen? (there is / there are + 2 ta o'rin predlogi: on, next to, opposite)
4. What is your room like? (2–3 gap)

answers: Namuna (L21 qoralama namunasi, ustoz uchun; 79 so'z): I live in a house in Samarkand. It is near my school. There are five rooms in our house: a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom and two bedrooms. The living room is big. There is a TV on the wall and there is a carpet on the floor. My room is small but nice. There is a bed next to the window and there is a desk opposite the door. I like my room because it is quiet.

Ixtiyoriy plus: would like (L21) bilan 1 gap — masalan: I would like a new lamp for my desk. Majburiy emas; bugungi yangi mavzu (mine/yours…) normativ YANGI MAVZU dan oldin bo'lgani uchun talab qilinmaydi.

reading.book_ref: Kitobdan (IXTIYORIY, uyga): Reading Topic 114–118. Pastdagi matn — sinfda.
reading.title: Two families, one street
text: The Karimovs and the Rahimovs live on the same street in Bukhara. Their houses are similar, but their families are very different.

My name is Dilnoza Karimova. Our family is big: my parents, my three brothers and me. My father is a doctor. He is calm and reliable. My mother is a teacher; she is cheerful and very organised. My brothers are sporty and a bit noisy — their room is always messy, but mine is tidy! Our grandmother lives with us. She is wise and talkative, and her plov is the best in the street.

Our neighbours, the Rahimovs, are a small family. Mr Rahimov is a driver. He is punctual and a little bossy. His wife is an artist; she is creative and easy-going. Their only son, Timur, is my age. He is curious and ambitious — he wants to be an engineer. Their cat, Murka, is naughty: yesterday she ate our fish! 'Her favourite food is fish,' Timur said. 'Sorry — it was yours, now it's hers!'

We are different, but we help each other. Their car is old and ours is new, so my father often drives them to the market. Our garden is small, so we have picnics in theirs. Good neighbours are like family.
glossary: help each other — bir-biriga yordam bermoq

intro: DETERMINERS (ko'rsatish olmoshlari) — narsani KO'RSATIB aytamiz: bu / anavi / bular / anavilar.
THIS + birlik (yaqin): This pen is mine — bu ruchka meniki. THAT + birlik (uzoq): That book belongs to my friend — anavi kitob do'stimniki.
THESE + ko'plik (yaqin): These shoes are comfortable — bu oyoq kiyimlar qulay. THOSE + ko'plik (uzoq): Those flowers are beautiful — anavi gullar chiroyli.
Yolg'iz ham keladi (otsiz): This is my bag. That is his car. These are my books. Those are their toys.
SAVOL: Is this your pen? — Yes, it is. / Are those your keys? — No, they aren't. What is this? What are those?
Vaqt bilan: this morning / this week / these days (yaqin vaqt); that day / those years (uzoq vaqt).
Telefonda: 'This is Aziz' (bu Aziz — o'zim), 'Is that Bobur?' (Boburmisiz? — telefondagi suhbatdosh).
A LOT OF + OT: I have a lot of friends (ko'p do'stlarim bor). Fe'l + A LOT (gap oxirida): I play football a lot (ko'p o'ynayman). 'A lot of' dan keyin doim ot keladi, 'a lot' dan keyin ot kelmaydi.

Bu oyoq kiyimlar qulay. / Anavi gullar chiroyli.
This is my bag. Those are their toys.
Bu mening sumkam. Anavilar ularning o'yinchoqlari.

notes: Sinfdagi real buyumlar bilan o'rgating: qo'lda — this/these; ko'rsatib uzoqda — that/those. 4 katakli jadvalni doskada qoldiring.
these [ðiːz] uzun, this [ðɪs] qisqa — talaffuzni aniq ajrating.
'This is' → 'This's' qisqarmaydi; 'That is' → 'That's' bo'ladi.
A LOT OF / A LOT: doskada 2 ustun — 'a lot of + OT' (a lot of books, a lot of water) va 'FE'L + a lot' (I read a lot). O'quvchi a lot dan keyin ot bor-yo'qligini tekshiradi: ot bor — of qo'shiladi.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Namuna: this — pen -> This is my pen — Bu mening ruchkam -> This isn't my pen — Bu mening ruchkam emas -> Is this my pen? — Bu mening ruchkammi? Ko'plik: those — keys -> Those are her keys — Anavilar uning kalitlari -> Those aren't her keys — Anavilar uning kalitlari emas -> Are those her keys? — Anavilar uning kalitlarimi? Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ — 1 daqiqada 3 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 4 aylana = 2 coin.

Progress test 4 — 24-dars boshida, 35 daqiqa (L19–L23): grammatika 50, lug'at 20, listening 10, reading 10, writing 10. O'tish >=70%. Takror: L19–L23 formulalari va CORE so'zlari; bugungi Common nouns 1 CORE so'zlari testning lug'at bo'limiga kiradi (alohida yozma normativ yo'q).

ICQ (har mashqdan oldin): 'Yakkami yoki juftlikdami? Necha daqiqa? These dan keyin birlikmi yoki ko'plik?' Speaking paytida xatolarni yozib boring, oxirida 3 tasini doskada birga tuzating (kechiktirilgan tuzatish).
mistakes: Are those your keys? — No, it isn't.
Are those your keys? — No, they aren't.
I have a lot of friends.

how: Common nouns 1 — kundalik buyumlar (CORE 20 — majburiy; STRONG/SUPER — ixtiyoriy). Har so'zni buyum yoki rasm bilan ko'rsating va this/that/these/those bilan gap tuzing: 'This is my wallet. Those are her keys.' Uy-ro'zg'or buyumlari 20-darsda (Common nouns 2) o'tilgan; kitob ro'yxati (Common nouns, 160) — ixtiyoriy.
core: I have a lot of photos on my mobile phone.
There is a bottle of water.
I'll drink a glass of milk.

reading.title: At the market
text: Seller: Good morning! Can I help you?
Nilufar: Yes, please. How much are these apples?
Seller: These are 15,000 soums a kilo. Those red ones over there are 20,000 — they're sweeter.
Nilufar: I'll take two kilos of these, please. And what is that? Is that a melon?
Seller: Yes, that's a melon from Khorezm. It's very sweet. This one is 30,000 and that big one is 45,000.
Nilufar: This one, please. Oh, and are those grapes fresh?
Seller: Of course! I picked them this morning. Have a look — try one.
Nilufar: Mmm, delicious. Give me a kilo of those, too. How much is that altogether?
Seller: Two kilos of apples — 30,000, this melon — 30,000, and grapes — 25,000. That's 85,000 soums.
Nilufar: Here you are. Keep the change. Thank you!
Seller: Thank you! Come back soon!
glossary: Keep the change — qaytimi kerak emas

homework.title: MAJBURIY — WRITING — My family (qoralama)
homework.instr: 60–80 so'z (8–10 gap) yozing; tarjimon va boshqa birovning yordamisiz. Qoralamani keyingi darsgacha (L24 gacha) ilovada ustozga yuboring — ustoz xatolarni belgilab qaytaradi (draft_check_a1, L24 da qaytariladi). Tuzating va uyda 10 daqiqada qaramasdan yozib mashq qiling (L24 uy vazifasi). L25 — WRITING NORMATIV, L26 — SPEAKING NORMATIV.
items: Oilada necha kishi: There are … people in my family: …
Ota-ona — kasbi (Jobs, L04) + 2 ta xarakter sifati (L22 CORE: reliable, caring, cheerful, helpful, responsible…): My father is a… He is … and …
Aka-uka / opa-singil — yoshi, nimani yoqtiradi; kamida 2 ta egalik shakli (her room / mine, theirs…): My sister … is … She likes… Her … , but mine …
Birga nima qilasizlar + 1 ta past simple gap: We often… Last Sunday we…
Yakuniy fikr: I love my family.
answers: Namuna (80 so'z): There are five people in my family: my parents, my two sisters and me. My father is a doctor. He is reliable and responsible. My mother is a teacher. She is caring and cheerful. My older sister Nodira is seventeen. She is creative and she likes music. Her room is big, but mine is small. My little sister is six and she is very talkative. We often have dinner together. Last Sunday we visited our grandparents. I love my family.
Tekshirish: (1) so'zni sanang — 60–80; (2) writing_a1 ning 4 mezoni — Topshiriqni bajarish / Grammatika / Lug'at va imlo / Gap tuzilishi va bog'lanish (har biri 0–5); normativ (L25) >=14/20.

Qoralamaga faqat draft_check_a1 belgilari qo'yiladi (G, Sp, WO, ^, P, ?, ✓) — to'g'ri javob yozib berilmaydi, o'quvchi o'zi tuzatadi. Namunani ustoz WRITING bosqichida 1 marta ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi, nusxa tarqatilmaydi.

lessons.title: MODAL VERBS (must, may, might, could)
lessons.grammar_topic: Modal fe'llar: must (kerak), may/might (mumkin, ehtimol), could (qila olar edim / muloyim iltimos); can — 11-darsdan takror

objectives: can / can't (hozir qila olaman), could / couldn't (o'tganda qila olar edim) — tasdiq, inkor, savol.
must / mustn't (kerak / mumkin emas, taqiq), may / may not (ruxsat; ehtimol), might (ehtimol, kamroq) — tasdiq, inkor, savol.
Modal fe'ldan keyin TO qo'ymaydi va -s qo'shmaydi (He can swim; He must go).
Ruxsat so'rash: Can I…? / Could I…? / May I…? — muloyimlik darajasi.

Tanaffus
Varaqlar yig'iladi. Ustoz doskaga modal jadvalini yozadi: can / could / must / may / might + V1 (to yo'q, -s yo'q).
YANGI MAVZU — Modal verbs

can (2 daqiqa takror) -> could (o'tmishdagi umumiy qobiliyat) -> must / mustn't (taqiq) -> may -> might. S + modal + V1; modal + not; modal + S + V1? CCQ: 'You mustn't run.' — Yugursa bo'ladimi? — Yo'q.
LUG'AT — Common verbs - revision

KOMBINATSIYA — modals

Juftlikda: A ega + fe'l aytadi, B 3 shakl + tarjima. Namuna: I — go -> I must go — Borishim kerak -> I mustn't go — Bormasligim kerak -> Must I go? — Borishim kerakmi? 1 daq: 3 aylana — 1 coin, 4 — 2 coin.

MAJBURIY: ovozli normativ Common verbs - revision (L25 gacha), 2-mashq (modallar, 10 gap), Reading 'Rules at the Aqua Park'. L25 boshida yozma normativ (CORE 20). My family — tuzatilgan qoralamani 10 daqiqada qaramasdan yozib mashq (L25 da normativ).
Yakun
Har o'quvchi bitta qoida aytadi: 'In our class you must… / you mustn't…'. Test natijasi va tahlil — 25-darsda.

intro: MODAL VERBS — asosiy fe'lga 'qila olmoq / kerak / mumkin' ma'nosini qo'shadigan yordamchi fe'llar. ULARDAN KEYIN TO YO'Q, -s YO'Q, asosiy fe'l o'zgarmaydi.
CAN — qila olmoq (hozir): I can swim — men suza olaman. I can't swim — suza olmayman. Can you swim? — suza olasanmi? Ruxsat: Can I come in?

COULD — qila olar edim (o'tmishdagi UMUMIY qobiliyat): When I was five, I could swim — besh yoshimda suza olar edim. I couldn't swim — suza olmas edim. Could you swim? — suza olarmiding? Muloyim iltimos: Could you help me?
MUST — kerak, shart: He must go — u borishi kerak. He mustn't smoke — u chekmasligi kerak / chekishi MUMKIN EMAS (taqiq!). Must I help? — yordam berishim kerakmi?
MAY — mumkin (ruxsat, rasmiy): You may come in — kirishing mumkin. You may not come in — kirishing mumkin emas. May I come in? — kirsam bo'ladimi?
MIGHT — ehtimol, balki (kamroq ishonch): It might rain — yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin. I might come — kelsam kerak (aniq emas). May ham 'ehtimol' bo'ladi: He may be at home.
Ruxsat so'rash zinasi: Can I…? (do'stona) → Could I…? (muloyim) → May I…? (rasmiy).
Modal fe'l hamma shaxsda bir xil: I can, he can, they can (he cans — XATO).
formulas: S + can + verb / S + can't + verb / Can + S + verb?
I can swim. / I can't swim. / Can you swim?
Men suza olaman. / Suza olmayman. / Suza olasanmi?
S + could + verb / S + couldn't + verb / Could + S + verb?
When I was five, I could swim. / I couldn't swim. / Could you swim?
Besh yoshimda suza olar edim. / Suza olmas edim. / Suza olarmiding?
S + must + verb / S + mustn't + verb / Must + S + verb?
He must go. / He mustn't smoke. / Must I help in the garden?
U borishi kerak. / U chekmasligi kerak (chekishi mumkin emas). / Bog'da yordam berishim kerakmi?
S + may + verb / S + may not + verb / May + S + verb?
You may come in. / You may not come in. / May I come in?
Sen kirishing mumkin. / Kirishing mumkin emas. / Kirsam bo'ladimi?
It might rain tomorrow. / She might not come.
Ertaga yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin. / U kelmasligi mumkin.
presentation: Bugun nima o'tamiz? can nima degani?
Modal verbs; qila olmoq
Formulasi? 'Men suza olaman'?
S + can + verb; I can swim
Inkor? 'Men suza olmayman'?
can + not = can't; I can't swim
Savolda can qayerga? 'Yoza olasanmi?'
oldinga; Can you write?
could formulasi? 'Bolaligimda tez yugura olar edim'? CCQ: hozirmi yoki o'tmishda? Bir martami yoki doim?
S + could + verb; When I was a child, I could run fast. O'tmishda, doim (umumiy qobiliyat)
can bilan could farqi? can qaysi zamon? could?
hozirgi; o'tgan
'Men yoza olmas edim'? 'Sen yoza olarmiding?'
I couldn't write. / Could you write?
must tarjimasi? 'Men borishim kerak'? Formulasi?
kerak; I must go; S + must + verb
Inkorda? 'Sen yugurmasliging kerak (yugurish mumkin emas)'? Savol: 'U yugurishi kerakmi?' CCQ: You mustn't run. — Yugursa bo'ladimi?
mustn't; You mustn't run; Must he run? CCQ javobi: Yo'q, mumkin emas (taqiq)
may tarjimasi? 'U kirishi mumkin'? 'Kirsam bo'ladimi?'

Eng katta xato nima? 'He must to go' to'g'rimi?

notes: can 11-darsda o'tilgan — bu yerda 2 daqiqa takror, asosiy e'tibor must / may / might / could ga.
Eng katta xato — modal + TO. Doskaga katta qilib yozing: can/could/must/may/might + VERB (to YO'Q, -s YO'Q).
mustn't = TAQIQ (mumkin emas), 'kerak emas' (majburiy emas) — don't have to (keyingi darajada). Hozircha mustn't = 'qilish mumkin emas' deb bering.
may/might farqini chuqurlashtirmang: may — ruxsat + ehtimol; might — ehtimol (kamroq).
'mayn't' shakli ishlatilmaydi — 'may not' deb o'rgating.
'My family': qoralama L23 da berilgan — ustoz bugun tekshirilgan qoralamalarni qaytaradi; WRITING NORMATIV — L25, SPEAKING NORMATIV — L26.
could — o'tmishdagi UMUMIY qobiliyat (When I was five, I could read). Bir martalik yutuqda could ishlatilmaydi: 'Yesterday I could pass the exam' — XATO (was able to — 2.0 da).

TEST kuni: dars boshida Progress test 4 (L19–L23), 35 daqiqa; Kahoot va yozma normativ yo'q. Natija va tahlil — 25-darsda. L23 ovozli normativi (Common nouns 1) shu dargacha yuborilganini belgilang; L23 CORE so'zlari testning lug'at bo'limida.
mistakes: modal o'zi oldinga chiqadi, do kerak emas.

how: REVISION — Common verbs darslaridagi (L07, L11, L18, L19) fe'llar yangi ot bilan: make / do / take / have / get / go / give / keep / pay / tell + ot. STRONG — phrasal verbs (turn on, put on…). SUPER — yana birikmalar. Har CORE birikma bilan bugungi modal gap tuziladi: 'You must make a decision today.'

class_ex.title: Progress test 4 (L19–L23): ustoz uchun o'tkazish tartibi va ball jadvali
class_ex.instr: Test 24-darsda, 35 daqiqa, 100 ball, 5 bo'lim: Grammatika 50 (13 daq) · Lug'at 20 (6 daq) · Listening 10 (5 daq) · Reading 10 (5 daq) · Writing 10 (6 daq). Qamrov — faqat 19–23-darslar: will / won't / will be; zero va first conditional; subject / object pronouns; like vs would like; my / mine…; this / that / these / those; a lot of / a lot; CORE lug'at: Common verbs 4, Common nouns 2, Sport and exercise, Common adjectives (revision), Common nouns 1. 24-darsning yangi mavzusi (modal verbs) testga kirmaydi.
items: 1. Dars oldidan: har o'quvchiga o'quvchi varag'ini chop eting — Grammatika A, B, C; Lug'at (20 ta o'zbekcha so'z); Listening (5 ta bo'sh joy); Reading matni va 5 ta gap; Writing topshirig'i. Listening skripti, javob kalitlari, rubrika va namuna javob varaqqa KIRMAYDI — ular faqat ustoz sahifasida.

2. Testdan oldin (vaqtga kirmaydi, 1–2 daqiqa): telefonlar yig'iladi, o'quvchilar alohida o'tiradi, varaqqa ism, familiya va sana yoziladi. Proyektorga faqat taymer va joriy bo'lim nomi chiqariladi; bu sahifani o'quvchilar oldida ochmang, 'Javobni ko'rsat' tugmasi test davomida bosilmaydi.

3. 0–5 daq — LISTENING (birinchi, chunki ustoz ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va sinf jim bo'lishi kerak): o'quvchilar 30 soniya savollarni o'qiydi; ustoz skriptni 2 rolda, odatiy tezlikda 2 marta o'qiydi (o'qishlar orasida 20 soniya pauza); oxirida 30 soniya javoblarni tekshirish.

4. 5–18 daq — GRAMMATIKA (A, B, C); 18–24 daq — LUG'AT; 24–29 daq — READING; 29–35 daq — WRITING. Har bo'lim oxiridan 1 daqiqa oldin ogohlantiring va keyingi bo'limni e'lon qiling. Oldinroq tugatgan o'quvchi keyingi bo'limga o'tishi mumkin, lekin oldingi bo'limga qaytib vaqt olmaydi; kech qolganga vaqt qo'shilmaydi.
5. 35-daqiqada varaqlar yig'iladi. Kalit o'quvchilarga yozma berilmaydi; eng ko'p xato bo'lgan 3–4 savol keyingi darsda doskada tahlil qilinadi.

6. Tekshirish (24 soat ichida, qizil ruchka bilan): Grammatika A va B — to'g'ri javob 2 ball, xato 0; B da shakl to'g'ri, lekin bosh harf xatosi (masalan, 'we' gap boshida) — 2 ball. C — to'g'ri tuzatilgan gap 2 ball; xato topilgan, lekin tuzatish noto'g'ri — 1 ball; topilmagan — 0. Lug'at — to'g'ri imlo 1 ball, bitta harf xato 0.5, boshqa xato 0. Listening — har javob 2 ball; 3-savol (mehmonxona nomi) faqat to'liq to'g'ri harflar bilan; boshqa javoblarda bitta harf xato — 1 ball. Reading — har gap 2 ball. Writing — writing_a1 rubrikasi (4 × 0–5 = 20) × 0.5 = 10 ball.
7. Natija varag'iga har bo'lim balli va jami yoziladi. 70% chegaralari (qayta topshirish uchun): Grammatika 35/50, Lug'at 14/20, Listening 7/10, Reading 7/10, Writing 7/10.
8. Ball va xatolar varag'i 2 kun ichida o'quvchiga beriladi; ota-onaga natija JonyOS orqali yuboriladi.
answers: 70–100 ball — O'TDI. Keyingi qadam: 25-darsdan davom etadi; xatolar tahlilini keyingi dars boshida ko'radi.

50–69 ball — O'TMADI (qisman). Keyingi qadam: xatolar varag'ini to'ldiradi (har xato: to'g'ri shakl + o'z gapi); 7 kun ichida FAQAT 70% dan past bo'limlarni qayta topshiradi (Grammatika <35, Lug'at <14, Listening <7, Reading <7, Writing <7). Qayta topshirilgan bo'lim balli eskisining o'rniga yoziladi; yangi jami >=70 bo'lsa — O'TDI.
0–49 ball — O'TMADI. Keyingi qadam: ota-onaga xabar beriladi; 1 ta qo'shimcha (remedial) mashg'ulot (19–23-darslar formulalari va CORE lug'at); so'ng 7 kun ichida testni TO'LIQ qayta topshiradi.
Guruhdan chiqarish yo'q. Qayta topshirishda ham jami <50 bo'lsa — rahbar bilan suhbat (takror guruh taklifi).
Qayta topshirishda Listening uchun ustoz skriptdagi 3 ta ma'lumotni o'zgartirib o'qiydi (uncle → aunt, ten → twelve, Oqtosh → Chimyon, C-H-I-M-Y-O-N) va kalitni shunga moslaydi.

class_ex.title: Grammatika A — Choose the correct answer (20 ball: 10 × 2)
class_ex.type: MCQ, 3 variant, bitta to'g'ri javob: 1–4 — will / won't / will be (L19); 5–8 — zero va first conditional (L20); 9–10 — like vs would like (L21)
class_ex.instr: Choose the correct answer: A, B or C. (To'g'ri javobni tanlang: A, B yoki C — faqat bitta harf.)
items: 1. Tomorrow I ___ at home all day. A) will B) will be C) am will
2. Sardor is ill. He ___ come to the lesson tomorrow. A) won't B) doesn't will C) will not to
3. ___ you help me with my homework tonight? A) Do B) Are C) Will
4. In ten years, my sister ___ a doctor. A) will B) wills be C) will be
5. If you heat ice, it ___. A) melts B) will melts C) melt
6. If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home. A) will rain B) rains C) rain
7. If you don't study tonight, you ___ the test tomorrow. A) don't passes B) won't pass C) not will pass
8. If my friend comes to my party, I ___ very happy. A) will is B) be C) will be
9. My brother likes ___ basketball after school. A) play B) plays C) playing
10. I'm hungry. I ___ a sandwich, please. A) would like B) like C) likes
why: 4. Kasb oldida will be: will be a doctor.
5. Zero conditional — umumiy haqiqat: if + present, present (it → melts).
6. if dan keyin present simple (will emas): if it rains.
7. First conditional inkor: If + don't …, won't + V1.
8. First conditional: if + present, will be + sifat (will is / be — xato).
10. Hozir xohlash, muloyim — would like + noun.

class_ex.title: Grammatika B — Fill in the gaps (20 ball: 10 × 2)

reading.title: Rules at the Aqua Park
text: Welcome to Aqua Park! Please read these rules before you enter.
Children under 12 must come with an adult. They can use the small pool, but they mustn't go into the deep pool. Everyone must take a shower before swimming.

You can bring your own towel or you can rent one at the entrance for 10,000 soums. You mustn't bring glass bottles — they can break and hurt people. You may bring food, but you can only eat in the café area.
You can't run near the pool because the floor is wet and you might fall. You mustn't jump from the sides. If you can't swim well, you must wear a life jacket — you can get one for free.
The park is open from 9 am to 8 pm. You may stay all day. Have fun and be safe!

homework.title: MAJBURIY — WRITING — My family (tuzatilgan qoralama, vaqtga mashq)
homework.instr: Ustoz qaytargan qoralamadagi belgilarni tuzating, so'ng matnni 10 daqiqada qaramasdan qayta yozib mashq qiling (kitob qoidasi: avval bexato, keyin vaqtga). L25 — WRITING NORMATIV.
items: 1) Ustoz qo'ygan belgilarni (G, Sp, WO, ^, P, ?) birma-bir tuzating — to'g'ri variantni o'zingiz toping.
2) Tuzatilgan matnni bir marta ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
3) Taymerni 10 daqiqaga qo'ying va matnni qaramasdan qayta yozing (60–80 so'z).
4) Tuzatilgan matn bilan solishtiring, xatolarni qizil bilan belgilang; kerak bo'lsa yana bir marta yozing.

5) Reja: Oilada necha kishi (There are … people in my family: …) → Ota-ona: kasbi + 2 ta xarakter sifati → Aka-uka / opa-singil: yoshi, nimani yoqtiradi, egalik (her room / mine) → Birga nima qilasizlar (We often …) + 1 ta o'tgan zamon gapi (Last Sunday we …) → Yakuniy fikr (I love my family.).
answers: Namuna (faqat ustozga, original): There are five people in my family: my parents, my two sisters and me. My father is a doctor. He is reliable and responsible. My mother is a teacher. She is caring and cheerful. My older sister Nodira is seventeen. She is creative and she likes music. Her room is big, but mine is small. My little sister is six and she is very talkative. We often have dinner together. Last Sunday we visited our grandparents. I love my family. (80 so'z)

Tekshirish (L25 WRITING NORMATIV dagi kabi, writing_a1): 1) Topshiriqni bajarish (mazmun va hajm); 2) Grammatika (to be, -s, V2, egalik shakllari); 3) Lug'at va imlo; 4) Gap tuzilishi va bog'lanish. 4 × 0–5 = 20; normativ >=14/20.
Qoralamadagi belgilar — draft_check_a1 (G, Sp, WO, ^, P, ?, ✓); to'g'ri javob yozib berilmaydi, o'quvchi o'zi tuzatadi.
Tayyorlik belgisi: 10 daqiqaga sig'di va 3 tagacha xato — L25 ga tayyor. Modal fe'llar (bugungi mavzu) normativ namunasida shart emas.

Ustoz: 'I am teaching now. I taught yesterday. I will teach tomorrow.' — doskada 3 ustun; 'When?' — o'quvchilar vaqt so'zini topadi.
KAHOOT — L24: Modal verbs, Common verbs - revision
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi — L24 kahoot banki, qisqa versiya: birinchi 10 savol, 15 soniyadan; 1–3-o'rin 3/2/1 coin.
YOZMA NORMATIV — L24: Common verbs - revision (CORE 20)
O'zbekcha 20 so'z -> inglizcha, 5 daqiqa; 3 tagacha imlo xatosi (so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato) — 2 coin.
TEST TAHLILI — Progress test 4
Har o'quvchiga ball va bo'limlar natijasi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 5 savol doskada, o'quvchilar tuzatadi; <70% olganlarga qayta topshirish sanasi (7 kun ichida).
WRITING NORMATIV — My family

60–80 so'z, 10 daqiqa (1' tarqatish + 10' yozish + 1' yig'ish), L23 qoralamasi (ustoz tekshirgan) asosida, qaramasdan; writing_a1 >=14/20; karta va rubrika — class_ex oxirida. SPEAKING NORMATIV — L26 da.
YANGI MAVZU — vaqt so'zi -> zamon
now/at the moment -> continuous; every day/usually -> present simple; yesterday/ago -> past; tomorrow/soon -> will. still/already/just — fe'l oldida; yet — gap oxirida. CCQ — presentation.
LUG'AT — Adverbs of time
CORE 20: so'z -> tarjima -> 4 ustunli jadvalga joylash -> har so'z bilan to'g'ri zamonda gap. STRONG/SUPER — ixtiyoriy.
KOMBINATSIYA — zamon <-> vaqt ravishi

A: ega + fe'l + vaqt so'zi; B: tasdiq, inkor, savol + tarjima: I — play — yesterday -> I played football yesterday -> I didn't play… -> Did I play…? 1 daqiqada 3 aylana — 1 coin, 4 — 2 coin (8 daqiqa: 1 namuna aylana + juftlikda normativ).
SINF MASHQLARI 1–4 (ZAXIRA: 5)

Majburiy: 1–4 (6+3+3+4 daqiqa). Ustoz aylanib xatoni tuzatadi. 5 — 'Vaqt mashinasi' — ZAXIRA (bugun WRITING NORMATIV vaqti; vaqt qolsa yoki keyingi dars Salomlashish vaqtida). Kuchsiz o'quvchi: 4 ustunli jadvalga qarab ishlaydi.
READING — Yesterday, today, tomorrow
Ichida o'qish (3 daqiqa) -> vaqt so'zlarini topish -> T/F -> juftlikda o'zi haqida 4–6 gap. Kalit ustozda.
LISTENING — skript (ustoz o'qiydi)
Ustoz Aziz haqidagi matnni 2 marta o'qiydi: 1-marta — fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonda yozish (1-topshiriq), 2-marta — soatlar (2-topshiriq). Kalit bilan tekshiriladi.
Uyga vazifa

MAJBURIY (~40 daqiqa): ovozli normativ Adverbs of time (L26 gacha), 'Zamonni tanlang' (8 gap), 'Uch kun — 8–10 gap', 'SPEAKING (ovozli mashq) — My family' (6 savol, ~1 daqiqa, ilovada; baholanmaydi — L26 dagi SPEAKING NORMATIV ga tayyorgarlik). L26 boshida yozma normativ (CORE 20).

intro: VAQT RAVISHI gapning qaysi zamonda ekanini AYTIB TURADI — bu darsda shu paytgacha o'tilgan zamonlarni vaqt so'zlariga qarab tanlashni o'rganamiz.
now / at the moment / right now → PRESENT CONTINUOUS: I am reading now.
every day / always / usually / on Mondays → PRESENT SIMPLE: I read every day.
yesterday / last week / ago / in 2020 → PAST SIMPLE: I read a book yesterday. (was/were + -ing → PAST CONTINUOUS: I was reading at 8 pm yesterday.)
tomorrow / next week / soon / later / in 2030 → WILL (yoki going to): I will read tomorrow. I am going to read later.

already / just / still — fe'l OLDIDA yoki to be dan KEYIN: I already know. She just left. He is still here. (Britaniya inglizchasida already/just ko'pincha present perfect bilan keladi — I have just finished; bu zamon IELTS 2.0 da. Hozircha present simple yoki past simple bilan.)
yet — faqat inkor va savolda, GAP OXIRIDA: He isn't here yet. Is the shop open yet?
Vaqt ravishi ko'pincha gap OXIRIDA, ta'kidlansa BOSHIDA: Tomorrow I will go to Tashkent.
formulas: I read every day. She reads every day.
Men har kuni o'qiyman. U har kuni o'qiydi.
He still works here. I already know. She just left.
U hali ham shu yerda ishlaydi. Men allaqachon bilaman. U hozirgina ketdi.
S + isn't/aren't + … + yet / Is/Are + S + … + yet?
He isn't here yet. Is she here yet?
U hali bu yerda emas. U keldimi?
presentation: Bugun nima o'tamiz? Vaqt ravishi nima?
Adverbs of time — qachon bo'lganini aytadigan so'zlar
'now' bo'lsa qaysi zamon? 'Men hozir o'qiyapman'?
Present continuous; I am reading now
'every day' bo'lsa? 'Men har kuni o'qiyman'? 'U har kuni o'qiydi'?
Present simple; I read every day; She reads every day
'yesterday'? 'Men kecha kitob o'qidim'?
Past simple; I read a book yesterday
'tomorrow'? 'Men ertaga o'qiyman'?
will; I will read tomorrow
'ago' qaysi zamon? 'Ikki yil oldin keldim'?
past simple; I came two years ago
still / already / just / yet gapning qayerida?
still/already/just — fe'l oldida yoki to be dan keyin; yet — gap oxirida
Vaqt ravishi odatda qayerda? Ta'kidlasak?
oxirida; boshida
notes: Bu — TAKRORLASH darsi: doskada 4 ustunli jadval (now / every day / yesterday / tomorrow), o'quvchilar vaqt so'zlarini ustunga taqsimlaydi.
CORE 20 — eng ko'p ishlatiladigan vaqt so'zlari (bugun faol, normativ shu 20 ta); STRONG/SUPER — ixtiyoriy (jamlanma 40/60). Kitob ro'yxati — ixtiyoriy.

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Bu darsda A ega + fe'l + vaqt so'zini aytadi, B zamonni vaqt so'ziga qarab tanlaydi. Namuna: I — play football — yesterday -> I played football yesterday — Men kecha futbol o'ynadim -> I didn't play football yesterday — Men kecha futbol o'ynamadim -> Did I play football yesterday? — Men kecha futbol o'ynadimmi? Keyingi aylanada vaqt so'zi almashadi (every day / now / tomorrow). Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ — 1 daqiqada 3 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 4 aylana = 2 coin.
ICQ (mashqdan oldin): 'Nechta gap? Yakkami yoki juftlikda? Qaysi so'zga qaraysiz? (vaqt so'ziga)'. Speaking vaqtida xatolarni to'xtatmasdan yozib boring, oxirida 3 tasini doskada birga tuzating.
mistakes: I will go tomorrow to Tashkent.
I will go to Tashkent tomorrow.
vaqt ravishi ega bilan fe'l orasiga kirmaydi — gap oxiriga yoki boshiga: I saw him yesterday. / Yesterday I saw him.

how: CORE 20 — eng ko'p ishlatiladigan vaqt so'zlari (bugun faol, normativ shu 20 ta). STRONG — vaqt iboralari, SUPER — kengroq ravishlar; ikkalasi ixtiyoriy. Har so'z bilan to'g'ri zamonda gap tuziladi (yesterday → past, tomorrow → will, every day → present simple).
core: We watched a film last night.
We will have a test next week.
I came here two years ago.
Men bu yerga ikki yil oldin keldim.
strong: I got up at 6 this morning.
Come to my house this evening.
I met him the day before yesterday.
He is busy at the moment.
I walk to school every day.
Men har kuni maktabga piyoda boraman.
I drink tea in the morning.
I go there once a week.
U yerga haftada bir marta boraman.
super: Previously, she worked in a bank.
Kelasi hafta biror vaqt qo'ng'iroq qil.
In the past, people wrote letters.
In the future, be more careful.
Nowadays people use phones every day.
Hozirgi kunda odamlar har kuni telefondan foydalanadi.
Last year I was in Samarkand.
Next month we will start IELTS 2.0.
These days I study a lot.
From now on, be on time!

class_ex.title: WRITING NORMATIV — My family
class_ex.instr: 60–80 so'z, 10 daqiqa. Qoralama, daftar, telefon — mumkin emas. Sarlavha yozilmaydi. Tugagach so'zlarni sanab, oxiriga yozing.
items: 1. How many people are there in your family? Who are they?
2. What do your parents do? What are they like? (2 ta xarakter sifati: reliable, caring, cheerful, helpful, responsible…)
3. Do you have brothers or sisters? How old are they? What do they like? (kamida 2 ta egalik shakli: her room / mine, theirs…)
4. What do you often do together? What did you do last Sunday? (1 ta past simple gap)
5. How do you feel about your family? (I love my family.)
answers: Namuna (L23 qoralama namunasi, ustoz uchun; 80 so'z): There are five people in my family: my parents, my two sisters and me. My father is a doctor. He is reliable and responsible. My mother is a teacher. She is caring and cheerful. My older sister Nodira is seventeen. She is creative and she likes music. Her room is big, but mine is small. My little sister is six and she is very talkative. We often have dinner together. Last Sunday we visited our grandparents. I love my family.

Ixtiyoriy plus: vaqt so'zi bilan kelajak gapi (will, L19 dan tanish) — masalan: Next summer we will go to Bukhara. Majburiy emas; bugungi yangi mavzu (vaqt so'zi -> zamon) normativ YANGI MAVZU dan oldin bo'lgani uchun talab qilinmaydi.

Tekshirish tartibi: (1) so'zlarni sanang (60–80; 48 dan kam bo'lsa Topshiriq mezoni 3 dan yuqori bo'lmaydi); (2) writing_a1 ning 4 mezoni bo'yicha 0–5 ball: Topshiriq (reja bandlari bor) / Grammatika (to be, -s, V2, a/an, egalik shakllari my/her/mine) / Lug'at va imlo (oila so'zlari L15, kasblar L04, xarakter sifatlari L22) / Gap tuzilishi (bosh harf, nuqta, and/but/because kamida 2 marta); (3) yig'indi 0–20.

Natija: >=14/20 — normativ + XP. <14 — xatolar draft_check_a1 belgilari bilan qaytariladi, o'quvchi xatolar ustida ishlab keyingi dars ZAXIRA vaqtida yoki darsdan keyin qayta yozadi (SPEAKING NORMATIV — My family baribir L26 da).

reading.title: Yesterday, today, tomorrow
text: My name is Malika and I am a student at Jony Academy. Every day I get up at 7, but yesterday I got up at 9 because it was Sunday. Right now I am sitting in the classroom and writing this text.
Two years ago I didn't speak English at all. Now I can read short texts and I speak with my teacher every lesson. Last week we had a Kahoot game — I was first!
Tomorrow we will have a test. Tonight I am going to revise the irregular verbs. I already know 40 of them, but I still don't remember 'swim – swam – swum'. I will learn it later today.
Next month I will finish IELTS 1.0 and soon I will start IELTS 2.0. My dream is to get 7.0 someday!

lessons.grammar_topic: S + verb + adverb / S + verb + object + adverb / adverb + adjective; adjective + -ly

objectives: Ravish fe'lni tasvirlaydi (qay tarzda?): She walked carefully; He ate his food quickly.
Sifat + -ly = ravish (careful → carefully); istisnolar: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard, late → late, early → early.
Ravish o'rni: fe'ldan keyin yoki to'ldiruvchidan keyin; adverb + adjective (incredibly delicious).
Sifat va ravishni farqlaydi: She is a careful driver / She drives carefully.

intro: ADVERB OF MANNER (holat ravishi) — ish-harakat QAY TARZDA bajarilganini aytadi va FE'LNI tasvirlaydi.
1) S + verb + adverb: She walked carefully — u ehtiyotkorlik bilan yurdi.
2) S + verb + object + adverb: He ate his food quickly — u ovqatini tezda yedi. She reads the book carefully. (Ravish fe'l bilan to'ldiruvchi ORASIGA kirmaydi: He ate quickly his food — XATO.)
3) Adverb + adjective: The cake is incredibly delicious — tort juda ham mazali. She looks remarkably beautiful.
YASALISHI: sifat + -ly: careful → carefully, quick → quickly, slow → slowly, quiet → quietly. -y → -ily: happy → happily, easy → easily. -le → -ly: gentle → gently, simple → simply.
ISTISNOLAR: good → WELL (She speaks English well). fast → fast, hard → hard, late → late, early → early (o'zgarmaydi). hardly = 'deyarli … emas' (hard emas!).
SIFAT yoki RAVISH? Sifat — OT yoki to be/look/feel bilan: She is a careful driver. The soup smells good. Ravish — FE'L bilan: She drives carefully. He cooks well.

EXIT ga tayyorgarlik (12 daqiqa): CHECK-LIST varag'i (L02–L26, 25 mavzu — ro'yxat va namuna gaplar 'MAJBURIY — CHECK-LIST' uyga vazifasida). 4 daqiqa — har o'quvchi ✓ yoki ? qo'yadi. 6 daqiqa — 5 blok: L02–L06, L07–L13, L14–L18, L19–L23, L24–L26; har blokda eng ko'p ? olgan mavzuga bitta o'quvchi doskada gap yozadi, sinf tekshiradi. 2 daqiqa — EXIT TEST tartibi: 28-darsda, yozma 45 daqiqa + speaking 20 daqiqa, L01–L27, o'tish >=70%; <70% — 7 kun ichida qayta topshirish.

Namuna: She — sing, beautifully -> She sings beautifully — U chiroyli kuylaydi -> She doesn't sing beautifully — U chiroyli kuylamaydi -> Does she sing beautifully? — U chiroyli kuylaydimi? Warm-up — 1 aylana, coin yo'q; normativ — 1 daqiqada 3 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 4 aylana = 2 coin.

Yozma (L27 boshida): o'zbekcha 20 so'z -> inglizcha, 5 daqiqa; 3 tagacha imlo xatosi (so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato) — 2 coin. STRONG/SUPER — ixtiyoriy, jamlanma 40/60.

answers: Namuna javob (A1, ≈1 daqiqa): There are four people in my family: my mother, my father, my brother and me. My father is an engineer. He is very helpful and reliable. My mother is a nurse. reading.title: The school concert
text: Last Friday our school had a concert. Everybody prepared carefully for two weeks. The teachers worked hard and the students practised patiently every afternoon.

Madina sang first. She was nervous at first, but she sang beautifully and the audience listened silently. Then Jasur played the guitar — he played incredibly well, and everybody clapped loudly. Two girls from the fifth grade danced gracefully; they moved so smoothly that it looked easy.

Not everything went perfectly. Little Ali forgot his poem and stood quietly on the stage. But the teacher smiled kindly, whispered the first line softly, and Ali finished the poem confidently. The audience cheered enthusiastically.
At the end the headmaster spoke briefly: 'You worked seriously and you did it well. I am proud of you.' We went home happily. It was a wonderful evening!

lessons.title: FUTURE CONTINUOUS (A) / DAVOMIY ZAMONLAR TAKRORI (B)
lessons.grammar_topic: Future continuous — kelasi davomiy zamon (will be + verb-ing); B-variant: present/past continuous takrori
lessons.book_ref: Ixtiyoriy: Student's book Level 13 (Exercise 1 — 50 gap), Reading Topic 14; Teacher's book: Lesson 11. Common nouns (qolgan qismi).
objectives: A-variant (kuchli guruh): future continuous to'liq o'tiladi. B-variant (o'rta guruh): present/past continuous takrori, future continuous faqat tanishtiriladi (2 misol). Ustoz dars boshida variantni tanlaydi.
'Subject + will be + verb-ing' formulasida kelajakda ma'lum vaqtda davom etadigan ishni aytadi (This time tomorrow I will be flying to Tashkent).
Uch davomiy zamonni bitta jadvalda ko'radi: am/is/are — was/were — will be + -ing.
Inkor (won't be + -ing) va savol (Will + S + be + -ing?) tuzadi.
this time tomorrow, at 8 tomorrow, next week at this time belgi so'zlarini ishlatadi.
Common nouns - revision — 20 ta CORE otni (joylar, buyumlar) biladi va will be + V-ing gapda ishlatadi.

SPEAKING — 7 mavzu takrori (About myself, About my friend, Hometown, My last weekend, My daily routine, My home, My family): juftlikda ≈1 daqiqa gapiradi va speaking_a1 mezonlari bo'yicha sherigiga maslahat beradi (EXIT ga tayyorgarlik).
materials: Uch davomiy zamon jadvali (present / past / future continuous).
Yozma normativ varag'i — L26 CORE 20 (Adverbs of manner); Common nouns - revision CORE 20 varag'i.

YANGI MAVZU — Future continuous (A) / davomiy zamonlar takrori (B)

A: present/past continuous -> will be + V-ing, won't be, Will + S + be + V-ing?; CCQ (presentation). B-variant (o'rta guruh): present/past continuous takrori, future continuous faqat tanishtiriladi (2 misol).
3 davomiy zamon jadvali
Bitta gap 3 zamonda: I am sleeping / I was sleeping / I will be sleeping. class_ex 3 (Uch davomiy zamon; 7 daqiqa — 6–8 ta gap) shu yerda — og'zaki/juftlikda (B guruh: asosan 1–2-ustun).
LUG'AT — Common nouns - revision
CORE 20: so'z -> tarjima -> will be + V-ing gap ('This time tomorrow I will be looking for a cheap apartment.'); B guruh — present continuous gap. STRONG/SUPER — kuchli o'quvchilarga.
KOMBINATSIYA

A ega+fe'l, B +/–/? gap va tarjima = 1 aylana. Namuna: I — sleep -> I will be sleeping — Men uxlayotgan bo'laman -> I won't be sleeping — Men uxlamayotgan bo'laman -> Will I be sleeping? — Men uxlayotgan bo'lamanmi?

intro: Future continuous — kelajakda ANIQ VAQTDA davom etadigan ish: 'Ertaga soat 10 da men uxlayotgan bo'laman'. Formula: ega + will be + fe'l-ing.
Uchta davomiy zamonda faqat TO BE o'zgaradi: am/is/are (hozir) → was/were (o'tgan) → will be (kelasi). Fe'l-ing hech qachon o'zgarmaydi.
Inkor: will not be = won't be + -ing. Savol: Will + ega + be + -ing? (will oldinga, be joyida qoladi — 19-darsdagi kabi).
Belgi so'zlar: this time tomorrow, at 8 tomorrow, tomorrow evening, next week at this time, all day tomorrow.
formulas: I will be sleeping. He will be working.

Yes, S + will. / No, S + won't.
Will she be working? — Yes, she will.

I am reading. I was reading. I will be reading.

notes: B-variant (o'rta guruh): present/past continuous takrori, future continuous faqat tanishtiriladi (2 misol): 2 misol — 'I will be sleeping at 10 tomorrow.' va 'Will you be working at 5?'. B guruh uchun: 2-sinf mashqi (B-variant), speaking va salomlashishda now/yesterday savollari, reading'da gaplarni present continuous ga aylantirish.
Bu zamon A1 uchun murakkab — chuqurlashmang. Maqsad: to be ning 3 zamoni + -ing formulasini bitta tizim sifatida ko'rsatish.
Inkorda o'quvchilar 'will be not' deydi — 19-darsdagi eslatma: not — will dan keyin.
Savolda 'Will be you…' xatosi — be ni doskada aylantirib qo'ying: Will you BE …?

Kombinatsiya — juftlikdagi formula zanjiri: A ega yoki so'zni aytadi, B shu darsning formulasi bo'yicha tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzib, har birini o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; shu uchlik — 1 aylana. Warm-up — 1 aylana (coin yo'q); normativ — 1 daqiqada 3 aylana bexato = 1 coin, 4 aylana = 2 coin. B guruh zanjiri: I — sleep -> I am sleeping -> I am not sleeping -> Am I sleeping?
EXIT speaking mavzulari (28-dars): About myself, My family, My home/Hometown, My daily routine, My last weekend.
mistakes: Tomorrow at 9 I will be sleeping.

reading.title: Tomorrow is a big day
text: Tomorrow is a big day for my family. At 6 o'clock in the morning my father will be driving to the airport. My uncle is coming from Moscow! At 8 my mother will be cooking a big breakfast and my sister will be cleaning the house. She won't be happy — she hates cleaning!

At 10 I will be sitting in my English lesson. I won't be sleeping — the teacher is very strict. At 12 my brother will be playing football at the stadium. It will be hot, so he will be drinking a lot of water.

In the evening we will all be sitting at a big table. My grandmother will be telling old stories and everybody will be laughing. What will I be doing at 10 in the evening? I will be sleeping, of course!

MALIKA: Thanks! See you!

lessons.title: UMUMIY TAKROR + EXIT TEST (IELTS 1.0 yakuniy)
lessons.grammar_topic: CHECK-LIST: L02–L27 mavzulari
lessons.book_ref: Ixtiyoriy: Student's book — CHECK-LIST FOR IELTS 1.0; Reading Topic 119–120.
objectives: CHECK-LIST mavzularida (L02–L27) tasdiq / inkor / savol gapni xatosiz tuzadi va o'z xatosini topadi.
Vaqt ravishiga qarab zamonni tanlaydi; eng ko'p uchraydigan 8 xatoni biladi.
EXIT speaking: qura bo'yicha 1 mavzuda 1–1.5 daqiqa gapiradi va 2 yordamchi savolga javob beradi.
EXIT TEST yozma qismini (45 daqiqa) yozadi; o'tish >=70/100 -> IELTS 2.0.
materials: CHECK-LIST varag'i — L02–L27 mavzulari (har o'quvchiga; ✓ / ?).
Yozma normativ varag'i — L27 CORE 20
Kahoot — L27 banki ('O'tgan dars Kahooti', qisqa versiya).
TEST final varaqlari + speaking qura kartalari + rubrikalar (writing_a1, speaking_a1)
ZAXIRA: L28 kahoot banki (20 savol, L01–L27 aralash) — EXIT oldidan yoki uyga ixtiyoriy; Reading va Listening skripti — tizimda.
timeline: Salomlashish + CHECK-LIST varag'i
Davomat. Har o'quvchi CHECK-LIST varag'ida har mavzuga ✓ yoki ? qo'yadi. Bugungi tartib: takror -> EXIT speaking -> tanaffus -> EXIT yozma qism (45 daqiqa).
KAHOOT — L27: Future continuous / davomiy zamonlar, Common nouns - revision
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi — L27 kahoot banki, qisqa versiya: birinchi 10 savol, 15 soniyadan; 1–3-o'rin 3/2/1 coin.
YOZMA NORMATIV — L27: Common nouns - revision (CORE 20)
O'zbekcha 20 so'z -> inglizcha, 5 daqiqa; 3 tagacha imlo xatosi (so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato) — 2 coin.
BLITS TAKROR + '?' mavzular
5 blok (to be / davomiy / oddiy / ot-olmosh / boshqa): ustoz o'zbekcha gap aytadi, sinf 3 shaklda aytadi (presentation). So'nggi 5 daqiqa — varaqlarda '?' eng ko'p bo'lgan 2 mavzu doskada.
SINF MASHQLARI — Xato ovchisi + 3 shakl
Majburiy: 'Xato ovchisi' (8 band, 6 daqiqa + tekshiruv) va '3 shakl' 1–2-bandi namuna; '3 shakl' qolgani — speaking paytida juftlikda. ZAXIRA: 'Zamonlar marafoni', 'Tarjima'.
LUG'AT TAKRORI (yangi so'z yo'q)
CORE 20 (L02–L27 dan): ustoz o'zbekcha aytadi, sinf inglizcha javob beradi; 3 so'zni o'quvchilar doskada harflab yozadi. STRONG/SUPER — ixtiyoriy.
EXIT — SPEAKING qismi

Ustoz o'quvchini alohida 1–1.5 daqiqa tinglaydi: 5 mavzudan qura (About myself, My family, My home/Hometown, My daily routine, My last weekend) + 2 yordamchi savol; speaking_a1 (15 ball). Qolganlar juftlikda CHECK-LIST 3 shakl mashqi. 12 dan ortiq o'quvchi bo'lsa — har biri 1 daqiqa.
Tanaffus
Telefonlar yig'iladi, partalar test uchun joylashtiriladi; ustoz final varaqlarini tarqatishga tayyorlaydi.
TEST — EXIT TEST, yozma qism (L01–L27)

Varaq: final, kalit ustozda. Grammatika 35 / Lug'at 15 / Listening 10 (ustoz skriptni 2 marta o'qiydi) / Reading 10 / Writing 15 + Speaking 15 = 100. O'tish >=70% -> IELTS 2.0. Natija 48 soat ichida; tahlil — individual varaq + ota-onaga xabar.
Yakun
Varaqlar yig'iladi. Natija 48 soat ichida; 70% dan past bo'lsa — qayta topshirish tartibi (7 kun ichida) aytiladi. Majburiy uyga vazifa yo'q.

intro: IELTS 1.0 CHECK-LIST — 27 mavzu 5 blokda: (1) TO BE: am/is/are, was/were, will be; this/that; my/your. (2) DAVOMIY: am/is/are + V-ing, going to, was/were + V-ing; will be + V-ing — faqat L27, ixtiyoriy (testda 2 ta BONUS savol). (3) ODDIY: present simple (do/does), past simple (V2 / did), will. (4) OT VA OLMOSH: a/an, countable/uncountable, there is/are, some/any, a lot of, subject/object pronouns, possessives, determiners. (5) BOSHQA: imperative, can/must/may/might, conditionals 0/1, conjunctions, like/would like, adverbs (frequency, time, manner).
Har mavzu uchun 3 shakl: TASDIQ — INKOR — SAVOL. EXIT grammatikasida: 15 ta test (A/B/C) va 10 ta o'zgartirish (inkor, savol, vaqt so'ziga qarab zamon).
Eng ko'p xato: (a) to be bilan fe'lni aralashtirish (I am go); (b) 3-shaxs -s ni unutish; (c) did dan keyin V2 (did you went); (d) modal + to; (e) vaqt ravishi ↔ zamon nomosligi.
formulas: I am a student. She was tired. We will be at home.
Men talabaman. U charchagan edi. Biz uyda bo'lamiz.
S + am/is/are/was/were + V-ing (will be + V-ing — bonus)
I am reading. He was sleeping. They will be working.
O'qiyapman. U uxlayotgan edi. Ular ishlayotgan bo'ladi.
S + V1(-s) / don't-doesn't + V1 / Do-Does + S + V1?
She reads. She doesn't read. Does she read?
U o'qiydi. U o'qimaydi. U o'qiydimi?
S + V2 / didn't + V1 / Did + S + V1?
I went. I didn't go. Did you go?
S + will + V1 / S + am/is/are going to + V1
I will help. I am going to study.
You must go. He can swim.
If + present, present / If + present, will
If it rains, I stay home. If it rains, I will stay home.
There is + singular / There are + plural (+ some/any)
There is a book. There are some pens. Are there any cups?
Kitob bor. Ruchkalar bor. Piyolalar bormi?
presentation: Blitz: 'Men talabaman' — 'Men talaba edim' — 'Men talaba bo'laman'?
I am a student. I was a student. I will be a student.
'U o'qiyapti' — 'U o'qiyotgan edi' — 'U o'qiydi (har kuni)' — 'U o'qidi (kecha)'?
She is reading. She was reading. She reads. She read.
Inkor: 'U o'qimaydi' — 'U o'qimadi' — 'U o'qimaydi (ertaga)'?
She doesn't read. She didn't read. She won't read.
Savol: 'U o'qiydimi?' — 'U o'qidimi?' — 'U o'qiyaptimi?'
Does she read? Did she read? Is she reading?
'Stolda kitob bor' — 'Stolda kitoblar bormi?'
There is a book on the table. Are there any books on the table?
'Bu mening kitobim' — 'Bu kitob meniki'
This is my book. This book is mine.
'Yomg'ir yog'sa, uyda qolaman' (0 va 1-tip)
If it rains, I stay home. / If it rains, I will stay home.
'U borishi kerak' — 'U suza oladi' — 'Kirsam bo'ladimi?'
He must go. He can swim. May I come in?
Exit testda nima bo'ladi?

Speaking 15 (yozma qismdan oldin, qura bilan: About myself, My family, My home/Hometown, My daily routine, My last weekend) + yozma 45 daqiqa: Listening 10, Grammatika 35, Lug'at 15, Reading 10, Writing 15 (60–80 so'z). Jami 100, o'tish — 70.
notes: Bu dars — takror + EXIT TEST. Yangi mavzu yo'q. CHECK-LIST varag'ini har o'quvchiga bering: har mavzuga ✓ / ? qo'yadi; '?' ko'p bo'lgan 2 mavzu blits oxirida qayta tushuntiriladi. Reading, Listening va L28 kahoot banki — ZAXIRA (120 daqiqaga kirmaydi; EXIT oldidan vaqt qolsa yoki uyga ixtiyoriy).

EXIT TEST (final) tuzilmasi: Speaking 15 ball (yozma qismdan oldin, 20 daqiqa) + yozma qism 45 daqiqa: Listening 10 (6 daq), Grammatika 35 (15 daq: 15 test + 10 o'zgartirish; future continuous — faqat 2 BONUS savol), Lug'at 15 (6 daq, o'zbekcha -> inglizcha), Reading 10 (8 daq), Writing 15 (10 daq, 60–80 so'z: 'Me and my day' yoki 'My family'). Jami 100. >=70 — IELTS 2.0 ga o'tadi; 50–69 — xatolar varag'i + 7 kun ichida 70% dan past bo'limlarni qayta topshiradi; <50 — ota-onaga xabar, 1 qo'shimcha mashg'ulot, 7 kun ichida to'liq qayta topshiradi. Guruhdan chiqarish yo'q.
Speaking mavzulari (qura): About myself, My family, My home/Hometown, My daily routine, My last weekend. Kartalar va yordamchi savollar — test varag'ida; baho — speaking_a1 (3 mezon × 0–5 = 15).
mistakes: If it will rain, I will stay.
If it rains, I will stay.
vaqt ravishi gap oxirida (yoki boshida: Yesterday I saw him).

Ustoz o'zbekcha aytadi, sinf inglizcha javob beradi — EXIT lug'at bo'limi ham shu turda (o'zbekcha -> inglizcha). Ovozli normativ yo'q.

class_ex.title: EXIT TEST — IELTS 1.0 yakuniy (L01–L27): ustoz uchun o'tkazish tartibi va ball jadvali
class_ex.instr: Yozma qism 28-darsda, 45 daqiqa (Listening 6 → Grammatika 15 → Lug'at 6 → Reading 8 → Writing 10). Speaking (15 ball) yozma qismdan OLDIN, 28-darsdagi 'EXIT — SPEAKING qismi' bosqichida (20 daqiqa) olinadi. Jami 100 ball + 2 bonus (jami 100 dan oshmaydi).
items: 1. Tayyorgarlik (test kunidan oldin): A variant o'quvchi varag'ini guruhdagi o'quvchilar soni + 2 nusxa chop eting (1-varaq: Listening, Grammatika, Lug'at; 2-varaq: Reading va Writing — 10 qator). Ball varag'i va xatolar varag'ini ham chop eting. B variant (qayta topshirish uchun) chop etiladi, lekin o'quvchilarga ko'rsatilmaydi. Speaking uchun 5 ta mavzu kartasini qirqib, qutichaga soling.

2. Speaking (yozma qismdan oldin, 20 daqiqa): o'quvchi qutidan 1 ta karta tortadi → 30 soniya o'ylaydi → 1–1.5 daqiqa gapiradi → ustoz kartadagi 2 ta yordamchi savolni beradi. Har o'quvchiga ≈ 2 daqiqa, 20 daqiqada 8–10 o'quvchi. Qolganlar shu vaqtda jim o'tirib CHECK-LIST varag'ini takrorlaydi. Guruh 10 dan katta bo'lsa, qolgan o'quvchilar yozma qism tugagach, shu kunning o'zida gapiradi. Ballni speaking_a1 rubrikasi bo'yicha darhol ball varag'iga yozing.

3. Yozma qismni boshlashdan oldin (2 daqiqa, 45 daqiqaga kirmaydi): telefonlar yig'iladi, o'quvchilar alohida o'tiradi, ism-familiya varaqqa yoziladi. Ko'rsatmani o'zbekcha ovoz chiqarib o'qing: 5 bo'lim, vaqt, o'tish balli 70.

4. Proyektorga faqat: bo'lim nomi, taymer va o'sha bo'limning ko'rsatmasi chiqariladi. Javob kaliti, Listening skripti, Reading javoblari va Writing namunasi proyektorga CHIQMAYDI (ular faqat ustoz ko'rinishida).

5. Listening (6 daqiqa, test boshida — hamma bir vaqtda boshlashi uchun): 30 soniya savollarni o'qishga vaqt beriladi → skriptni tabiiy tezlikda o'qing (ikki rolni ovoz bilan farqlang) → 20 soniya pauza → ikkinchi marta o'qing → 1 daqiqa javoblarni tekshirishga. Harflab aytilgan familiya va raqamlarni aniq, lekin sekinlatmasdan o'qing.

6. Keyingi bo'limlar: Grammatika 15 daq. → Lug'at 6 daq. → Reading 8 daq. → Writing 10 daq. Har bo'lim oxiridan 1 daqiqa oldin ogohlantiring. Vaqt tugasa, keyingi bo'limga o'tiladi; oldingi bo'limga faqat Writing tugagach, ortgan vaqt bo'lsa qaytish mumkin.
7. Test vaqtida savol mazmuni tushuntirilmaydi va tarjima qilinmaydi — faqat ko'rsatmani o'zbekcha takrorlash mumkin. Ko'chirish aniqlansa — o'sha bo'lim 0 ball, sababi ball varag'iga yoziladi.

8. Tekshirish: Grammatika 1–15 — har biri 1 ball. 16–25 — har biri 2 ball: to'liq to'g'ri = 2; zamon/yordamchi fe'l to'g'ri, lekin bitta mayda xato (imlo, -s tushib qolgan, savol belgisi yo'q) = 1; zamon yoki so'z tartibi xato = 0. Bonus B1–B2 — har biri +1 (faqat to'liq to'g'ri bo'lsa). Lug'at — har so'z 1 ball, bitta harf xatosi = 0.5, ikki va undan ko'p = 0 (a/an/the va to yozilmasa ham to'g'ri). Listening va Reading — har savol 2 ball; familiya va raqamda bitta xato ham 0; qisqa javobda imlo xatosi ma'noni buzmasa — ball beriladi.

9. Writing: avval so'zlarni sanang (60–80). writing_a1 rubrikasi: 4 mezon × 0–5 = 20 → × 0.75 = EXIT balli (0–15, 0.5 gacha yaxlitlanadi: 9.75 → 10, 11.25 → 11.5). 40 so'zdan kam bo'lsa, 'Topshiriqni bajarish' mezoni 1 dan oshmaydi.

10. Natija 48 soat ichida bo'limlar kesimida tizimga kiritiladi. Keyingi mashg'ulotda (yoki shaxsan) har o'quvchi o'z xatolar varag'ini oladi; ota-onaga natija va keyingi qadam haqida xabar yuboriladi (test yozilgandan keyin, oldin emas).
answers: Ball → natija → keyingi qadam (jami = Speaking + Listening + Grammatika + Lug'at + Reading + Writing + bonus, maksimum 100):
70–100 → O'TDI → IELTS 2.0 (A2) ga o'tadi. Xatolar varag'i baribir beriladi (eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 mavzu 2.0 ning birinchi haftasida takrorlanadi).

50–69 → xatolar varag'ini to'ldiradi va 7 kun ichida FAQAT 70% dan past bo'limlarni B variantdan qayta topshiradi (70% chegaralari: Speaking 10.5, Listening 7, Grammatika 24.5, Lug'at 10.5, Reading 7, Writing 10.5). Yangi ball eski bo'lim balli o'rniga yoziladi. Qayta hisoblangan jami ≥ 70 → O'TDI → IELTS 2.0.
0–49 → ota-onaga xabar (natija + bo'limlar) → 1 ta qo'shimcha (remedial) mashg'ulot, 45–60 daqiqa, eng zaif 2 bo'lim bo'yicha → so'ng 7 kun ichida B variant TO'LIQ qayta topshiriladi.
Qayta topshirishda ham < 70 → 1.0 takror modul yoki rahbar qarori. Qayta topshirishda ham < 50 → rahbar bilan suhbat (o'quvchi va ota-ona bilan; takror guruh taklif qilinadi).
Hech qanday natijada o'quvchi guruhdan chiqarilmaydi. Speaking va Writing qayta topshirishda boshqa mavzu (karta) beriladi; Listening, Grammatika, Lug'at va Reading — faqat B variantdan.

class_ex.title: 6-bo'lim. Speaking — 15 ball (yozma qismdan OLDIN, 28-dars 'EXIT — SPEAKING qismi', 20 daqiqa)
class_ex.type: Speaking — qura bo'yicha 1 mavzu, 1–1.5 daqiqa monolog + 2 yordamchi savol; speaking_a1 (15 ball)
class_ex.instr: Take one card. Think for 30 seconds. Then speak for 1–1.5 minutes. Then answer 2 questions. (Bitta karta oling. 30 soniya o'ylang, keyin 1–1.5 daqiqa gapiring. So'ng ustozning 2 ta savoliga javob bering.)
items: 1. Card 1 — About myself: name, age, city, school, hobbies, what you can do. Yordamchi savollar: What can you do well? / What do you usually do at the weekend?
2. Card 2 — My family: family members, their jobs, what they are like. Yordamchi savollar: Who do you help at home? / What did your family do last Sunday?
3. Card 3 — My home / My hometown: where it is, the rooms or places, your favourite place. Yordamchi savollar: What is there in your room? / Is there a park near your home?
4. Card 4 — My daily routine: morning, school, afternoon, evening. Yordamchi savollar: What time do you get up? / What are you going to do this evening?
5. Card 5 — My last weekend: where you went, what you did, who you were with. Yordamchi savollar: What did you eat? / Was it a good weekend? Why?

6. Ustoz uchun: o'quvchi gapirayotganda gapini bo'lmang va tuzatmang; 1.5 daqiqada to'xtating. Yordamchi savollarni faqat monologdan keyin bering. Qisqa belgi qo'ying (masalan: G 3 — does/do xato). Ball darhol ball varag'iga yoziladi.
7. Qayta topshirishda o'quvchi boshqa kartani tortadi (oldingi karta qutiga qaytarilmaydi).
answers: Namuna javob (Card 4 — My daily routine, 5/5/5 = 15 ball, ≈ 1 daqiqa 15 soniya): I usually get up at seven o'clock. First I wash my face and brush my teeth. Then I have breakfast with my family. I often eat eggs and bread, and I drink tea. At eight o'clock I go to school by bus. My school is not far from my home. My favourite subject is English because it is interesting. I come home at two o'clock and have lunch. In the afternoon I do my homework, but sometimes I play football with my friends. In the evening I watch TV or read a book. I go to bed at ten o'clock.
Yordamchi savollarga namuna: What time do you get up? — I get up at seven. / What are you going to do this evening? — I am going to do my homework and help my mother.
Ball: speaking_a1 — 3 mezon × 0–5 = 15 ball, EXIT ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'shiladi. 70% chegarasi — 10.5 (normativ — 11/15).

class_ex.title: Variant A — Listening skripti (faqat ustozga, o'qib beriladi)
class_ex.type: Listening — ustoz o'qiydigan original skript (2 rol, 2 marta)
class_ex.instr: Faqat ustoz uchun. Proyektorga chiqarilmaydi, o'quvchi varag'iga kirmaydi. Tabiiy tezlikda o'qing; ikki rolni ovoz bilan farqlang. 1-o'qish → 20 soniya pauza → 2-o'qish.
items: Roles: RECEPTIONIST (sport markazi) and TIMUR (o'quvchi). Read twice. (Ikki rol, 2 marta o'qiladi.)
RECEPTIONIST: Good afternoon, Sunrise Sports Centre. How can I help you?
TIMUR: Hello. I would like to join the swimming class, please.
RECEPTIONIST: Great. What is your name?
TIMUR: My name is Timur Rasulov.
RECEPTIONIST: How do you spell your surname?
RECEPTIONIST: Thank you. And what is your phone number?
TIMUR: It's nine-oh, four-one-five, two-seven, six-three.
RECEPTIONIST: The class is on Monday and Thursday. Which day do you want?
TIMUR: I have a football match every Monday, so Thursday, please.
RECEPTIONIST: OK. On Monday the class starts at four o'clock, but on Thursday it starts at half past four.
TIMUR: Half past four. Good. What do I need to bring?
RECEPTIONIST: Bring a towel and a bottle of water. Don't bring a ball. We have balls here.
RECEPTIONIST: You're welcome. See you on Thursday!
class_ex.note: Distraktorlar: Monday (futbol) → Thursday; four o'clock (dushanba) → half past four; ball (markazda bor) → towel and a bottle of water.

class_ex.title: Variant A — 1-bo'lim. Listening (forma to'ldirish) — 10 ball
class_ex.type: Listening — IELTS Section 1 uslubidagi forma: 4 ta bo'shliq + 1 ta savol (5 × 2 ball)
class_ex.instr: You will hear a phone call TWICE. Complete the form. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER. For question 5, circle A, B or C. (Telefon suhbatini 2 marta eshitasiz. Formani to'ldiring: BITTA so'z va/yoki raqam yozing. 5-savolda A, B yoki C ni aylana ichiga oling.) Time: 6 minutes.
box: SUNRISE SPORTS CENTRE — Swimming class: registration form
items: 5. What does Timur need to bring? A) a towel and a ball B) a towel and a bottle of water C) a bottle of water and a ball
answers: B) a towel and a bottle of water
why: Harflab aytiladi (L01: How do you spell it?) — imlo aniq bo'lishi shart.
Raqamlar tartibi to'g'ri bo'lsa, bo'sh joy va chiziqcha muhim emas.
To'p (ball) markazda bor — olib kelinmaydi (Don't bring a ball).

class_ex.title: Variant A — 2-bo'lim. Grammatika A (1–15: to'g'ri variant) — 15 ball
class_ex.type: Grammar — Multiple choice (15 × 1 ball); CHECK-LIST, 5 blok × 3 savol (L02–L26; L27 — faqat bonus): to be / davomiy / oddiy / ot-olmosh / boshqa
class_ex.instr: Choose the correct answer A, B or C. (To'g'ri javobni tanlang va harfni aylana ichiga oling.) Time for Grammar (1–25 + bonus): 15 minutes.
items: 1. My uncle _____ a doctor. He works at a hospital. A) am B) is C) are
2. _____ your parents at home now? — Yes, they are. A) Is B) Am C) Are
3. We _____ at the cinema yesterday evening. A) was B) were C) are
4. Look! The children _____ football in the park. A) play B) are playing C) played
5. I have a plan. I _____ my grandmother next Sunday. A) am going to visit B) visited C) visits
6. I was reading a book when my phone _____. A) was ringing B) rang C) rings
7. My sister _____ to school by bus every day. A) go B) goes C) going
8. _____ you play chess at the weekend? — Yes, I do. A) Do B) Does C) Are
9. Last summer we _____ to Samarkand by train. A) go B) went C) goed
10. I have _____ umbrella in my bag. A) a B) an C) some
11. There _____ some milk in the fridge. A) is B) are C) be
12. This is my cousin Ali. Do you know _____? A) he B) his C) him
13. If it rains tomorrow, we _____ at home. A) stay B) will stay C) stayed
14. Please be quiet. You _____ talk in the library. A) mustn't B) might C) could
15. She speaks English very _____. A) good B) well C) goodly
why: To be (L02–L04): my uncle = he → is.
To be savol (L06): parents = they → Are …?
To be o'tgan (L14): we + yesterday → were.
Davomiy/reja (L08): reja, kelajak → am going to + V1.
Past continuous + when (L17): uzun ish — was reading, uni bo'lgan qisqa ish — past simple (rang).
Oddiy (L09): you → Do …? Qisqa javob 'Yes, I do.'
Ot (L12): umbrella unli tovush bilan boshlanadi → an.
Ot/miqdor (L13): milk sanalmaydi → There is some.
Olmosh (L21): fe'ldan keyin to'ldiruvchi olmosh → him.
Boshqa — 1-tur shart gap (L20): If + present simple, will + V1.

box: My name is Madina and I am fourteen years old. I live in Namangan with my parents and my little brother, Sardor. He is nine. On weekdays I get up at seven o'clock and go to school by bus. My favourite subject is English because our teacher is very kind.

Last weekend was very busy. On Saturday morning I helped my mother in the kitchen, and we cooked plov for our grandparents. In the afternoon Sardor and I played chess, but he won three times! On Sunday it was cold and rainy, so we didn't go to the park. We watched a film at home.
Now I am writing this text in my room. Next Saturday my family is going to visit my aunt in Tashkent. I think it will be a lovely trip.
items: 1. Madina goes to school by bus.
2. Madina won all the chess games on Saturday.
3. On Sunday the weather was cold.
4. What did Madina and her mother cook on Saturday?

(Oilada necha kishi; kasblari va qanday odamlar; o'tgan dam olish kuni birga nima qildingiz; nega oilangizni yaxshi ko'rasiz.)

3. Rules: 60–80 words; every sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop; use at least 2 linking words (and, but, so, because). (Qoida: 60–80 so'z; har gap bosh harf bilan boshlanib nuqta bilan tugaydi; kamida 2 ta bog'lovchi.)

answers: Namuna javob, Topic A (74 so'z, sarlavhasiz; 20/20 → 15): Me and my day. My name is Kamola and I am thirteen. I live in Andijan with my family. On weekdays I get up at half past six and have breakfast with my brother. I go to school by bus. My favourite subject is English because it is interesting. In the afternoon I do my homework, but I don't watch TV. In the evening I help my mother and read a book. I go to bed at ten o'clock.

Namuna javob, Topic B (69 so'z, sarlavhasiz; 20/20 → 15): My family. There are five people in my family. My father is a driver and my mother is a nurse. They work very hard. I have a sister and a brother. My sister Laylo is ten, and she is very cheerful. My brother is only four, so he doesn't go to school. Last Sunday we visited our grandparents and had a picnic. I love my family because they always help me.
Majburiy emas, lekin yuqori ball uchun ko'riladi: present simple (-s bilan), to be, kamida bitta past simple gap (Topic B), and/but/so/because.

reading.title: ZAXIRA: My first year at Jony Academy
text: My name is Sardor. I am fourteen years old and I am from Bekobod. Last September I started IELTS 1.0 at Jony Academy. On the first day I was very nervous because I didn't know any English.

Now I can say many things. I get up at 7 every day, I go to school and in the afternoon I come to the academy. My favourite lessons are the Kahoot games — we play on our phones and the fastest student wins coins.

Before our last progress test I studied every evening, so I got 92%. At 9 pm on the day before the test I was still studying! My teacher said, 'Well done, Sardor! You will be a good student in IELTS 2.0.'
Tomorrow is our exit test. I am a little worried, but I am going to do my best. If I pass, my parents will buy me a new bike. Wish me luck!

transcript: NIGORA: Hello! My name is Nigora — N-I-G-O-R-A. I am thirteen years old and I live in Chirchiq.
NIGORA: Last year I didn't know any English. Now I can read short stories in English.
NIGORA: I usually get up at half past six. I have English lessons three times a week, and the lessons start at four o'clock.
NIGORA: My teacher is very friendly and helpful. My favourite game is Kahoot, because our team often wins coins.
NIGORA: Last week I was tired, but my parents helped me. At eight o'clock yesterday evening I was revising my lessons.
NIGORA: Tomorrow I will write my exit test. I am going to go to bed early tonight. If I pass, I will start IELTS 2.0.
